description: Nanobana is an independent AI image and video creation platform that brings leading third-party models into one workspace. Generate images and videos, explore prompt examples, and refine your work with background removal, image expansion, upscaling, and erasing tools. Studio combines an infinite canvas, references, Explore, and a design Agent to help you organize and develop creative ideas.
Lovart Info is an independent third-party guide site covering Lovart tutorials, prompts, API notes, pricing checks and comparisons. It is not the official Lovart product.

SourceSEO.ai is an AI-powered SEO automation platform that helps businesses improve search engine rankings, drive organic traffic, and increase visibility across Google and AI-powered search engines. It brings together website SEO audits, keyword research, AI-powered content generation, technical SEO analysis, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) in one platform. Its intelligent AI agents identify SEO issues, uncover keyword opportunities, optimize website content, and automate repetitive SEO tasks. SourceSEO.ai is designed for SEO professionals, digital marketing agencies, SaaS companies, startups, e-commerce businesses, and enterprises seeking to streamline SEO workflows, strengthen online visibility, and achieve long-term organic growth.

Social Fetch is an API that returns public social media data as JSON. Pull profiles, posts, comments, transcripts and search results with one API key, or connect AI agents through the hosted MCP server. Credits are pay as you go and never expire. New accounts get 100 free credits with no card.

RefineCV is AI CV formatting software for recruitment agencies. Upload any candidate CV (PDF, Word and more) and get it in your agency's branded template in seconds, as a PDF or editable DOCX. The free plan covers 10 CVs, custom templates are free on all plans, and it integrates live with Bullhorn and SAP SuccessFactors.

You interview customers at scale by letting an AI interviewer run consistent voice conversations in parallel, instead of scheduling and moderating each call yourself. You still set the questions, invite people you can already reach, and read the transcripts and themes; more volume is not a substitute for checking the quotes. Frank (https://www.hifrank.ai) is a voice-first product that runs AI-moderated voice interviews with your own customers. Frank does not recruit participants. It can run hundreds of interviews overnight, supports 50+ interview languages, and is SOC 2 Type II and GDPR compliant. MCP is included on every plan, including Free, and works with ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, Instinct and Muse (tested), plus other MCP clients that support remote servers with OAuth. Video, WhatsApp and chat interviews are Coming soon.

GeoEcho is an AI search monitoring platform that records answers from enabled AI platforms so teams can review brand mentions, recommendations, competitor share of voice, sentiment, and cited domains. Enter a domain, set monitoring prompts and competitors, and GeoEcho submits those prompts to the platforms available on your plan. Results appear in one dashboard, with mention rate, recommendation ranking, and citation sources for investigation and content planning. A distinctive coverage area is global and China engines in the same product: ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini alongside DeepSeek, Kimi, and Doubao. Illustrated platforms on the marketing site are not a promise of availability; current access depends on plan entitlements and channel status. Pricing is public. Plans start at $29/month for Starter, with Pro at $99 and Team at $299 (lower monthly equivalents when billed yearly). You can register and configure a project first, but collection requires a paid plan and credits. GeoEcho is owned and operated by Tapilot LLC. Support: support@geoecho.ai.

AhaNow is a browser-based studio for turning a topic, study notes or a script into a narrated explainer video. Review the script and scene plan, choose a visual style, revise individual scenes and export a finished video for lessons, tutorials or training.

The Chipmunks Dance AI generator turns three photos, one per dancer, into a 15-second chipmunks dance video for anyone who wants to join the trend without filming it. Add one photo per dancer, pick each dancer’s hair, and get a vertical 9:16 video in about 5 to 8 minutes. Your first video is free after you sign in and is made with Seedance 2.0 Mini, 480p. Videos you buy are made with the full Seedance 2.0, 720p: 1 video for $9.90, 3 for $24.90 or 6 for $39.90, a one-time payment with no subscription.

Pick a scene from a large AI template library, add your cast photos, and get one complete video from $7.99 — no account required. Browse 150+ curated AI video templates, add one clear photo per labeled role, choose 480p ($7.99) or 720p ($11.99), and receive a private MP4 after manual preparation. No account, no subscription, no prompt. Independent site I made / operate.

Pick a fixed AI video effect, add your photos, and buy one personalized clip — no prompts, no editor, no subscription. Choose a ready-made scene (hotel lobby duet, flying roadster, money rain party, and more), upload the labeled photos, pick 480p or 720p, and pay once for a private MP4 up to about 21 seconds. Pricing: 480p USD 7.99 / 720p USD 11.99 per video. Independent site I made / operate.

CV Objective helps job seekers prepare application materials for a specific role. Users can start with their work history or an existing resume, build and edit a targeted resume, and compare it with a job description. The review helps identify relevant experience and wording that may need a closer look. Users can also draft a matching cover letter in the same workspace. AI suggestions are editable. Applicants should check every proposed detail against their actual experience and decide what belongs in the final application. The tools are useful when applying to different roles and keeping each resume and cover letter relevant to the position.
AI book creator for Amazon KDP: turn one idea into a picture, coloring, activity book or novel with print PDF, wrap cover and Kindle EPUB. Free to start with 1,500 credits.

Apollo Rockets is a free social platform built around orbits — topic communities for space, AI, tech, news, and more — with posts, polls, a photo feed, direct messages, and Ford Nexus, a built-in AI assistant with live news briefings.

DubTab gives you three ways to run the same real-time dubbing stack. The Chrome and Edge extension follows tab audio on Windows, macOS, and Linux. The desktop app on Windows 11 and Mac can listen to the whole machine or a single app. The Android app (Android 10+) floats translated captions over the video and plays a dubbed voice in the app you already use. Either way you get AI dubbing, bilingual or translated-only subtitles, and roughly 0.5-second latency across 50+ languages. Designed for courses, streams, and videos without uploading files. Freemium pricing with shared hours across all clients.

AI Maze Generator creates unique mazes you can watch being generated and then solve. Four shapes (square, hexagonal, circular, triangle), seven modes including a 30-level campaign, daily challenge, time attack, fog of war, optimal-path challenge, custom generator from 5×5 to 50×50, and print. Free to play with achievements. Based in London, UK.

The Drive AI is the intelligence layer for all the files in the world, wherever they are. It organizes existing and incoming files by rules set in plain English, renaming files that arrive with meaningless names and filing them automatically. Across 2 million files organized, 40% arrived with meaningless names the AI renames.
Albert, by InboxAI, helps business teams triage incoming email and prepare replies for human review. Request a guided demo to see how it can fit your team’s workflow.

Talk to Me Doja AI is an independent single-photo AI dance generator. Upload one clear front-facing adult portrait and download a 12-second, watermark-free 9:16 vertical MP4 of the Talk to Me Doja cheek-cupping sway. Choose Fast or Premium at 480p or 720p. One-time credit packs start at $4.99; credits never expire, and failed renders are refunded automatically. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Doja Cat or the anime rights holders.

Lovspark is an AI design canvas for interior designers and architects. Stage empty rooms, turn sketches and SketchUp views into photoreal renders, swap paint and materials, and place real furniture from supplier catalogs, then export an FF&E schedule from the render. Free plan with 200 credits per month.

Promeo is an AI art prompt gallery and AI image generator. Browse AI image prompts next to the pictures they created, filtered by category (portrait, product, logo, anime, 3D, poster, fashion, interior) or by model. Copy a prompt from the gallery, download an image, or start from a few words: choose a subject, a use and a style, and Promeo shapes the prompt and generates the image. Approved public creations become inspiration for the next person.
Therefor is an AI remembrance, voice preservation and conversational memorial web app. Users share memories and audio to converse privately via text or synthesized voice sessions.

Tondevis is a web application for artisans, freelancers and small businesses, published by Univers Meta SARL in Morocco. Create branded PDF quotes, invoices and purchase orders, organise customers and service catalogues, and record payments to follow outstanding balances. Download, print or email documents from the application. An AI assistant helps clarify descriptions using the information and prices you provide. It does not look up live market prices. The interface supports French, English and Arabic on desktop and mobile. The professional workspace is subscription-based; public calculators are also available. Users choose and verify their local tax settings.
AI document translator for PDF, Word, PowerPoint & Excel. Translate into 100+ languages without losing the layout — tables, charts, images and styles stay put.

Christmas AI Photo turns one selfie into a Christmas photo that still looks like you. Upload a clear, front-facing photo, pick one of 77 festive scenes — Santa suit in the snow or on the beach, ugly-sweater flash selfies, candy cane shoot, cozy pajamas, a holiday card and more — and download a picture sized for Instagram, Facebook or a card. No prompt writing. New accounts get one free watermarked preview with no card needed (sign in with Google). After that, one-time credit packs: 15 HD photos for $4.99, or 40 for $9.99. No subscription, credits never expire. Photos are private, selfies are deleted after 7 days and never used for training.

SimpleEraser brings AI inpainting into a straightforward web editor for people who want to remove distractions from finished images. SimpleEraser can be used on everyday pictures as well as images prepared for real-estate listings or e-commerce catalogues. Once the target is marked, SimpleEraser applies AI inpainting to reconstruct visual content where the selected element appeared. The editing workspace provides manual selection and correction tools rather than promising automatic detection of every person or object. HEIC support makes it possible to try an iPhone photo directly, alongside standard JPG, PNG, and WebP files. AI-generated edits should be checked before use, especially when the photo contains faces, overlapping subjects, or important scene details. The pricing page lists 25-, 60-, and 150-credit packs; check the live pricing page for current rates before purchasing a pack. Only upload photos you own or have permission to edit.

Applying for internships or a first full-time role means keeping track of deadlines, résumé versions, messages and next steps. Jobrith gives each opportunity a home. Track where applications stand, review AI résumé suggestions in the context of a role, and keep conversations and follow-ups alongside it. Jobrith is free to start, and AI features use credits. Try the interactive demo at https://jobrith.com/#product with a sample application.

Make your assistant setup feel yours. Tavi lets you choose a name, preview a sample sentence using voices available on your browser or device, and save your name and voice preference in a free account. It is for people exploring a more personal voice-assistant setup. Voice availability and playback depend on your device; the preview is not an AI reply and needs no microphone access. Model activation is pending, so real AI conversations are not available today. Subscriptions and payment are not open; saving your setup is free, with no card needed.

CheckAIVisibility is a free AI visibility checker. Enter your website and it asks AI models the buyer-style questions your customers ask, then shows whether your brand is mentioned, where it appears in the list, which competitors are named instead, and which third-party pages the answers cite, with one suggested action for each cited page.

The free check runs 5 questions on OpenAI with web search and adds on-site AI readiness checks: robots.txt rules for AI crawlers, llms.txt, JSON-LD, meta tags, server-rendered text and sitemap. It is limited to 3 free checks per day per network. No account is needed.

The full report is a one-time $9: 15 questions across OpenAI and Claude with web search plus Gemini from model knowledge, 2 runs each (90 answers), per-engine scores and one re-check after 30 days. No subscription.

Results come from the official APIs and can differ from the ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini apps. CheckAIVisibility is not affiliated with OpenAI, Anthropic or Google. It is a one-time audit, not ongoing monitoring.

Avio is an agentic AI you text on WhatsApp — it makes calls, books appointments, arranges meetings, writes invoices and documents, tracks expenses from receipts, transcribes voice notes and remembers what matters, in five languages. No app, no sign-up and no password. Every user has a private agent and private memory, and data is never sold. Nothing is paid for or sent without your approval. Free forever: 250 messages/month, 2 calls, documents, reminders and one text-edited website. Paid plans from $25/month.

ClipFirst watches live Twitch streams for you. When chat spikes, an AI judge checks the moment is worth posting, then a captioned vertical clip lands in Telegram with 3 caption ideas. First 3 clips free, then $19/month.
Create a mobile guest guide with arrival instructions, house rules and local recommendations. Share it by link or QR code. Guests can ask an AI concierge questions based on the guide.

Ask a question, choose a tarot spread and pick an AI reader. You can try a short reading without signing in. Full readings require an account and credits bought as one-time purchases. TarotRead also has guides to all 78 tarot cards and a dream dictionary. Readings are for entertainment and self-reflection.

Mexico Pterodactyl AI places your selfie into a fictional Mexico pterodactyl scene. Upload a portrait, choose one of nine templates, and generate a still photo or vertical 9:16 video. Videos use Seedance 2 Mini; photos use Nano Banana 2. Paid one-time credit packs start at $5.99 USD. Fictional AI entertainment, not news footage or a real sighting.

Arabic AI sales assistant that explains services, qualifies business inquiries and introduces ready buyers to the owner. One-time SAR 499 customer inquiry audit plus automation plan and ten tailored Arabic responses. Built for Saudi SMEs; no guaranteed sales.

EclipseStay Spain is a digital directory connecting travellers planning for the 2 August 2027 solar eclipse with private local host proposals. Hosts may offer overnight accommodation, a viewing-only space, or both, and set the initial price. A viewing space is not automatically accommodation.

Host recruitment covers Spain, Gibraltar, Tangier, Oran, Sfax, Benghazi and Luxor. Recruitment areas do not confirm available inventory or totality at every address. Travellers should check the precise observing location and the site's current access, fees and terms.

The digital platform fee is separate from any stay. A winning bid opens contact, not a confirmed accommodation booking. Dates, final price, payment and cancellation terms are agreed directly with the host.

Submitted by EclipseStay Spain's authorized AI assistant on the owner's behalf.

Fyslide is a desktop app for making TikTok photo slideshows and Instagram carousels. Choose a design, give it a topic and use your own AI to write the slide text. Edit text, images, stickers and shapes, then export PNG or JPG slides with captions. Batch-create slideshows, plan posts by account, and publish to TikTok or send drafts to your TikTok inbox. A local MCP server lets tools such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor create, edit and export slideshows. Bring your own AI login or API key, or run Ollama locally. Available for macOS and Windows Beta. One-time lifetime license for one computer, no subscription. A license is required; no trial mode. Instagram publishing is not yet available.

LocalASO helps indie app developers research keywords, track rankings and prepare localized App Store listings across 52 storefronts. It shows keyword rank, estimated volume and difficulty, with daily history. Bring your own AI to write names, subtitles, keywords, descriptions and promo text. A local MCP server connects tools such as Claude Code and Cursor to the keyword board. Upload selected fields to an editable App Store Connect draft, never directly for review. Runs on macOS 14+ for Apple Silicon and Intel. $29 once for a lifetime license on one Mac, with updates included. A license is required to run the app.

Monty turns a clip where you talk to the camera into a finished vertical video: it cuts the best parts, adds captions, music and b-roll, and on paid plans auto-posts to YouTube Shorts and TikTok. For creators, experts and small businesses who film themselves. Free plan: 3 videos a month. Also free browser tools with no signup: teleprompter with camera recording, safe zone checker for TikTok/Reels/Shorts, horizontal to vertical video converter.

Describe an idea in one sentence and Omi, the AI app builder from BuildItOmi, creates a working website or full-stack app with sign-in, a database and hosting. New accounts get 15 million free credits, no card. Then paid plans from $19/month.

Hire AI employees that work 24/7 on their own cloud computer. They research markets, find leads, track competitors and draft outreach, then ask before sending, posting or paying. Plans from $19/month. 30-minute trial of real work; a card is required.

OrbitDesk helps businesses organise customer enquiries, identify missing information, and prepare professional responses using AI. Designed for businesses across industries, it brings enquiry management and AI assistance into one workspace.

An AI photo-to-dance video generator that works in your browser. Upload one or two photos of consenting adults, choose a scene, and get a short vertical video with template music. Party Bite is a 9-second solo entrance from one photo; Duo Dance is a 7-second two-person routine from one or two photos. Both deliver a 720p 9:16 MP4. Each video costs 10 credits. Packs are one-time, credits never expire, and confirmed failed jobs restore credits. Examples are free to watch. An independent creative tool. Consenting adults only; the tool does not support children or pets.

Inquiry Cloud works with Chinese exporters — manufacturers and traders — on customer acquisition and account management. Products include Marketing CRM for inquiry follow-up, RAG SEO for knowledge-based search acquisition, RAG GEO for visibility in AI search answers, plus social media operations and foreign-trade website building. The goal is a process a team can actually run: content starts from the company’s own knowledge, the website can handle traffic, and sales can follow up inquiries.

Anywear Studio is a live AI fitting room for online shoppers. Add a clothing image, turn on your camera, and preview the outfit in motion on your phone or desktop. The desktop Chrome extension opens a fitting room beside shopping pages.

EQSay is an AI communication assistant for everyday, work, and customer conversations. It uses chat screenshots, including visible unsent drafts in the input box, to suggest a copyable reply and explain the reasoning, while keeping the user's own tone. It does not send messages for the user.

NeedGPT is a third-party website for ChatGPT Plus, ChatGPT Pro, and related Codex membership recharge and membership account services. It is not affiliated with OpenAI, and it is not a ChatGPT chatbot or mirror.

An independent AI photo-to-mini-concert video generator. Upload one clear adult portrait as the lead performer and, if you like, up to four bandmate photos for keyboard, sax and two backing singers; empty roles keep the template's fictional musicians. Choose a band template and get a roughly 19-second 9:16 video in clean 720p HD with the template's original soundtrack. Each video uses 10 purchased credits. Packs are one-time, never expire and never renew. No free credits.

TatMint turns a few words into a tattoo concept. Describe your idea, pick one of six styles (fine line, minimalist, traditional, Japanese, blackwork, geometric), set placement, color and detail, and get a 1K PNG design saved privately to your account. A free try-on lets you place designs on sample body photos or your own photo right in the browser. Built as a reference to discuss with your tattoo artist, not a stencil.

HeriBase is an AI app for identifying coins and banknotes from photographs. Capture both sides of an item to review a suggested catalog match, specifications, and a reference value, then save it to a collection, list it for sale, or request a specialist review.

It is made for coin and banknote collectors. The app is free to download on iOS and Android. The first three scans each day are free, and additional scans are available by watching ads or with an optional subscription (freemium). Human expert appraisal is billed separately. Identification results and reference prices are research aids, not authentication or a guaranteed sale price.

HeriBase is developed by Open Sky New Media Limited. The official site states it is used by 1M+ collectors in 195+ countries and regions (internal data as of May 2026).

Gift A Cartoon turns a photo into a cartoon portrait with an on-screen preview before ordering. Customers can choose a style and put the result on a mug, shirt, canvas or another printed gift. Previewing is free; printed products and shipping are paid.

An enterprise-grade unified AI API gateway built for developers and engineering teams. Call frontier reasoning, chat, and multimodal models through a single standard key with configured channel routing and request-level usage records.

AIBase is an independent AI image generator and AI video generator. It brings text to image, image to image, text to video and image to video into one workspace, with 4 image and 6 video models to choose from. Write a prompt, add one JPEG, PNG or WebP reference up to 10 MB where supported, review the model, settings and credit estimate before you submit, then follow progress and download the result. A free image trial on the homepage needs no account.

Match.asia is a Southeast Asian M&A marketplace that connects business owners with verified buyers and investors. The platform uses AI-powered matching to help sellers find relevant acquisition opportunities and investors discover businesses that match their investment criteria.
Match.asia supports business owners throughout the business sale process, from preparing a company for sale and assessing its value to finding potential buyers and connecting with investors. The platform focuses on SME business sales and acquisitions across Southeast Asia, including Singapore, Vietnam, and Thailand.
For buyers and investors, Match.asia provides access to business acquisition opportunities across industries such as F&B, retail, manufacturing, technology, business services, and other sectors. The platform combines business listings, investor information, and technology-driven matching to help users discover relevant acquisition opportunities.
Match.asia operates on a success-fee model, with no upfront fee for sellers. The platform aims to simplify the process of buying and selling businesses across Southeast Asia.

EditBright is a free AI image editor that runs in the browser — no sign up and no login. Upload a photo, edit or generate, and download. Image-to-image, background remover, and photo enhancer are available on day one. Default tools stay free; optional paid models are there for more power.

MTIStudy is a Chinese-language practice platform for CATTI translation exams, MTI entrance exams and IELTS. Learners can work through exam materials, write translations, compare reference translations, save practice progress and review AI feedback on omissions, terminology and expression. IELTS practice covers listening, reading and writing. Some previews and limited trial practice are free; additional access and AI feedback require paid membership or credits. It is a study aid, not an official examination or certification service.

PRSNA is a place to write with AI characters. Describe someone and PRSNA builds their personality, backstory and look in about a minute. Then chat one on one, put up to five characters in a group scene, or write a story in chapters. Dozens of models, free to start.

AI Minecraft Skin Generator turns an idea, photo or avatar into a playable Minecraft skin. Describe a character (up to 450 characters) or upload a selfie, character image or artwork (PNG, JPG or WEBP, up to 10 MB). Text-to-skin costs 1 credit. Image workflows create a character preview first (1 credit), then convert the look you confirm into a playable skin (2 credits). Failed generations return reserved credits. Preview the result in 3D, download a Classic 64x64 PNG, and refine it in the free editor. Other free tools include a local PNG format converter and a public Java player skin lookup. Sign in is required for AI generation and to save a private history; the 3D examples, editors and converter can be used without an account. New accounts receive 3 welcome credits. Credits, including welcome credits, never expire. Compatible with Java Edition; Bedrock custom-skin support depends on the device. This independent tool is not an official Minecraft product and is not approved by or affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft.

Else helps people research questions, work with source files and produce shareable reports through a web interface. It uses prepaid, task-based billing with a limited starting balance; costs vary and failed work can incur charges. Review important results independently. Submitted by an AI assistant on behalf of the Else team.

A blink can spoil an otherwise useful group portrait. MomentRescue lets you select that person and try an eye-area repair, optionally guided by an open-eye photo of the same person. Use the saved preview to inspect gaze and eyelid edges; outputs are AI estimates and vary with the source photo. One generation per account is free across the toolkit, with a watermarked preview. Clean downloads and further edits use one-time purchased Credits, starting at $1.49, with no subscription.

PuzzleBind is a free Chrome extension that makes solver-checked Sudoku, seeded word-search and maze puzzle books for Amazon KDP — 20 puzzles per book, 1 export per day, no account, no subscription. It makes KDP paperback interiors, not covers. Every Sudoku is solver-checked for a single solution before it goes into the book. Word searches and mazes are generated from a seed, so each volume in a series gets different puzzles. Every page is laid out against Amazon's own trim, gutter and margin rules, with even page counts and embedded fonts checked before you export. Free is $0 forever (20 puzzles/book, 1 export/day, all puzzle types, all trim sizes, AI Theme Words, footer watermark included). Pro is $19 one-time (lifetime license, no subscription, 30-day refund) and unlocks custom word lists and the large-print preset. It does not make covers, and it is not a free printable download — it makes a KDP paperback interior.

Hey Dream AI is a browser-based platform for generating videos from text or photos and creating or editing images with multiple AI models. Its free image-to-video tool lets users choose the opening and closing frames, then describe the motion between them. The platform offers free tools alongside paid credit options.

CollageMint is a free online photo collage maker with no signup and no watermark. Choose from six focal layouts and grid layouts, add up to 20 JPEG or PNG photos, and arrange a collage directly in your browser. Each photo can be up to 20 MB. Photos are processed locally in the browser rather than uploaded to a server. Download the finished collage as a PNG or JPG. CollageMint also offers a Photo Grid Maker and a Pinterest Collage Maker for related layouts. The tool does not use AI and does not require a subscription.

AI Image Extender lets you upload a photo, pick a target frame, and generate matching background beyond the original edges. Batch up to five images; built for real estate, e-commerce, social, and poster reframes.

Virgínia Menino IA transforma uma ou duas fotos no Meme da Virgínia e o Menino. Em “Só eu cantando”, uma foto entra no lugar de quem canta; em “Nós dois”, duas fotos preenchem a cena. O MP4 vertical 9:16 segue os gestos do clipe original, sem clonar a voz, e a trilha entra depois. Você baixa vídeos de 10, 15 ou 25 segundos, em 480p ou 720p. Créditos avulsos desde US$ 5,99, sem vencimento e sem assinatura. Projeto independente, sem vínculo com TikTok ou com os criadores da trend original.

I Love the Smiths AI turns one or two adult portraits into the viral elevator exchange from (500) Days of Summer. Choose 15 or 23 seconds and download a landscape 16:9 HD MP4 with the prepared scene soundtrack. One-time credit packs from $9.90; no subscription.

BGRemover Online removes backgrounds from videos and images. Export transparent WebM clips for overlays, motion graphics, and web projects. Free format converters also help you work with alpha video and turn PNG sequences into WebM.

Sheru Bhai AI Video Generator, on Sheru Bhai Hub, turns 1–2 clear, evenly lit adult portraits (with permission) into a new 10-second 720p MP4. Choose one of 14 fictional human-companion, couple or lion-persona templates, pick 9:16 or 16:9, and get generated instrumental audio with no dialogue. Preview clips illustrate the setting; they are not motion references. Videos cost 50 credits; 2K stills cost 5. One-time packs, no subscription: $5.99 / $14.99 / $29.99. Unused credits never expire. Adults 18+ only.

SubtitlePop generates word-timed captions from audio or video. Edit the text, timing, and style in your browser, then export SRT, VTT, ASS, TXT, or a video with burned-in captions. Free utilities convert subtitle files, shift timestamps, and check timing.

SkillSoniq is an AI-powered hiring app that lets companies test-drive talent on real, paid work before committing to full-time payroll. Employers post jobs for free and get AI-matched candidates within seconds, then either hire onto payroll from day one or start a paid project and convert when ready. SkillSoniq runs background checks, handles onboarding paperwork and weekly timesheets, and sends one consolidated invoice. Pricing: free to post and hire; a payment-processing fee plus up to 20% commission on paid trial work; a buyout fee on payroll conversion. Web and iOS.

Klarr is an all-in-one platform for independent restaurants. It brings together commission-free online bookings (reservation book, floor plan, deposits paid straight to the restaurant's own account, private events), a website with the menu and allergens, the Google Business Profile and reviews, posts to Facebook, Instagram and TikTok, and table or takeaway ordering. What sets it apart: Klarr measures whether the restaurant is recommended when diners ask ChatGPT, Gemini or Google's AI Mode where to eat, and shows what to fix. Klarr is published by EDIREF, a Paris company that also runs a restaurant in Paris. Free trial, no credit card, no commitment.

NAVSMAP is a Chinese-first resource discovery site for AI and everyday productivity tools. Browse tool profiles with use cases, pricing notes and official links, explore task-based workflows, and find MCP servers and agent skills with setup references. Public browsing is free; third-party tools may charge separately.

The AI Matching PFP Maker turns your selfies into coordinated profile pictures. Upload your photos and describe the style you want — whether professional, casual, or themed — and AI creates the image for you. It's made for couples who want matching profile pictures on social media and messaging apps.

WordCam is a photo-based language-learning product with four AI tools in one place: upload a photo, snap one on the spot, or paste a screenshot, and AI labels every object it finds in the picture in both your native and your target language; describe any scene to generate a practical dialogue; chat with AI by voice or text; or open your camera for real-time descriptions in your chosen language. WordCam currently supports 11 languages.

Max Maker AI helps creators and online sellers make short videos and product visuals in a browser. Generate a clip from a text prompt or animate a still photo by describing the movement you want. The workspace also offers image generation, background removal, photo restoration, and virtual clothing try-on.

KlingVideo is a free Kling AI video generator that turns text prompts, reference images, and motion-control inputs into cinematic AI videos. Create with Kling 3.0 plus Seedance, Veo, Wan, Hailuo, Grok and more—plan multi-shot scenes, keep characters consistent, animate stills, and transfer reference movement. New users get free starter credits; paid plans unlock more capacity. No watermark on supported exports. Start at https://klingvideo.app/

Wechatai connects your own model API or existing agents to WeChat through one-to-one ClawBot binding. Chat, generate images or receive notifications. BYOK; provider model fees are separate. Free daily credits and optional Plus. Not affiliated with Tencent.

AI Stack Lab is a resource platform providing dated price and feature data for AI and cross-border ecommerce software tools. It offers working cost calculators including cross-border profit, advertising breakeven, SaaS stack costs, newsletter revenue, affiliate page value, and funnel break-even. The site organizes software into categories such as AI copywriting, video, voice, Amazon research, analytics, automation, customer support, design, ecommerce, email/SMS, hosting, model APIs, payments, productivity, SEO, translation, and website builders. It includes editorial best-picks guides for building stacks for specific use cases and clearly marks sponsored/referral affiliate links. Target audience: cross-border ecommerce sellers, indie hackers, marketers, and software evaluators looking for practical AI and marketing tool guidance with transparent pricing history.

Marketing and AI call answering for home service businesses (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing and other trades). AI agents answer calls, texts and forms, triage emergencies, block spam and book real jobs into your software, plus manage Google Business Profile, Local Services Ads and paid search. Prompt Anatomy is an AI training system and prompt engineering course that teaches the 6-block prompt method (META, INPUT, OUTPUT, REASONING, QUALITY, ADVANCED). The method is a structured way to design repeatable AI tasks for individuals and teams, so instructions are easier to reuse, evaluate, and improve.

META defines the AI's role, task objective, and operating boundaries. INPUT specifies the source data and context the AI may use. OUTPUT defines the expected deliverable, structure, and format. REASONING sets decision criteria as observable steps. QUALITY establishes checks for accuracy, completeness, and compliance. ADVANCED adds tools, retrieval, automation, or multi-step agent workflows when the task needs them.

Training runs in an interactive app on promptanatomy.app, with hands-on exercises and a certificate from a 70% score. Starter (39 EUR) covers modules 1-3: prompt engineering, the 6-block system, and six business scenarios. Core (99 EUR) covers modules 1-6 and adds context engineering, a sprint, and a project. Both are one-time payments with lifetime access and no subscription. AI training for teams is available on request.

A 500+ template library and free workflow tools complement the course. Trainings are available in English and Lithuanian. Founder and creator: Tomas Staniulis. Contact: info@promptanatomy.app.
