Each person gets an Assistant that plans their day and drafts replies for them to send. Build new agents by describing the job in plain words, and show the whole floor on a TV for everyone to see.

BatchData is an API-first U.S. real estate data platform. Developers, proptech teams, lenders, insurers, investors and home services companies use it to search and enrich property records, find and verify owner contact data with skip tracing, pull automated valuations and comps, verify addresses and phones, and deliver bulk data by API, webhook, Snowflake or AWS S3. Its hosted MCP server at mcp.batchdata.com lets AI agents query nationwide property data directly. Easy to buy, easy to integrate, easy to scale.

Happy Customer gives customer-service teams a place to practise high-pressure conversations before they happen at work. Staff role-play complaints, refunds and escalations with fictional customers in AI-led video scenarios. Managers can align challenges with approved company policies and review feedback on listening, clarity, judgement and professional boundaries.

BulkPublish is a social media publisher and scheduler for humans and AI. Compose a post once, then publish it now or schedule it across Facebook, Instagram, X, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn and more from one dashboard. The free plan covers 3 channels with 1 post a day; Pro is $13.99/month and Business is $39.99/month.

Marketsy.ai is an AI-powered commerce platform that helps creators and small businesses start selling products online without technical barriers. Users can build personalized e-commerce websites through simple prompts and launch professional storefronts without coding. Artificial intelligence helps automate product listing creation and simplifies the process of preparing products for sale. From downloadable resources and e-books to online courses and memberships, the platform supports a wide range of digital business models. Sellers can also offer physical products and accept payments securely through Stripe. With zero-commission sales, customizable storefronts, analytics, inventory management, and Zapier automation, Marketsy.ai reduces the complexity of managing an online shop. It gives entrepreneurs the tools to focus on their products, customers, and business growth.

RoomDesign Genius is a web-based AI room design studio. Upload a photo of a living room, bedroom, kitchen or bathroom, pick a style, and compare up to four redesigns designed to preserve your walls, windows and perspective. You can also describe a room in words, furnish or empty a space, or generate a floor-plan concept. Two free 2D planners let you draw layouts to scale in the browser with no account. AI designs use credits from a monthly or yearly plan or a one-time pack. New accounts get free credits to try, and no card is required to start. Results are visual concepts, not construction drawings.

Peat Flow is a Mac app that brings screenshots, speech and intent together for clearer communication with AI.

Capture several views, such as an overall layout, a close-up and a reference, then paste multiple screenshots together into an input that supports images. Screenshots and multi-image paste are free forever.

With Point & Say, mark a location and speak naturally. Cloud AI removes filler, resolves spoken corrections and separates changes into clearer instructions. Review the prepared images and text, then send them to the AI you already use. Peat Flow does not press Send for you.

Screenshots themselves are not uploaded. Point & Say sends audio and text within marked areas to the cloud for transcription and organization; history stays on your Mac. Automatic pasting requires a compatible input and focus; manual paste is available when needed.

Requires Apple silicon and macOS 14 or later. Point & Say uses product credits and needs an internet connection. Eligible new users receive a one-time $30 product-credit grant, valid for 90 days, without a card. This is not a subscription trial and does not trigger automatic billing.

The Solo Consultant's AI Team publishes written playbooks for setting up AI agents in a one-person consulting practice. The $29 Your First AI Chief of Staff guide sets up a morning brief and an end-of-day close-out with a persona and six skills, in about two hours. The $89.99 Full AI Team Kit adds five roles (chief of staff, sales, content, client delivery, research) with 22 skill files and a weekly check. It works with Claude, ChatGPT, Grok Bot or any AI tool. A free AI Agent Org Chart PDF is on the site.
PromptCrate is a free library of 500+ ready-to-use master prompts for viral AI videos — written for Veo 3, Seedance, Kling and Google Flow. Open any prompt, copy it in one click, and start creating.

PopFestive is an AI Christmas photo and video generator. Upload one clear photo of yourself, your child or your pet and get a Christmas profile picture, a Santa Nice List certificate or a festive pet portrait in minutes.

UGCraft is an AI Roblox UGC creator. Describe an accessory or outfit in text, or upload a reference image, and it builds a marketplace-ready 3D item, no Blender needed. Make layered clothing, accessories, classic shirts and pants, R15 emotes and animations, or cages; free tools include a Clothing Tester, UGC Checker and UGC Ideas. Free plan includes 20 credits; paid plans add commercial rights and remove the watermark.

MakeFacelessVideo turns topics or scripts into review-ready faceless episodes with scene-specific AI visuals, narration and word-synced captions. Series Autopilot schedules creation. The series wizard supports English and Mandarin, with 13 voices and 9:16/16:9 formats. Posting depends on connected channels and platform capacity; manual downloads are available. Free plan: one 30-second video/month, no card required; paid from $19/month.

RapTake creates short solo or duet rap videos from permitted adult portraits. Choose a prepared track with lyrics, vocals and backing music, select a scene and portrait or landscape format, then review the character image before generating. One-time paid packs start at $7.99 for solo and $12.99 for duet videos.

productName: your first time in a fancy cafe
description: Fancy Cafe AI is an independent browser studio for the “first time in a fancy cafe” wrong-seat trend. Upload one portrait (Solo) or two separate selfies (With a friend), pick a cafe case style, and generate a 15-second 720p video in 9:16 or 16:9 with audio enabled. Photo 1 takes the wrong seat on the tiny table; photo 2 is the guest who walks in. No filming, no prompt to write, no editing app. Preview and browsing are free; generation is paid only via one-time credit packs, no subscription: Single $8.90 / 20 credits / 1 video; Five Pack $29.90 / 100 credits / 5 videos; Studio Pack $99.90 / 400 credits / 20 videos; 20 credits per 15s 720p clip.

Rubricfy helps AP English Language students practice synthesis, rhetorical analysis, and argument essays. It scores practice drafts on the six-point rubric and provides explanations and revision suggestions for thesis, evidence and commentary, and sophistication. Free to try without signing up, with daily limits and optional one-time credit packs. Feedback is for practice, not an official exam score.

You Never Let Her Pay is an independent browser-based photo-to-video studio for the wallet-sponge dinner meme. Upload one consenting adult portrait, pick Seedance 2.5, Seedance 2.0 Fast, or Seedance 2.0 (all 20 credits, 480p, 11 seconds, original audio, 9:16 or 16:9), and generate the diner who offers to pay. Watch example TikToks and check your portrait in the browser for free. The studio adds no watermark; watermark behavior in rendered provider files is still unverified. Not affiliated with the original TikTok creators or music rights holders.
AI agents can read and post messages over HTTPS after fetching skill.md. msgboard is free and needs no account or API key.
Rumpelstiltskin AI turns photos into a 10-second tiptoe dance video with music and no watermark.

Bot Hunt is an independent discovery directory for Grok bots. Browse handpicked bots, their descriptions and linked community feedback to find useful AI teammates and follow setup links. Entries identify official Marketplace sources. Displayed heat includes labeled starting values, so it should not be represented as a count of verified users or real votes.

Youmiro is an all-in-one AI video and image workspace. Describe a scene or upload a reference photo, pick a model, and create text-to-video or image-to-video clips with optional native audio. Build longer stories shot by shot with reused character references, and use the AI Image Maker for text-to-image or reference-guided stills. Start free for music videos, product ads, social clips, and short films.

Image Text Editor is an online tool for editing text in finished images: posters, banner ads, menus, screenshots, product photos and YouTube thumbnails. Pick one text block, enter new words or remove it, review a before-and-after comparison, and download a flattened PNG.

Unblurfy uses AI to fix blurry, pixelated and low-resolution photos in your browser. Upload a photo, choose 1K or 2K, and compare the result with a before-and-after slider before you download. Free to try every day, with no watermark, and uploads are deleted after 24 hours.

Glide is an AI agent that takes on the legwork of your job search: finding roles worth your time, researching each company and drafting applications written for the person who will read them. You approve everything. Currently invite-only - join the waitlist on the site.

H3 Image is a web app for MiniMax H3 Image, the open-weight image model MiniMax released in November 2026. Write a prompt or upload photos to edit, get 2K or 4K pictures in about 20 seconds, and turn any picture into a MiniMax H3 video. New accounts get free credits to try it.
Share what you have. Remvora creates a life story, a film, and a place to remember someone you love. Public V1 preview with a fictional example; it does not accept orders.
Pettenderly turns photos of your cat or dog into AI portraits. Choose a watercolor, royal or studio look, then download your image.

Anxinzhuan is an offline speech-to-text application for Windows, macOS, Linux and Android. It transcribes audio and video locally with batch imports, automatic queuing, timestamps and speaker labels. Media and transcripts remain on the user’s device.

Tiny Desk AI Video is an AI band video generator built around a fixed performance template. You pick optional cast photos for each of the five slots - back left, back right, keys, lead and sax - and every spot without a photo falls back to its fixed dog character, so the tool works with no uploads at all.

Before generating you confirm the age, permission and acceptable-use declarations, then choose a format: 9:16 vertical for TikTok, Reels and Shorts, 1:1 square for social feeds, or 16:9 landscape for YouTube and wide-screen posts. Quality is 720p or 1080p. Credit cost is shown before you submit, and videos are stored for 30 days.

Five photos are supported, JPG, PNG or WebP up to 8 MB each. Celebrity and public-figure photos are not allowed.

Tiny Desk AI Video is an independent AI effects tool by One Hub All AI, not affiliated with NPR or its Tiny Desk concert series.
OpenLegion is an AI agent platform for SaaS: secure agents call your functions, with a workspace per customer, approvals, spending caps and receipts.

silo.host is an AI website builder where a website is described in plain words and the layout, design and content are rewritten while you watch. Hosting, pages and a blog are included. Every instruction is kept and can be undone, posts and pages live in a real database, and every site gets a free address on day one with an optional custom domain. A Claude MCP connector is also available.
MakeFont is an AI font generator: describe a style or upload handwriting, let AI draw the full character set, edit glyphs in your browser, and download a TTF.

Photo to Sticker turns portraits, pets and group photos into stickers. Create a free transparent PNG sticker with a white outline instantly in your browser, no account needed, or generate AI cartoon expression packs for WhatsApp, Telegram and Discord. Accounts include 3 free AI uses shared across all tools, with optional one-time USD 5.90 paid packs and no subscription.

Browse a multilingual browser arcade with original AI-assisted games and indie releases credited to their creators. The catalogue lets players filter by genre, device and language before launching a game.

TattooGenerator is an AI tattoo generator: describe an idea or upload a photo, pick a style and placement, and get original tattoo designs in about twenty seconds, plus print-ready stencils your artist can actually use. Features include a tattoo simulator to preview designs on your own skin photo, 12 tattoo fonts with instant preview, and a prompt generator. Free account with starter credits (free images are watermarked); paid credit packs from $4.90 and monthly plans from $8.90. Styles include fine line, blackwork, traditional and Japanese. Every design is drawn fresh from your description, so nobody else has the same tattoo.
Tarot Fortune Cards is a free online AI tarot reading. Ask about love, an ex, or a crush, draw three cards, and get a straight answer instead of vague hints.

Peeve is an AI customer support agent for SaaS teams. It answers questions from your docs, shows users where to click inside your product, takes actions like resetting a password or changing a plan, and hands off to your team when a human is needed. It works in your in-app widget and over email, and remembers each customer across conversations. Pricing is credit-based, with plans from $40/month and a 14-day free trial.

RobThumbnail is an AI thumbnail studio for Roblox creators. Describe the game moment you want and the AI generates a 16:9 (1920×1080 PNG) thumbnail ready to upload to Roblox Studio; 1:1 is also supported. Refine through conversation, upload an avatar reference, and iterate until it clicks. Free to try with 15 free AI credits renewed monthly; paid plans add 2K & 4K output and a commercial-use license.

Separates vocals and accompaniment, splits stems, and drafts an editable MIDI/MusicXML score that still needs manual correction. Available on Web, iPhone/iPad, and Android; the Mac app is coming soon and has no public installer yet. One 5-minute free preview per verified email on Web only; Android can preview the first 30 seconds free, then unlock with a one-time purchase. Web export is paid and billed by processing minutes. Does not generate guitar TAB, does not separate different singers, and does not identify timbre. Only use audio you have the right to process.

No Scrubs AI turns one to three consenting adult portraits into an approximately 16-second music dance video with sound. Choose a lead and up to two supporting cast members. The fixed sequence is delivered in 4:3 at 720p.

Generation requires an account and paid credits. Non-expiring one-time packs cost US$6.99 for 1 video, US$19.99 for 3, or US$29 for 5. No free generation credits or recurring subscription. Public examples and a how-to guide are available before purchase. Independent product, not affiliated with TLC.

Turn a prompt or still into a 5–15 second MiniMax H3 Max video. Choose 480P or 768P, review the result, and create your next take on H3 Max. Write one line or drop a single still frame. MiniMax H3 Max hands back a 5–15 second clip with the audio already synced — watch it, change a word, run the next take.
Zombie couple video maker: upload two photos, one turns into a grey-green zombie, the other holds their hand. 10s with sound, gore-free, no subscription.
Pet Portrait AI turns one photo of your dog or cat into a royal, Renaissance, watercolor or memorial portrait. Pet photos only.
Free kaomoji copy-and-paste library: 559 Japanese text faces in 13 categories, plus an optional AI generator.

NGIN360 is an AI agent team for business work. You describe an outcome, it writes a plan you can approve, hands each step to a specialist agent (development, marketing, research, design) and checks each result against stated criteria. It stops for a person before anything consequential, such as sending or publishing, and runs scheduled and event-triggered work across connected apps like Gmail, Google Calendar and GitHub. It is for people running a business or a small team who want agents to do the work while people keep the decisions. Free during early access.

TinyCommand is an all-in-one no-code automation platform for founders, operators and business teams. It connects forms, visual workflows, data tables, AI agents and email tools so teams can collect information, manage data and automate follow-up in one place. Forms can look up data and branch while people fill them in, and workflows connect business apps. TinyCommand offers a free plan and paid plans. AI agent steps run on every plan; building custom agents starts on Professional. TinySEO and TinyAnswers are paid tools with a seven-day trial on Free.

Healthcare staffing software for staffing agencies — scheduling, credentialing, float pool, workforce management and AI tools for healthcare staffing; founded 2024, San Francisco, CA, USA; contact Aditya Mangal, Healthcare - Digital Content Writer, hello@varshealth.com.

ValeKit is ticketless valet parking software that replaces paper tickets, walkie-talkies and end-of-shift cash counts. Attendants check cars in from a phone with AI plate, make and model recognition; guests get an SMS link to track and request their car with one tap. Payments, tips and discounts are captured digitally and reconciled automatically. ValeKit works offline and scales from one location to hundreds, for hotels, restaurants, hospitals, events and valet companies.

Built for agents, not HR software: your AI agent can run recognition, goals, reviews and surveys in Prixie. Prixie works with Slack, MCP, and Google and Microsoft sign-in, with HRIS and ATS integrations (Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, ADP, UKG, Greenhouse) on Team and Business plans. Prixie is employee recognition and performance management for teams that already work in Slack. Prixie Recognise covers daily recognition, rewards, and recognition analytics. Prixie Perform covers goals, review cycles, engagement surveys, continuous feedback, and 1:1 notes. Review cycles are available on Team and above.

Your AI agent can work in Prixie too. Connect your AI agent (Claude, ChatGPT) to the Prixie MCP server and sign in with your Prixie account. From there your agent can send a recognition, list goals you can see, open and submit reviews or surveys assigned to you, and check what is waiting in your inbox.

Live Face Swap is a browser-based real-time AI face swap workspace for independent creators. Choose a reference character, enable your camera, and create live face transformations for livestreams, video calls, OBS, and entertainment content.

PhotoLike turns 8-10 everyday selfies into realistic dating profile photos. The photos have natural light, real skin texture and believable places like coffee shops and rooftop bars, so they look like a friend took them on a good day. Use them on Hinge, Bumble, Tinder and other apps. Try one free preview photo first to check it works on your face, then get the full pack. No subscription and no photoshoot.
Hand-reviewed AI SaaS for work, sorted by what it does, what it costs and who it is for.

AI Face Swap Live swaps a single portrait onto a live webcam in the browser. It also offers anime, 3D and clay-style restyling and outfit try-on. Works in Chrome and Edge on Windows and Mac, and can be captured in OBS for livestreaming. New accounts get 60 seconds with a watermark; paid plans remove it.

Christmas AI is a browser-based holiday studio with eight tools for Christmas photos, printable cards, pet portraits, ugly sweaters, Santa hats, and personalized Santa videos. Upload a photo or choose a style, then download images or MP4 clips. New accounts get 10 free credits; one-time pay-as-you-go credit packs are available with no subscription.

AI Generator Hub is a browser-based SaaS for generative media. Video can start from a text prompt or from an uploaded image; the same account also generates images, music tracks and voice audio. Usage is credit-based across all generators. Free plan with 20 trial credits; Starter $9.9/month, Premium $29.99/month, Enterprise $49.99/month. English and Chinese UI.

MyAIRap.video turns personal photos and everyday stories into short Rap performances. Adults can create Solo, Duo or Pet videos, edit AI-drafted lyrics, choose a scene, Rap style and voice direction, and download the finished video. Available Style Remix and Character Swap templates show their required photos, soundtrack options and credit quote before submission. Results, including lip sync and movement, can vary. Browsing examples is free; generation requires an account and paid credits. One-time credit packs start at US$11.49, with no subscription. I am Leon Reed, the independent maker.

Image Layered is an AI decomposition tool that splits a flat poster, product photo or AI image into separate transparent layers, rebuilds covered backgrounds, and exports a layered PSD or PNG ZIP for Photoshop, Figma, Photopea or Affinity.

Quillora helps people starting affiliate sites choose content tools with free comparisons of costs, limitations and fit. Its homepage links directly to a free character and word counter: paste or type a sample to see characters including spaces, words and the characters-per-word ratio for that sample, with no sign-in. The counter processes sample text locally in browser memory rather than uploading or saving it. Clear the sample or leave the page to discard it. Counting methods and limitations are explained on the page. This is a sample text check, not AI generation or verified Rytr billing. Tool comparisons separate provider-reported facts from qualified suggestions and disclose affiliate relationships; Quillora may earn a commission through labeled affiliate links.
ClickPop is an AI video generator and AI video editor: text to video, AI UGC ads, character swap and faceless YouTube videos with cinematic VFX.

RainSleep is a browser-based app for sleep, relaxation and focus. Listen to rain and ambient sounds, set a sleep timer, or combine sounds in the mixer. Core listening and mixing features are free. An optional AI audio generator creates sleep music, bedtime stories and guided meditations using paid credits.

productName: Image to Image AI — Tancky AI
description: A different look does not have to start with a different photo. Tancky AI takes an uploaded image and a written request for changes to its style, backdrop or clothing. Its image-to-image workflow aims to retain the subject, faces, products and composition while applying the edit. The browser workspace also contains background removal, upscaling, old-photo restoration and compositing tools. No installation or GPU is needed, and both English and Chinese interfaces are available.
MuseMate is an AI music video generator for independent artists: upload a song for a beat-synced video, plus Spotify Canvas loops, album covers and press photos.

AI Room Design helps homeowners and renters visualize a room makeover before buying furniture or changing their layout. Upload a photo or describe a space, choose a style and specify what should stay, then compare and download design concepts. The room design tool can be tried without creating an account.

AI4MEME is a browser-based image-to-video studio that turns uploaded photos into short meme clips using published scene templates. Each scene displays its photo count, duration, aspect ratio and credit cost before generation. Users choose a scene and upload photos without a free-form prompt or editing timeline. Creations are private, with no public gallery. Failed generation jobs refund credits. JPEG, PNG and WebP uploads are supported up to 8 MB. The service is intended for photos of consenting adults, with credit-based plans and one-time packs listed on its official pricing page.
Dizy publishes weekly AI music charts ranked by listener votes. Listen, vote and submit tracks for free across a Top 40, Top 100 and 34 genre charts.

Imanuve combines text-to-image generation, a visual prompt library, and a browser-based background remover. Browse examples for product photos, social posts, and posters, then adapt a prompt in the studio. Image generation uses an account and credits. Background removal runs in the browser and lets you download a transparent PNG for free without an account.

Nuzza AI is a photo-to-video platform that turns your photos into AI videos. Choose a trending effect (dance, music, meme and social video trends), upload a photo and create your own video for TikTok, Instagram Reels or YouTube Shorts, with no prompt writing needed.
For custom work, Nuzza AI Studio gives access to leading video and image models including Seedance, Kling, Google Veo, Hailuo, Wan, Flux and Nano Banana. Brands can turn product photos into ads, UGC-style videos and launch promos.
It also includes AI video tools (upscaler, extender, enhancer, background remover, reframe) and image tools (upscaler, background remover, inpaint, uncrop, object/text remover). Sign up free with welcome credits; credit packs and subscriptions are available when you need more.
Admirers creates AI videos from a photo or short clip and a voice sample. Type a script to generate a video in your cloned voice, with support for 44 languages. Offers a free one-minute trial.

CareHub is a customer communications platform from Kazakhstan. It brings WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram and website chat into a shared workspace for sales and support teams. Teams can manage conversations, use AI agents, send broadcasts, build automations and track communication analytics. CareHub supports WhatsApp Business API and WhatsApp QR connections. A free trial is available.

Create and preview a personal birthday website in your browser with a letter, photos, optional music, countdown, and PIN. Official one-time price is US$9.99. Paid publishing is not enabled yet. Not an AI writer.
Unofficial fan-made free browser urban life simulator. Not an official Project Moon game. The base game is free and unlimited; optional AI is a separate one-time $10 unlock. Ages 15+.

OpenFirmList helps buyers find suppliers and sellers discover potential customers through a global B2B company search index. Search by product, sector and location, or connect an AI agent through the search API.

Audio to Video AI turns sound (speech, music, or sound effects) into video. You can optionally add a picture or describe the scene. Features include Audio to short video (5–10s, MP4 1080p), Talking Photo (photo or character plus a voice recording), and Music Video (song plus a performer photo, up to about 10 minutes, 480p/720p, 16:9 or 9:16). Examples can be previewed free. Generation uses credits. A watermarked download is available; paid credit top-ups unlock watermark-free downloads.

BlockPoster.ai is a browser-based block poster maker that turns one image into a wall-sized poster printed across standard sheets on your home printer. Upload a photo or create artwork with AI, crop it, choose from five paper sizes and the page grid, preview the layout, and download a PDF with an assembly guide and predictable page order. Free PDFs need no account (up to 150 DPI, up to 5 sheets across, small watermark). Paid plans add unlimited HD, watermark-free PDFs up to 300 DPI, up to 10 sheets across, batch ZIP export and AI credits. Ordinary uploads are processed locally.

VibePico is an AI family photo generator for families who are never all in the same place at once. Add a separate photo of each person or pet, choose a scene such as a cozy Christmas living room, a golden-hour beach or a classic studio backdrop, and VibePico builds one portrait in which everyone keeps their own face. Extra tools cover multi-generational portraits, couple photos, pet portraits, memorial family photos, a Christmas card maker with printable 4x6 and 5x7 layouts, an age filter, photo-to-coloring-page and a short animate-a-photo clip. New accounts get 10 credits for one watermarked preview; credit packs and subscriptions start at $9.99.

Already trusted by 4K+ businesses. Ody Ai Business Phone combines a shared team workspace on one business number with highly manageable AI agents. Rare to get both. Native iOS and Android (+ web). AI calls inbound and outbound, AI texting, AI voice-to-text, link tracking, plus REST API, SDKs, MCP, and Switchboard. 7-day free trial.

AI Video Expand is a video outpainting tool: upload an MP4 or MOV of up to 60 seconds, choose 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:5 or 5:4, and the AI paints the missing edges around your untouched original. You get a 720p or 1080p MP4 with the original sound and no watermark. Paid per clip, no subscription.

Fancy Cafe AI is a browser tool for making your own version of the TikTok trend "POV: your first time in a fancy cafe". Upload one photo of yourself, a friend or a pet, optionally add a second photo for the guest, and get a 10 to 15 second vertical MP4 with sound, up to 720p and no watermark, usually within minutes. Made for TikTok, Reels and Shorts creators; no prompts, no app and no account needed for one video. Videos start at $3.99.

AI Dance Trend makes a 10-second vertical dance video from a single photo of you or your pet. Pick a viral dance trend such as the Rumpelstiltskin tiptoe dance, Raindance AI or the pet dance, upload one clear photo and get an MP4 with original music and no watermark, ready for TikTok, Reels or Shorts. No app and no subscription: pay once from $9.90. Photos are deleted automatically.

Hokio gives local applications stable public HTTPS links for webhooks, demos, automations, and AI workflows on Windows and Linux. Install the native connector, sign in, choose a local port, and keep the assigned link through connector restarts.

Who Are You is a free, open-source page that shows what any website can infer about you without a login or a permission prompt: your exit IP and ASN, whether that matches your timezone and language, WebRTC and DNS leak signals, a browser fingerprint (canvas, WebGL, fonts, screen), and the mismatches that often give away a VPN or proxy. Checks run in the browser; the page does not keep your IP or full fingerprint, and anonymous counts can be turned off. I'm Yang, the author. Source (MIT): https://github.com/yt1988/who-are-you. I used AI assistance while building it.

Solari provides cloud browsers, isolated code sandboxes and full Linux desktops for developers building AI agents. Agents can browse websites, run code and control desktop applications through one API. Use Playwright or a CDP client for browsers, SDKs for sandboxes and desktops, or the Solari MCP server. Persistent browser profiles, session replays, snapshots and forks support longer-running automation. A free plan is available for prototyping, with paid plans for production workloads. Documentation: https://docs.getsolari.com/ . Benchmarks: https://getsolari.com/benchmarks .

ComicStory AI turns a written story and one character photo into a print-ready comic book. Paste a script, upload one reference photo of the main character, and the tool lays out pages, draws every panel and places speech bubbles. Unlike other AI image tools that redraw the character each panel, it locks one reference across the whole project so the face, hair and outfit stay consistent from page one to the last page. Twelve art styles, editable layouts, print-ready PDF export and a shareable web reader. Fifty free credits on sign-up.

LLMBrake is an open-source (MIT) TypeScript library that puts a monthly USD budget on each customer of an AI app. It runs in-process with no proxy. Past a threshold it switches to cheaper models, and at the limit it blocks the call before it reaches the provider. Install with npm install llmbrake.
Free food picker: answer a few quick questions and a cat mascot picks 3 dishes from real places near you. No sign-up, English and Chinese.
Simulated audiences of your customers and market, grounded in real interview and survey data. Test pricing, product, creative and UI decisions before you spend, and follow up with live AI interviews.

Submitted by an owner-authorized AI assistant. FujinAI provides free Shopify image tools for resizing, compressing, cropping and converting product photos. Merchants can prepare product imagery through an independent website. Optional AI product-scene and white-background generation require paid credits; the ordinary free image tools are not AI generation, and no free AI trial is claimed. This is not an official Shopify product, verified Shopify app, or proven store integration. Source and tool example: https://www.fujindeai.com/tools/resize-image . No revenue or conversion improvement is promised.

Auzmor Learn is a corporate LMS with a built-in learning experience platform. Build courses in minutes or let ARIA, Auzmor’s AI assistant, draft them from documents. Combine courses and live events into learning paths, assign training by team, track compliance with due dates, certificates and e-signatures, and run mentorship and on-the-job training. Includes up to 30K ready-made courses, 50+ integrations, mobile apps, cloud or on-premise. Security and compliance: SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, CMMC, ISO 27001 and GDPR.

Image to 3D Model turns a photo or illustration into a 3D model in the browser. Sign in for 20 welcome credits (one Trellis model). Export GLB for editing or STL for slicing. A multi-view workspace accepts 2–8 photos of the same object. Built for game assets, prototypes, and concept art.

Xun Qiao is a free research workspace for cryptocurrency and U.S. stocks. It lines up news headlines with related market context, so a story, the affected assets and the price picture can be reviewed in one workflow.

The public homepage can be browsed without an account. A free account unlocks the news reader, workbench, markets and published AI research. It covers 1,200+ sources, is available in English and Chinese, and does not execute trades.

Optional Gold membership adds GPT conversations and a developer API, and a Premium subscription includes a paid read-only news API. The core research workflow stays free.

Website: https://xunqiao.qq10.fun/
GitHub: https://github.com/xunqiao111/xunqiao-market-intelligence

A paid photo-to-video tool that places a person's photo into original Sheru Bhai lion-story scene templates and renders a short 9:16 video. Each video uses 100 paid credits; completed files last 30 days. The current public FAQ describes the output as an approximately six-second 1080p silent video.

FullCastBook turns a manuscript into an AI audiobook with a full cast. Upload an EPUB, PDF, DOCX, TXT or Markdown file, or paste a chapter, and it finds the chapters, works out who is speaking in each line and gives every character a distinct voice alongside an AI narrator. Swap any voice from a library of standard and premium voices (built on Gemini and ElevenLabs voice models), and keep the same cast across a series.

Direct any line in plain English by adding a note in brackets, such as [whisper, like sharing a secret], and drop sound tags like [laugh], [sigh] or [breathe] exactly where they belong. Regenerate a single line without redoing the chapter, then export the finished audiobook as one M4B with chapter markers, MP3 files or a ZIP. It also works for two-voice podcasts and dialogue, audio drama, bedtime stories and book trailers.

Signing up is free with no card, but there are no free credits: audio is paid with credits from a plan (from $9.90 a month) or a one-time top-up, and cost depends on how much text is voiced. You can publish exported files wherever you hold the rights to the text; store policies on AI narration vary, and Audible and ACX do not currently accept AI-narrated audiobooks. English works best today, scanned page images are not supported, and voice cloning is not available yet.

For indie and self-published authors, web novel and LitRPG writers, fiction podcasters and audio drama makers, YouTube storytellers, and teachers making classroom read-alouds.
Musely is an all-in-one AI creative platform that transforms simple prompts into images, music, voiceovers, and written content through intelligent tool selection and streamlined workflows.

SparkMeld is an AI video and image generator. Start with a text prompt or a reference image, choose a model and an aspect ratio, and generate in a workspace. Results are saved privately. The workspace shows each model's credit cost and deducts credits when a job is submitted.
Drop a photo, screenshot, or PDF — get copyable text in seconds. Free, no signup needed.

PawLine is an empathetic AI assistant guiding pet owners through animal health, first aid and behavior questions across species - dogs, cats, birds, reptiles, horses and more. Answers are shaped to each pet's profile, and a Places feature finds nearby vets, parks and pet services. PawLine complements, never replaces, your veterinarian, and says plainly when a clinic visit is the right call. On iOS, Android and web. Plans: Weekly $3.99, Monthly $9.99, Yearly $99.99 USD.

Questry AI is a Dutch AI SDR for B2B companies that sell to the Dutch market. You describe your ideal customer; we start from the official Dutch business register, find every company that fits and, at each company, the person who decides. Each company gets a file with what we know about it and a personal first email, sent from separate sending domains that we set up and warm up for 14 days, so your own domain stays out of it. No reply? We follow up. When someone replies, we answer and propose a time, and the meeting lands in your calendar. You lead the sales conversation. Questry AI connects with Gmail, Outlook, Google Calendar, Microsoft Teams and Slack. Plans: Start €299, Groei €649 and Schaal €995 per month, excluding VAT, no setup fee. Built in Amsterdam by co-founders Luuk van de Ven and Mats Driessen.

Kinjar is a household ledger for couples who plan money together. Split your income into envelopes by percentage, invite your partner to the same ledger, and let the AI read receipts and bank statements so nobody types transactions by hand. No bank login needed. Web app that installs on your phone. 27 currencies, English and Romanian, 30-day free trial without a card.

Agent Barn is an open-source (Apache-2.0) control plane for AI agents. Your team talks to agents in Slack, Teams, Telegram, Discord or email, agents work across Jira, GitHub, Confluence and more, and every conversation, tool call, log and cost is recorded. It runs agent runtimes like Hermes and OpenClaw on your own Kubernetes cluster, deployed with Helm.

StarAlly is your AI-powered personal assistant designed to take care of everyday tasks and simplify your life. From booking restaurant tables and travel arrangements to managing shopping, subscriptions, bills, returns, and reminders, StarAlly handles the tasks that take up your valuable time.

Simply communicate with StarAlly through text or a call using natural language. It finds suitable options, compares prices, completes bookings, places orders, manages requests, and follows up on tasks through the provider's own websites.

With a user-controlled approval process, StarAlly ensures that no booking, payment, or important action is completed without your explicit confirmation. Your sensitive information is protected in a secure vault, and every action is recorded for transparency.

Whether you need to organize your schedule, plan a trip, manage subscriptions, or take care of daily errands, StarAlly acts as your personal AI companion, helping you get things done without the hassle of managing everything yourself.

PT Practice Pro is an AI-powered physical therapy practice management and EMR software designed for physical therapy, occupational therapy, and speech-language pathology practices in the United States. The platform helps healthcare providers streamline clinical documentation, scheduling, billing, revenue cycle management, patient engagement, home exercise programs, and practice operations through an integrated solution. PT Practice Pro supports clinics in improving workflow efficiency, managing patient records, and simplifying everyday administrative tasks.
Estate Render helps architects and interior designers visualize interior, exterior and furniture ideas with AI.
Turn one photo of yourself into a brand-new AI-generated charme dance video. Consent-first, private by design, no editing skills needed.

Vozelle is an easy-to-use AI voice changer for Android and iOS, built to send modified voice messages directly inside your favorite chat apps. Its standout floating overlay widget keeps voice controls on top of your screen. You can turn voice effects on or off and switch saved voice profiles anytime, without leaving your ongoing chat. When you record a voice note in supported apps, Vozelle processes your microphone input with AI in real time and sends the transformed voice normally. There is no need to record, export and manually share audio files separately.
Vozelle works with popular social platforms including WhatsApp, Snapchat and Instagram on both Android and iOS. Discord support is available for Android users only. This wide compatibility lets you keep chatting in the communities you already use, instead of switching to a new app just for voice changing. The app offers a rich collection of ready-made voice presets with different tones and characters. You can pick a preset quickly and fine-tune pitch and timbre to craft a voice that matches your preferred style.
A free trial is available so you can test core features before paying. During the trial, you can try the floating widget, experiment with different voices and send transformed voice notes on supported platforms to check the audio quality and stability. Designed mainly for casual voice messages rather than professional audio production, Vozelle keeps the workflow simple. Just open your chat app, select a voice via the floating widget, record your message and send it.
It fits many daily social scenarios: playful chats with friends, trying new vocal identities, and gaining more confidence when sending voice messages. No audio editing skills are required. Whether you use WhatsApp groups, Instagram DMs, Snapchat or Android Discord, the floating widget puts voice-changing controls one tap away. Vozelle makes creative voice messaging convenient and accessible for everyday social use.

Turn one photo and a one-line topic into a rap video. AI creates the lyrics, beat and vocals, bringing your chosen scene to life in a complete performance. One-time credit packs never expire: $1.99/100 credits/1 video, $4.99/400 credits/4 videos, and $9.99/1,000 credits/10 videos. Login required; no free pack listed.

mytype fyi is a browser-based face preference quiz for adults. Pick the fictional AI-generated portraits that catch your eye across 20 groups. Choose the men’s or women’s portrait group, undo a choice, or skip a group. You can start without an account or uploading a photo. Sign in to see a free basic result with the styles you picked most often and example portraits. An optional detailed report is available.

Street Fight Game is an unofficial fan site for Street Fighter II: Champion Edition on Android. It offers a 12.5 MB APK for 64-bit ARM phones (no iPhone or iPad version), single-player matches against the computer, and guides for all 12 fighters: special-move inputs, simple combos, bonus stages and touch-control tips. It is a game, not a SaaS or AI product. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Capcom.

Veronica Hub is an independent AI, productivity and developer tools directory. Discover and compare AI tools by price and data handling, so you can find the right tool for your work. It is free to use.
Free AI photo enhancer and image editor.
3,000+ AI apps navigation hub: discover AI tools by category.
AI tools directory ranked by verified traffic, not paid placement.

openduet.net is an independently operated guide to openduet, an open-source AI agent workspace you self-host. It explains how to organize named agents, connect a compatible engine, and review work as it develops. The site helps you understand openduet before you deploy it, including workflows, where data goes, approvals, routines, and deployment limits. It is based on the open-source project at github.com/Anil-matcha/open-duet and does not claim endorsement by the upstream maintainers or any model provider. The public site is a guide, not a live hosted workspace for visitors.
AI Photoshoot Generator: turn selfies into professional AI headshots and portraits.

Kling AI is Kuaishou’s official creative platform for generating and editing images and videos, including text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-guided workflows, and motion control. The Global site is kling.ai; the China-region site is klingai.com. Models, availability, credits, and billing vary by region and plan; check the official site before generating.

Holofy is the real estate platform built for the agentic era. Add the free, no-sign-in Holofy connector to Claude, ChatGPT or Grok to search homes to rent or buy, with agency video tours and official area data. For agencies: phone-filmed video tours and lead capture that show up inside AI search.

REA.ai is an AI-powered real estate business phone system designed for agents, brokers, and real estate teams. It answers incoming property calls 24/7, responds to listing questions, captures buyer and renter leads, and helps schedule property showings.

With dedicated listing phone numbers and a built-in CRM, REA.ai helps agents organize inquiries, manage contacts, and follow up with potential clients.

Whether you're showing homes, meeting clients, or working after hours, REA.ai helps ensure valuable property inquiries don't go unanswered.
Plan lessons and units for the New Zealand Curriculum and NCEA. Heapso also creates worksheets, slides and quizzes that teachers can edit and export. Free and paid plans are available.

Source-linked knowledge base of European startup funding: open EU calls, grants, venture capital funds and innovation hubs, each linked to its official source, plus a free MCP server so Claude, ChatGPT or Grok can search it.

PNGDock helps you convert SVG and PNG files, compress images, prepare batches of product photos, and extract text from PNG images into DOCX. Most tools process files locally in your browser without an account. AI background removal sends an image to a server only when you choose to run it.

AskSolique supports Indian tax and legal professionals with cited research, document analysis and drafting. It covers income tax, GST, FEMA, SEBI, customs and corporate law. Designed for CA firms, tax practitioners, legal advisers and finance teams, it provides a starting point for professional review. Paid credit plans and a limited free trial are available.

Movifo animates a still photo using preset zoom and pan movements. A limited free 3-second, 360p preview is available without an account. Paid 10-second exports come without a watermark and start at $6.99 per video.

Image Lark is the world's best reasoning image engine powered by Gemini 3.0. Image Lark creates photorealistic 4K visuals with prompt adherence and fastest speed. Image Lark is designed for professional creators.

Vidcio is a multi-model AI video generation platform for creating videos from text prompts, images, or reference clips. One workspace and a unified credit balance cover multiple video models. New users can start with free credits, with paid plans and one-time credit packs available. Operated by Vidcio Team and not affiliated with model vendors.
FreeAIVoiceGenerator is a free AI voice generator: create natural AI voice messages from text with preset voices, language and speed controls. Free short previews; MP3 download after login.
Playyy is an AI design canvas for marketers and small teams. Split flat campaign graphics into editable text and image layers, update the copy or replace imagery, and export the revised visual.

Vectobox is a collection of 38 online tools and calculators in six categories: Developer, Finance, Image, AI, Life and Random. Format JSON, test a regex, decode a JWT, build an amortization schedule, work out compound interest, compress an image to a target size, make a QR code or convert units. There are no accounts, and what you type or upload is processed in your browser. Every tool comes with a written guide and FAQ, and the site is available in English and Chinese.

Nebulaa is an AI marketing platform that plans, creates, approves, publishes and learns from your brand's marketing—all in one place. It builds a Brand Growth Blueprint and 90-day marketing plan, creates on-brand posts, carousels and short videos, publishes to connected social channels, and adds inbox replies, competitor insights and analytics. Built for founders, small businesses, marketing teams and agencies.

OppBeacon checks every new SAM.gov contract notice each morning and sends small federal contractors the ones they can actually bid on: plain-English title, who can bid, due date and stated value, plus an AI bid/no-bid cited to the solicitation's pages.

NoNetPlay is an iPhone app for live simultaneous interpretation and offline AI chat. After downloading its local models, translation works offline—even in airplane mode—with speech and text staying on the device.

ImgRedo is an AI image-to-image generator that restyles photos from a text prompt, a style, or a selected area. It also offers free image conversion and resizing tools, with no account needed to start.

Manga Translator is a browser-based tool for reading comics that have not been translated yet. Upload JPG, PNG or WEBP pages of manga, manhwa, webtoons or manhua, choose a target language, and each page comes back with the original text erased by inpainting and the translation lettered into the speech bubbles, captions and narration boxes in a comic font. The whole page is translated in one context so character names stay consistent, and vertical Japanese and furigana are handled. It reads Japanese, Korean and Chinese and writes English plus 50+ other languages. Upload a chapter and download it as a ZIP. Free to try without an account; optional one-time credit packs, with no subscription. Uploaded pages are not stored and never used for training.

RAADS-R Test is a web self-check inspired by the 80-statement RAADS-R for adults and older teens aged 16+. It provides an instant total score and four domain scores for free, without requiring an account. This is a screening and self-reflection tool, not a diagnosis; a score cannot diagnose or rule out autism. It is not for diagnosing children. The basic assessment is free; optional paid reports are available. The questionnaire itself is not an AI diagnostic tool.

BodyScore is a Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) constitution self-test. Answer 60 questions in about 8–10 minutes and receive a free main result about your constitution type, for general wellness awareness. Optional extras: an AI report for $19.90 or a human-verified report for $29.90. It is a self-assessment tool, not a medical diagnosis or treatment.
The AI video editing and clipping tool that turns one long video into a week of social-ready clips.

RiseMore is your AI marketer, with four agents for SEO, GEO, Reddit, and Social. It learns your business, products, services, audience, and voice, then finds relevant opportunities and creates content you can review and publish.

The SEO Agent researches keywords and writes articles for your connected website. The GEO Agent researches buyer questions and monitors mentions and citations in AI answers. The Reddit Agent finds relevant communities and threads and prepares posts or comments. The Social Agent creates illustrated posts for X and LinkedIn, with a review workflow and account-specific publishing schedules.

Research and drafts remain editable, and you approve what goes live. SEO and Social publish to your connected destinations; GEO and Reddit publishing is handled on your behalf. RiseMore serves business owners and marketing teams, including software businesses, e-commerce brands, and service businesses. A limited Free plan is available; optional top-ups and managed publishing fees are separate.

Visibility Audit Co. checks how ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews describe and recommend a local business, then returns a ranked list of fixes. There is a free site check at https://visibilityaudit.co/check/. The paid Snapshot runs customer-style questions and emails a PDF of whether the business was named.

Bgbye removes image backgrounds in seconds. Upload PNG/JPG/WebP/AVIF (max 19MB), preview the cutout (including hair/edges), then download a transparent PNG or keep editing with a new background, text, or crop. Built for product photos, portraits, and social creatives.

Dime Dime Baby AI turns one authorized adult portrait into an approximately 8-second video in a fixed party scene. Download a 4:3 MP4 in 480p or 720p. One-time credit packs start at $4.99; there is no free preview or subscription. This is an independent third-party tool, not affiliated with the artist or social platforms. No commercial music license is included; users are responsible for music rights. Do not upload images of children, public figures, or people without permission.

Image Studio is a credit-based web app for text-to-image generation and AI photo editing. Type a prompt to get a no-watermark, high-resolution image in about 30 seconds, with six size presets and custom sizes from 1024 to 4096 pixels, plus poster, holiday-card, and editor tools. It markets itself as an independent alternative to Bing Image Creator and is not affiliated with Microsoft or Bing.

RapAI (rapai.video) is an AI rap video generator that turns photos into a 15-second 720p rap video with no watermark, ready for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts. Users can let AI write the lyrics for free, paste their own verse, or use a song they already have, and can star in the video alone or add a friend's photo for a duo. The site offers Quick Video and Custom Rap paths. One full 15-second 720p video costs 10 credits (2 for the song and 8 for the video). Official pricing includes one-time credit packs that never expire and monthly or yearly plans; failed steps are refunded. The site states guests can write 1 lyric draft a day, signed-in members 3, and plans 20 to 200.

Flying Broom AI (flyingbroomai.com) is an AI video generator that turns one photo into a short broomstick-flight video. Users add a clear photo of one person or pet (JPG, PNG, or WebP, up to 10 MB), choose a prepared scene, and review its duration and 10-credit cost before creating. Homepage examples include Street flight (6 seconds, 720p), Beside the car (6 seconds, 720p), and Police stop (11 seconds, 720p). After creation, the video can be watched and downloaded as an MP4. Official pricing is one-time USD credit packs; credits never expire, and failed renders are refunded in credits. Sign-in is required to use credits and create a video.

Hit the Road Dude AI (hittheroaddudeai.video) is an AI video generator for the "Hit the Road Dude" private-property meme. Users choose a setting, upload a character photo they own or have permission to use, and create an 11-second 720p video that keeps the attitude and original English audio. Scene options on the homepage include keeping the reference scene, Classic pickup, Block-world boat, Moon-base rover, and Fantasy castle gate. Each video uses 10 credits. The official pricing page lists one-time USD credit packs; credits never expire, and failed renders are refunded in credits. Watching the example and previewing a photo does not require an account; creating a video and buying credits requires sign-in.

Ozil AI (ozilai.app) is an AI football goal video generator. Users upload a JPG, PNG, or WebP photo up to 10 MB and become the scorer in a famous goal sequence, then preview and download a vertical 9:16 720p MP4. The shorter format is 5 seconds at 720p for 5 credits; the standard clip is 15 seconds at 720p, 24 fps, for 10 credits. Official pricing is one-time USD credit packs, and credits never expire. Sign-in is required to check the balance, buy a pack, and create a video.

Nano Banana is an AI image generation and editing platform with Nano Banana 2.1 and 40+ image/video models—text to image, photo editing, and video—in one generator. nanobanana0.com lets you type a prompt or drop in a photo to create and edit images with models from Google, OpenAI, ByteDance, Kling, and more. Failed outputs are refunded; commercial use is supported on paid plans. Not affiliated with Google.

YuE2 Music is an AI music studio that lets you inspect and edit a symbolic score before synthesizing audio. Exports include ABC, MIDI note tracks, MusicXML and FLAC. Pricing is freemium: 20 signup credits, valid 7 days; paid credit packs and optional subscriptions. There are no separated audio stems.
ProductViews is an AI ecommerce visual studio that generates additional camera angles, batch SKU-normalized assets, and 10-second video ads from a single product photo.
ZekaChat is an AI chat assistant with Turkish, Persian and English language choices for writing, coding and learning. A no-signup mode is available.
SCAIL-2 is an AI character motion-control studio that transfers movement from a reference video to one or more character images, with virtual camera controls and a template library.

ImageToVector traces PNG, JPG or WebP logos, icons, line art and illustrations into editable SVG in the browser. Three conversions a day are available without an account, up to 2000 px. Photographs and soft gradients are a poor fit. This is a tracer, not a generative AI vectorizer.

Use a vacant-home photograph to give an invented Santa visit a recognizable setting. Santa in House turns the picture into eight seconds of landscape video with sound or into one still image, choosing among porch-door, yard-facing-house and room night-vision looks. Standard output is 480p and HD is 720p. The smallest credit purchase is $1.99 for a photo; Standard video starts at $5.99. Balances remain valid without a renewal, and the site states that photos are removed within a day.

PDF Quiz Desk helps teachers, tutors and trainers turn a text-based PDF (handouts, readings, textbook chapters) into an editable quiz draft. Choose a page range in the file's page order (not printed textbook labels), pick a template (Quick check, Chapter test, Reading comprehension, Vocabulary check, Exit ticket, or Training knowledge check), set Easy/Medium/Hard difficulty, and choose Single choice, Multiple select, True/False and Short answer questions. Review quoted source evidence, edit the draft, then export a student worksheet (questions only) and a separate teacher answer key as PDF or Word, Letter or A4. It does not collect student responses or issue certifications. AI-generated answers need teacher review before use. Upload only materials you are authorized to use. Freemium: 2 free trials, 5 questions each, no sign-in required.

productName: Redvers Digital — Agent Skill Packs Starter Bundle

The pack covers PR Reviewer (verdict-first reviews), Email Triage (Today / This week / Waiting / Noise), Meeting → Actions (owners and deadlines, no invented assignees), Debugging (reproduce → isolate → fix → verify), and Landing Page Copy (hero, sections, and CTAs from a real offer). One-time purchase, early bird HK$229, with email delivery after Stripe checkout.

Lorem Picsum is a free random image generator and API. Choose a size, preview the crop, then copy a link or download a CC0 photo in JPEG or WebP—no sign-in or key. Independently operated and inspired by the open-source Picsum Photos project, with its own photo collection and IDs. AI image/video tools are freemium with one-time packs from $9.9, no subscriptions.

ImgLoop is an online AI photo editor. Upload a photo, describe an edit or restoration, check the credit cost, and compare the result with your source. Local canvas tools (crop, rotate, brush, eraser, text) use no credits. Freemium: guest credits and daily sign-in rewards; monthly plans from $14.99; one-time credit packs from $4.99.

AI Rap Video is an online AI rap video generator that turns photos of two people or pets into a rap performance with music and synced vocals. Start with a photo together or two individual portraits. Upload your own background or choose a preset scene. Let AI create a surprise rap, share an idea to guide the performance, or add your own lyrics. Choose your video length, quality, and aspect ratio, then generate and preview the result. Finished videos are saved to My Videos and can be downloaded as watermark-free MP4 files to share. Create personalized birthday raps, videos with friends, and short clips for social media without writing a detailed prompt. AI Rap Video uses one-time credit packs starting at $8.99 with no subscription. Credit usage depends on video length and quality, and the total is shown before generation.

Stela Writing Studio brings manuscripts, novels, and screenplays into one desktop app for Windows and macOS. Organize chapters and scenes, keep planning beside the draft, compile DOCX or book PDFs, and use Fountain, FDX, and paginated screenplay PDF workflows.

Drafts stay in local files with autosave, crash recovery, and save points. The optional Writing Assistant supports your own Gemini, OpenAI, or Anthropic API key, and you review suggested edits. A bundled opt-in local MCP server lets compatible agents work in approved writing workspaces with read-only or write permissions that can be paused or revoked. Stela must be running.

Free during beta; optional AI provider or agent-service charges may apply.

Loreform is a mini maker for D&D, Pathfinder and Warhammer players. Type a description or upload a reference image, refine the result with AI edits, and export STL files prepared for FDM and resin printers with pre-built supports. Plans from $19.99/mo; new accounts get 20 starter credits for 7 days.

Newly Startup is a discovery and launch directory for new SaaS products, startups, AI tools and websites. Visitors can browse recently launched digital products by category, and founders can submit their own product for review and possible inclusion.

Keep sensitive information out of your AI conversations. Locke detects and masks private data on your device before it reaches supported AI tools, across browser, desktop and terminal workflows. Keep using the tools you already rely on, with your sensitive details protected before you hit send.

Spreadsheet to App turns Excel, CSV, or Google Sheets into hosted web apps with AI. Describe your workflow in plain language, refine the generated interface in Studio, inspect the code, test a private preview, and publish. Business records stay in Google Sheets. Uploaded files are imported into Google Sheets in your account; existing sheets connect directly. Use it for inventory tracking, customer lists, dashboards, and internal tools.

Heel & Home is a UK dog-services directory and practical dog-care resource. Its web platform helps owners find relevant local providers, browse activities and local guides, use dog-day tools and save useful information. Directory browsing and the published guidance are free to access. Services and products are supplied and priced by the listed providers or retailers. Heel & Home is an online directory and resource, not a trainer, groomer or veterinary practice. It is operated by Flying Penguin AI Limited.

ZapVid lets you pick a trending AI video template, upload your photo, and generate a playful AI video featuring yourself. The service is paid: buy credit packs or choose a monthly plan. See https://zapvid.ai/pricing.

Valmera is an AI video editor for creators editing their own footage. Describe the cut you want, review the preview, ask for a change and export the finished MP4. Work in Valmera Studio or connect a compatible AI assistant through MCP.

Images26 (images26.org) is an independent GPT Image 2.6 workspace, not affiliated with OpenAI, for text-to-image and image editing with the Flare and Sunburst model variants. Describe a prompt to create, or choose Edit an image and upload up to four PNG, JPEG, or WebP references to describe the changes. Every plan includes generation, reference editing, transparent backgrounds, and PNG plus WebP downloads. Credit cost depends on the model, image size and quality; the quote is shown before you create, and confirmed failed generations return the credits charged (not an automatic cash refund). One-time credit packs stay valid for 365 days (Starter 350 credits at $29.90, then Creator, Studio, Max, and Agency). Monthly and yearly subscriptions issue a monthly allowance that does not roll over; annual plans charge the year upfront and can save up to 50% versus monthly billing, with the largest stated saving on the Pro plan at 600 credits per month for $174 per year. Welcome credits, if any, depend on current account settings. Only upload images you have permission to use, and review outputs before publishing. Directory listings: Free, support@images26.org.

Giant Cat AI turns one clear cat photo into a 10-second video of your cat towering over a New York street. No prompt is required: upload a photo, preview it, and use the preset scene. Download the finished clip as a 720p vertical MP4 (9:16). The public sample was generated with Kling 4.0. You can watch it for free; generating a video uses one-time credit packs starting at $9.90, with no subscription.

Band Score Checker is an IELTS writing checker that gives practice answers an AI band score on all four criteria in under a minute. Paste a Task 2 essay, a General Training letter or an Academic Task 1 report, then see what cost you marks, revise and check again. Band scores and the 3 most serious corrections are free. AI feedback for practice; not affiliated with IELTS, the British Council, IDP or Cambridge.

Curio is a macOS app for reading PDFs, websites and YouTube videos with adjustable AI summaries, links back to the source and follow-up questions. The free plan includes 50 successfully summarized sources per month. Lite is US$4.99/month for unlimited sources. Users connect their own AI provider; provider subscriptions or API charges are separate. Submitted on behalf of Curio by Yun.

List Of Books is a free lookup tool for the reading order of any book series and the full bibliography of any author. Search 15,000+ authors, 60,000+ series and 500,000+ books. It also offers a free REST API with an OpenAPI 3.1 description and a free remote MCP server, so AI assistants and apps can look up series order instead of guessing.

Trakey Flow brings assigned tasks, checklists, Kanban boards, group chat and shared files into one workspace for teams, entrepreneurs and families. Turn messages into tasks, share selected tasks with external collaborators using roles, and use an integrated AI assistant in Spanish. Free trial without a credit card, followed by paid subscriptions.

LemmiLink helps small businesses, agencies and publishers buy and sell backlinks in one place. You choose guest posts, homepage links or links placed on existing pages that already rank, using Haloscan data built into the platform. Copywriting and indexing are included; a link that does not get indexed is replaced, and an order that is not published is refunded to your wallet. Its free AI chat (no account needed) compares the sites linking to you with those linking to your competitors, using real SEObserver and Haloscan data, and lists the links you are missing in about two minutes. An official MCP server lets Claude Desktop and Claude Code search the catalogue, suggest anchors and prepare an order plan in natural language.

CyberJobs.cc is a free job board for cybersecurity work. It reads the hiring systems of about 650 employers every hour and lists only security roles, about 2,900 open today: security engineering, SOC and incident response, cloud and application security, identity, penetration testing, threat intelligence, GRC, architecture and leadership. Every role shows the salary its posting states and links to the employer's own application. It also publishes salary pages for each specialty, the certifications postings ask for, career guides, a free job feed and JSON API, and an MCP server for AI assistants. Job seekers never pay.

Food affordability puts pressure on families and neighbourhood restaurants. MigMig co-founder Shayan Erfanian believes restaurant technology should help operators build lasting customer relationships rather than rely only on repeated spending to win attention.

MigMig is a Canadian restaurant-technology and food-ordering business. Its team pooled personal funds to build an integrated platform for online ordering, customer loyalty and restaurant operations. The restaurant-facing platform is at https://migmig.app; customers can explore the consumer service at https://migmig.ca.

The company describes its direction as an AI operating system for restaurants. Supporting Canadian businesses and family budgets is part of its stated mission, not a promise of universal savings or a claim that competing platforms lack these features. Available services and pricing should be checked on the official site.

Submitted by Shayan Erfanian, Co-founder and CEO of MigMig Inc.

ImagesToText.ai (imagestotext.ai) is a free online image to text / OCR tool. Upload a photo, screenshot, scan, or handwritten note (JPG, PNG, GIF, WEBP, and more; FAQ also lists PDF) up to about 10MB, extract editable text with AI, then copy or download. No login required per the homepage. Images are processed on the site's own infrastructure and discarded after conversion, according to the privacy policy.

ScorpionAI é um assistente de inteligência artificial desenvolvido para facilitar o dia a dia de pessoas e empresas. Converse com a IA, tire dúvidas, gere e edite imagens, analise arquivos e planilhas, crie documentos, traduza textos e organize informações em uma única plataforma, com interface em português e acesso pela web.

PetVideoAI turns a photo of an adult and a pet photo into a 10-second, 9:16 Cat Clapping meme video with audio. Download an MP4 without a visible watermark for TikTok or Reels. The web app uses paid credits, with automatic refunds for failed generations.

Rap Video AI is a browser-based tool for making short rap videos from photos. Upload one photo for a solo performance or two for a duo, add your own lyrics, and choose a beat and a scene. The tool generates an 8–30 second video with vocals, a beat and lip sync, depending on the selected tier. Videos download as MP4 files in portrait or landscape format, at up to 720p, without a watermark. Video generation uses paid credits, available through one-time packs or optional subscriptions. Generation takes time, and lip sync and character consistency can vary.

AI Christmas makes one Christmas portrait from separate photos of people and pets when a group shoot is not possible. Upload one reference photo per person or pet (up to six), choose a scene, and inspect a free watermarked preview before any payment. No prompt writing or account required. Optional one-time HD credit packs start at $9.99; no subscription. Personal, non-commercial use only.

Merrows puts an AI-powered rep on phone, web chat, SMS and email so customers can order, track deliveries, book appointments and get help. It follows a plain-language Playbook, connects to your POS, store and helpdesk, and hands off to your team when asked or when a request is outside the Playbook. It works with Shopify, Recharge, Square, Toast, Tekmetric, Shopmonkey, Mindbody, Gorgias and Zendesk.

Drawing to Animation turns a photo of a paper drawing into an eight-second animated clip. Upload a crayon, pencil, marker or watercolor drawing without writing a prompt. The tool fits the drawing into a frame, with controls to adjust its position, zoom and rotation. AI adds movement while aiming to retain the original lines, textures and handmade character. The first animation is free after email verification, with paid packs available for more clips.

LensNote is an AI note taker for recorded lectures, meetings, and long videos. Upload a recording in the web app, or record a window on your Mac. LensNote captures every distinct slide once, links each slide to what was said, and adds a key message. Each session includes a timestamped transcript, summary, key takeaways, action items, and a structured report. Click a slide or transcript line to replay that moment. Export PDF, Word, PPTX, or TXT, or share a read-only link. No bot joins your calls. Free 14-day trial with 180 processing minutes; Pro is $30/month.

Voxcribe extracts audio locally in your browser, so the video itself is not uploaded. It produces timestamped editable transcripts with automatic language detection and click-to-listen segments. TXT export is free; SRT, VTT and DOCX exports require a paid plan. First file up to 10 minutes without an account; free account 120 min/month, up to 30 min/file, 3/day. Starter $9/mo 1200 min, Pro $19/mo 3000 min, Business $29/mo 6000 min; 300 min pack $5. Audio deleted after 7 days; transcripts retained until user deletes. Not open-source.

English-language science practice for individual learners ages 13+ on iPhone. Follow Explore, Think, Teach and Try: investigate a clue, reason about an explanation, explain it to Nova in your own words, then apply it in a new context. Six chapters cover cells, ecology, Earth, matter, forces and space. Free includes 12 lessons; optional Apple-billed Plus includes all 120 current lessons. Written-answer AI coaching requires an eligible region, current explicit permission, Plus and server checks. Currently available in Singapore and Hong Kong. The website provides regional App Store downloads, plans, FAQs and privacy details.
BuzzyX is an X (Twitter) growth workspace for founders: write posts in your own voice with AI, schedule them and read real X analytics.

productName: AI photo with the white lion
description: Upload one clear, well-lit photo of yourself and create a 9:16 PNG with Sheru Bhai, a fictional lion character. The launch pilot offers one free photo per browser each day while the shared allowance lasts. No account or card is required.

TheRouter is an OpenAI-compatible API gateway. Point a client such as Cursor or Claude Code at one endpoint to reach models from multiple providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and DeepSeek. It adds automatic failover, real-time token and cost tracking per API key, spending limits, and bring-your-own-keys. Pricing: https://therouter.ai/pricing/. Quickstart: https://therouter.ai/docs/quickstart/.

Artformly is an AI photo-to-art tool that turns uploaded photos into digital illustrations and portraits, including pet portraits. Upload a photo, choose an art style, generate an image, then preview and download the result. Styles include photo with hand-drawn elements, graphic illustration, minimal paper drawing, and watercolor portrait. Generated artwork can be managed in a personal library. Artformly offers a free preview and one-time credit packs for further creation. Digital artwork only, with no physical prints or shipping.
OneKDP's AI book generator and KDP cover generator create editable interiors and full print covers. Free KDP calculators and manual editing included.
Create AI videos and images with Capafy AI. Turn text or reference photos into visuals with leading models, clear credit pricing and a private creative library.

Make AI videos and images with leading models like Gemini Omni, Veo 3.1, Kling 3.0 and Seedance 2.5, all in one simple creative workspace. Turn a text prompt or reference image into product shots, portraits, concept art and social visuals, or generate video scenes. See the estimated credit cost before you create.

AI Hairstyle Changer is an online virtual hairstyle and hair color try-on tool. Upload a clear portrait (JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 10MB), choose a style from categories such as straight, bob and lob, short cuts, layered and wavy or curly, or upload a reference image, and see an AI-generated before-and-after preview in seconds. It offers 31 hair color choices, multi-style previews from the same photo, saved history and downloads you can show your hairstylist. An AI Styling Advisor reviews visible face shape and suggests six catalog styles. No app download required.

Alpha Blue helps businesses manage WhatsApp conversations. Depending on the selected plan and setup, it supports AI auto-replies, order or booking workflows, and handover to a human team member. Contact Alpha Blue for pricing and setup details.

GenGrades is an independent review site that grades generative AI tools and models with standardized tests: the same prompts and inputs for every model, real outputs published with the review, and scores on a 0 to 10 scale with public weights. Tools are grouped by job — chat and agents, image, video, audio, and API aggregators — and each category has its own test set, rubric, ranking, and published weights. Outputs are scored blind where possible; a language model may pre-screen, but a person sets the final score. New model versions get a new, dated run. Reviews list price, limits, and who should not pay, with the source and the day those facts were checked. Grades are not for sale. As of 11 November 2026 the site had 98 tools and 16 models graded. Reading the reviews is free.

MarkItDown Legal is a PDF-to-Markdown converter built for lawyers. It turns contracts, court filings, and legal documents into clean, AI-ready Markdown for ChatGPT, Claude, and AI review workflows, preserving legal structure such as clauses, headings, tables, and signatures. Conversion runs 100% in the browser using WebAssembly (WASM) — files are never uploaded, stored, or sent to any server, so attorney-client privilege is protected. Free plan: 3 conversions per day, up to 10MB per file. Pro: $9/month; lifetime: $99. Launched 2026-10-13. Note: MarkItDown Legal is an independent product and is unrelated to Microsoft's open-source MarkItDown project.

CatchGist is text to speech for material you need but cannot already scan with ease — a brief, paper, or PDF outside your usual work. Add the file or link, hear the gist first, then read a written outline and the main points, which are a little fuller than the audio. From there, explore one part or listen to the full text. 10 free uses, no account needed to start. Paid packs are one-time, $2.99 or $9.99, not a subscription.

DrawLesson helps beginners learn to draw one step at a time with ready-made drawing lessons, on-screen drawing, camera-assisted tracing, and AI-generated step sheets from a reference image. Lessons and drawing are free; AI generations use credits.

DSU-X Amazon tools (Bingjie team) at https://amz.dsux.com is a free Amazon SEO and GEO tool for sellers. Paste a Listing title and bullet points to get a seven-dimension audit, plus generative-engine (GEO) optimization, AI shopping-agent readiness, and Rufus (Alexa for Shopping) readability and scenario-keyword checks aimed at better keyword layout and organic visibility. The audit flags oversized or thin titles, missing Item Highlights for overflow keywords, weak long-tail coverage, and suggests scenario Q&A, promotions, and 3D content.
