Audits stay free; a full Word plan with line-by-line edits, keyword placement, and an AEO checklist can be downloaded on a pay-for-results basis for listing updates. Registration includes a 7-day Silver membership with one free plan download per day; the free tier audits up to three listings at a time. The site states a white-hat policy (no review or sales manipulation, no infringement advice) and that suggestions are for reference only, with no guaranteed sales or ranking outcomes; Amazon policies and algorithms change, and the team does not accept responsibility for platform-side changes. The product is localized in Chinese, English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Japanese, and Portuguese. Official site: https://amz.dsux.com

WinningUGC is an AI video agent for e-commerce sellers and brand content teams. Start with a product photo and a one-line brief. It analyzes the product and selling points, researches the market and proposes three creative directions. You choose one, approve characters and scenes, then review a shot-by-shot storyboard with durations and a credit estimate. Video is generated only after you confirm. Compare shot versions, regenerate only the shots you dislike, arrange the timeline, and adjust subtitles, voiceover and volume before rendering. Download the final video and project bundle, or share a revocable link. Failed generations automatically return credits. Freemium: every new workspace gets 200 free credits with no expiry. Pro is $39/month or $396/year; one-time credit packs are $30/$60/$100.

ApiClay helps developers, businesses and AI builders discover, use and publish APIs. Explore API listings, inspect documentation, test requests in a playground and integrate through REST or compatible MCP clients. Turn websites, databases, spreadsheets and existing services into APIs with controlled access and pricing. Tools for data extraction, enrichment, monitoring and webhooks support recurring workflows. Browsing and documentation are free; trials and paid usage vary by API.

SchemCanvas is an AI Minecraft build generator. Type a prompt like "a stone watchtower with a spruce roof", pick a size, and get a 3D build you can inspect, edit by hand and export as a Sponge v2 .schem file for Minecraft Java 1.20.1 via WorldEdit. A free image-to-pixel-art schematic tool is included.

The Free plan includes one AI generation per week. For more, one-time packs are available with no subscription: Starter Pack ($4.99, 10 generations) and Builder Pack ($9.99, 25 generations), each valid for 12 months. Previewing, editing and downloading never cost extra generations.

SchemCanvas is an unofficial tool, not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft.

Face Atlas is a free AI face analyzer that runs privately in your browser, so your photo is not uploaded to a server for analysis. It reads face shape, photo quality and visible proportions and turns them into an easy-to-read report.

Free tools include a face shape detector, canthal tilt test, golden ratio analysis, facial symmetry test and a facial ratio calculator. Chapters 01–03 of the report are free; the complete 14-chapter report is an optional one-time $9.90 purchase with no subscription.

Face Atlas is meant for curiosity, styling and photo decisions (hairstyles, glasses, angles), not medical or identity use.

TattooPilot helps you turn a tattoo idea into a clear concept before you visit an artist. Describe your theme, subject, mood, symbols, or preferred style, and explore AI generated tattoo concepts in different directions.

Compare styles, refine details, and use model previews to consider placement, scale, and balance on different areas of the body. This helps you make decisions with more confidence and communicate your vision without needing to sketch or collect references for hours.

When you find a direction you like, download a structured concept brief to share with a professional tattoo artist. TattooPilot is a planning and inspiration tool: your artist can adapt the final design, line weight, size, and stencil for your body and tattooing technique.

Paid one-time packs are $9.90, $19.90 and $49.90. There is no subscription.

My Paper Plagiarism Checker is a browser-based tool for reviewing student essays, research papers and coursework. It provides similarity scores, linked matching sources and highlighted passages, alongside an AI-writing check. Users can paste text or upload PDF, Word or text files. A free tier supports up to 3,000 words per check, with paid credit packs for longer work. Scores are indicators for review, not proof of plagiarism or AI use.

DSU-X (DsuX.com) is a globally distributed marketing-tech team founded in 2006. One parent site runs twelve growth lines: AI SEO CMS, AI GEO CMS, Amazon seller tools, self-hosted EDM, white-label/OEM source, RouteLab store routing, crypto quant lab, cross-border DTC marketing, Asia-Pacific business advisory, and multi-agent quant research. Focus: white-hat compliance, measurable delivery, auditable data—no absolute outcome promises. Localized across languages with 24/7 cross-timezone collaboration. Site: https://dsux.com

Upload recent photos, choose a professional style, pay once from $29, and review watermarked previews before HD unlock. Built for LinkedIn, speaker bios, and company team pages, with free crop and photo tools on the same site.

A free 12-question score for whether your agents and automations can run while you’re away. The $29 kit adds a pre-departure runbook, spend caps, and a heartbeat monitor you host on your own free Supabase project. Independent kit; no data is sent to the seller.

A free in-browser check of whether a local model fits in GPU or RAM, with weights and KV-cache math shown and sourced. Three models are free. The $7 sheet covers eight, plus launch commands and a memory cheat sheet. Estimates only; no speed predictions.

MertAGI is an alpha-stage AI workspace for trade operations. Its MAGI assistant helps businesses research products, compare supplier offers and prepare buying, selling and bookkeeping workflows within company-defined approval limits.

productName: AI Practical Lab — Private File Precheck
description: Free, client-side format checker for exported ChatGPT conversations.json and advertising CSV/TSV. Select a file locally to see conversation-structure counts or whether required advertising headers (date, spend, campaign, ad ID, installs) are present. It does not upload files or show private message text and requires no signup. Source code is public on GitHub. It is only a preliminary format check, not a guarantee of compatibility with separate paid offline tools.

Online Vocal Remover is a web-based audio tool for separating vocals and instrumentals. Upload an MP3, WAV, M4A, or OGG file up to 50 MB, preview both tracks online, and sign in when you want to download. It is designed for karaoke preparation, cover practice, music lessons, and remix drafts. Single-file testing is available on the free plan, while paid subscriptions include monthly credits, batch processing, and ZIP exports. Separation quality depends on the original mix, so users should listen to the output before using it. https://onlinevocalremover.com/
LyricCreatorAI turns song ideas into structured, singable lyrics with AI-assisted hooks, verses, choruses, rewriting, quality analysis, and vocal tools.

AIHOT helps Chinese-speaking readers follow AI model releases, product updates and industry developments. Browse concise summaries and daily briefings, then open the original reporting for more detail.

Turn a photo of your pet, a favorite place, or an illustration into an editable cross-stitch chart. Choose a stitch count and a DMC palette, then preview the result on fabric. Direct photo conversion and the guest editor are free. Optional AI photo preparation and printable PDFs use paid credits. Available in English and French.
Famed shows local businesses how often ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI, Perplexity, Claude and Grok recommend them, and fixes what holds them back. Free AI check.
Make AI videos free with Veo, Kling, Seedance and more. Text or image to video, no watermark, credits that never expire, commercial use. No card required.
Remove BG Video is a browser AI tool that removes or replaces video backgrounds. Download one processed 5-second WebM free; credits cover longer clips.
A browser tool for real-time webcam AI looks. Choose a gallery reference or a portrait you have permission to use; preview live in your browser. Try 20 seconds free as a guest.

Photo Retouch Ease is a browser AI workspace for portrait touch-ups, object cleanup and old-photo restoration. Guests can try one basic edit without signing in; one-time credit packs are available for further edits.

roTEAMnet is a career workspace for job seekers exploring worldwide, remote, part-time and flexible opportunities. Browse jobs and open original application links for free. Create a free account to save opportunities, set up alerts and organize applications. Free browser tools check the text extracted from a CV PDF and compare posting words. Optional AI workflows review a CV, compare job requirements with your experience and prepare tailored CV drafts from facts you confirm. A verified free account includes 15 initial AI credits; paid plans and top-ups support further AI work, with costs shown before use. The interface is available in English, German, French, Romanian, Dutch, Italian and Spanish. A remote MCP connector supports compatible AI clients with scoped OAuth access.

AI Picture Checker is a free browser tool that analyzes an uploaded image to estimate whether it was generated by AI. It can flag likely AI images, identify common source models such as Midjourney, DALL·E, Stable Diffusion, Flux, and Gemini, and check for deepfakes.
NextReset monitors public OpenAI Codex reset announcements and presents clearly labelled current status and forecast information for developers.

USA Intelligence is an independent AI information service. Ask questions about U.S. government, public services, civics, and history — every answer links to official sources. No account, nothing saved. Includes a directory of 31,874 verified government sites.

Create Image is a browser-based workspace for turning a written idea, and optionally a reference image, into still images or short videos.

In the workspace you choose image or video, write a prompt, and, when the selected model supports it, upload a reference image you have permission to use. The site shows the currently available models and the settings for that model �ü such as aspect ratio or video length �ü before you submit. It also shows the credit cost for that generation.

Create Image currently sells monthly plans billed in credits: Starter at $9.99 for 100 credits, Creator at $19.99 for 300 credits, and Pro at $49.99 for 1,000 credits, as listed on the pricing page on 14 November 2026.

Sheru Bhai AI is an independent AI photo and video generator for fictional lion-boss scenes: turn your photo or a short prompt into a white-lion portrait or a 5–10 second Reels-ready video, with optional Hindi, Hinglish or Urdu dialogue.
AI document translator & summarizer for 50+ formats. Read PDFs, contracts, and slides in 154 languages & dialects, layout intact. Free preview, no signup.

Research stocks, US options, forex, crypto and penny stocks through conversational questions. Large Trader AI lets users explore companies, markets and trading ideas in a web interface. Freemium; AI-generated information is not investment advice.

Maker disclosure: I maintain FotoApta. The free document-photo editor crops, sizes and prepares print sheets locally in the browser. Check the receiving organization’s requirements before changing a document photo. A separate English/Portuguese AI headshot workflow sends a selfie to external generation providers. It offers a free watermarked preview and an optional US$9.99 one-time pack of six HD portraits, without a subscription. AI can change facial details and the paid batch may differ from the preview. Generated portraits are for professional profiles, not passports or official ID; generated photos are kept up to seven days for order recovery.

AI选聘 helps HR teams organize recruiter-selected information in their own Feishu Bitable for human review and collaboration. It supports visible profiles from supported recruiting websites, selected attachments in supported webmail, and local PDF, DOCX, PNG or JPG resumes. Annual plans are CNY 199 for email, CNY 299 for recruiting platforms and CNY 399 for the full plan. Three basic syncs are a trial and exclude AI analysis.

Campfire SMS gives your AI agent a phone line to you. When a long-running agent needs an answer, you get a real text and your plain-language reply goes back to the agent. Works over MCP. Free demo, then pay-as-you-go credit packs from $5.

Practice interviews, meeting contributions and assertive conversations aloud with a live, topic-specific AI voice coach. Choose one skill and a real situation, rehearse in your browser, then review a saved recap and practical next step after a completed conversation. A paid introductory session covers one topic for up to 20 minutes, with no subscription required. Optional plans are available; see current local prices on the site. Adults 18+. AI coaches, not human professionals. Skills coaching, not therapy or mental-health care. No guaranteed outcomes.

Headcanon Generator gives fanfiction writers and original character creators a starting point when a character feels flat or a scene stalls. Use it to brainstorm character details, relationship dynamics, and scene prompts, then decide what fits your story. Writing guides and a character worksheet are free; AI generations use paid credits.

productName: What Will My Baby Look Like AI
description: What Will My Baby Look Like AI is a browser-based AI baby generator for couples. Upload one clear photo of each partner, choose a girl, boy, twins or a surprise, and the AI draws 2 pictures of a child mixing both faces. It is made for fun, not as a prediction. The first preview is free.
Scrape, clean, match: ready data APIs and AI scrapers that end in a competitor price comparison. Pay as you go, 5 free requests. REST API, CSV, MCP.

MendPhoto offers online AI photo repair tools for fading, scratches, creases, noise and blur. Upload an image, review the before-and-after result and download the repair. Processing uses paid one-time credits.

AceStack AI helps frontend, backend, and full-stack engineers prepare for technical interviews. Choose a role-based path, practice HR and technical screening, algorithm and platform coding, and SQL cases. Save solutions, review your reasoning, and see what to practice next. Start free; Focus adds an AI Coach and behavioral practice.

SpriteSkin helps Minecraft players create personalized skins from a photo or text prompt, preview them in 3D, and edit skins in the browser. It also offers free manual skin and cape tools. AI generation uses credits; paid options and download restrictions are shown on the site. Free promotional credits vary by region. SpriteSkin is an independent tool and is not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft.
JellyMate is an AI plush-style image and video generator. Turn pet photos into plush-style portraits and short videos. From $9/month with commercial use included. Not affiliated with Jellycat.

BrickGPT turns a photo of a finished brick model into an AI-generated visual step-by-step instruction board plus a short assembly video. Independent product, not affiliated with any university research project.
XDReality is an AI image-to-3D model generator. Upload a photo and download a GLB 3D model.

Taste Stack provides installable design-skill packages for existing AI coding agents. Choose a visual direction for web interfaces and visual assets, then use it inside Claude Code, Codex or Cursor. Four starter tastes are free with an account; listed paid tastes cost $3.99 once, with optional Pro access. Agent and model access are separate. Commercial use in personal and client work is allowed; redistribution or resale of the packages is not. Free Swiss starter: https://tastestack.dev/skills/swiss . Install guide: https://tastestack.dev/docs . Self-submission by the Taste Stack team, prepared with AI assistance.

Prompty is a Windows app for people who already use ChatGPT, Claude, Grok or Perplexity. Describe something you need, such as turning rough meeting notes into an email. Prompty asks for missing details, sends the prompt to your chosen AI, then follows up on its first answer. Download Prompty and create a free account to try one task. Feedback on your first run is welcome at hello@lumlyai.com.
Free browser-based image tools — resize, crop, compress to KB, convert JPG/WebP/HEIC, AI upscale, background remover, passport photos — no signup, no upload, no watermark
Hyzocool Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures MCIO and OCuLink high-speed cables, PCIe adapters and cooling solutions for AI and HPC servers, with in-house cable assembly and ISO 9001 certification.
Enhance video quality online with AI. Upscale soft footage to 1080p, 2K or 4K and reduce noise and motion artifacts. Browser-based; one 5-second free trial, then paid processing in credits.

Motion TMS is transport management software for UK haulage operations, bringing orders, planning, drivers, delivery evidence and draft invoicing workflows into one workspace. It is in an early operator rollout. Its free plan is for operators running 1 to 50 trucks; live telematics, driver-hours feeds, route optimisation and accounting sync are separate paid tools. The public walkthrough uses fictional sample records and does not book real slots, track vehicles or send invoices. Motion TMS is operated by Flying Penguin AI Limited.

Traductor Total (traductortotal.com) es una web gratuita, en español y sin registro, que usa inteligencia artificial para pasar al español todo lo que no está escrito: imágenes, documentos, audio y vídeo. Reúne cinco herramientas en un solo sitio, cada una pensada para una tarea concreta, y funciona igual en el móvil que en el ordenador, sin instalar nada ni crear una cuenta.

La portada combina OCR y traducción automática: un modelo de visión localiza el texto de una foto o captura y lo traduce. Admite JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC, GIF y BMP de hasta 10 MB, detecta el idioma de la imagen y devuelve las frases listas para copiar o descargar en TXT, con el original debajo. La página Imagen a texto hace solo la extracción, sin traducir, para quien únicamente quiere copiar lo que dice una captura.

Traductor de imágenes usa IA de visión para localizar cada bloque de texto, traducirlo y devolverlo a su sitio: el fondo se limpia sin recuadros blancos y la descarga conserva el tamaño original, sin marca de agua. Sirve para carteles, cartas de restaurante, fichas de producto, cómics, infografías y diapositivas.

Traductor PDF traduce documentos PDF, también los escaneados, con OCR para las páginas que son imagen, y conserva tablas, imágenes, firmas y maquetación. Acepta hasta 20 MB y 50 páginas y deja comparar cada página con la original antes de descargar.

Transcribir audio a texto usa reconocimiento de voz con IA para convertir notas de voz de WhatsApp, entrevistas, clases y reuniones en texto con marcas de tiempo, identificación de hablantes y exportación a TXT o SRT. Admite MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG/OPUS, AAC, FLAC y más, hasta 100 MB y 30 minutos. Transcribir vídeo a texto hace lo mismo con MP4, MOV y WebM y genera subtítulos, y Traducir audio transcribe y traduce lo que se dice, frase a frase.

Traduce al español por defecto y a 20 idiomas de destino: inglés, catalán, euskera, gallego, francés, portugués, alemán, italiano, neerlandés, rumano, polaco, ucraniano, ruso, árabe, chino, japonés, coreano, hindi y turco. Todo es gratis, sin registro y sin marca de agua. Es útil para estudiantes, oficinas, tiendas online, hostelería, investigación, medios y para cualquiera que reciba un documento, una imagen o un audio en otro idioma y lo necesite entender en español.

tatbot sends one prompt to several AI models at once, shows the answers side by side, then a judge model critiques them, corrects what's wrong and gives a verdict. Free for up to 5 models per comparison; Pro is $9/month after a 7-day trial.

Israelingo helps you practise conversational Hebrew on Android and iPhone. Speak or type with an AI tutor, role-play everyday situations in Israel, and review corrections, translations and vocabulary. The app is free to download, with some paid features and plans.

CatalogGuard audits Shopify product data, descriptions, image alt text, and SEO fields. It drafts AI-assisted improvements for merchant review, so merchants can check changes before saving them to Shopify.

productName: FreeToolBox: Free AI Background Remover Online
description: FreeToolBox removes the background from any photo right in your browser. There is no sign-up, no watermark, and no upload, because the AI runs on your device, so your photos stay private. Download the result as a full-resolution transparent PNG, or place it on white or any colour for listings and social posts.

Wassup in a Minute at wassupinaminute.net turns an image of a person, illustrated character or animal into a white-background waist-sway video, aiming to preserve the subject's appearance, outfit and original visual style. Upload a JPG or PNG up to 10 MB and generate a 6-second, 720p, 9:16 video without audio. No dance recording or custom prompt is needed. Google sign-in and paid credits are required: each generation uses 36 credits, and the smallest pack costs $4.99 for 50 credits. Credits are purchased once without automatic renewal. Music must be added separately, and AI results may change details. Input/output examples and photo tips are available before creating.

Syaxis creates presentations from source files, research or a topic. It researches, writes and designs slides, supports direct editing and chat revisions, and lets users present in the browser or export PowerPoint, PDF and PNG. The free plan uses credits, supports up to 12 slides per presentation and adds a Made with Syaxis mark to exports.

Seyka AI is a conversational SEO assistant built for the Russian-speaking web. It checks website metadata, technical SEO, page speed and Yandex indexing, researches keywords using Yandex Wordstat, and helps with SEO content. Basic checks are available without registration; accounts and subscriptions unlock advanced tools and models. Submitted by Харитон М, SEO-специалист команды «Сейки».

Image-to-image AI: upload a reference photo and add a prompt to generate a new image. It transforms styles, scenes, and details while using the input as a visual reference. Freemium: one free generation per day with or without an account; no sign-up and no watermark.

Beauto is an Android AI face-swap app for photos and videos. Single custom photo swaps are free, with watermark-free exports and core on-device processing. Batch, multi-face, video and template features use credits or PRO. Download the APK from the official website.

ClassPaws is a classroom workspace for teachers. Use AI to draft lesson plans and quizzes, recognize progress with points and virtual pets, and organize classroom groups and seating. Try the public practice classroom without adding a real student roster. The free plan supports one class with up to 60 students.

Genify turns your text into illustrated stories with one consistent character across every scene, outfit and style. Built for picture books, comics and storyboards. Features include custom reference images, style extraction, @character and @style in the prompt box, a character library with multiple looks and outfits, automatic character extraction and linking from story text, and full storyboard editing. Made for AI picture book creators, KDP self-publishers, illustrators and parents making personalised books for their kids.

reinwatch is a free, open-source (MIT) Claude Code plugin/mod that shows per-agent token counts for subagents, warns you when an agent runs too long, burns too many tokens or gets stuck, keeps 30-day totals, and lets you stop a single agent — even inside a workflow.

Motion Control is a freemium web app for generating a new video from photos and a reference clip. The reference video guides the action, timing and framing, while the photos guide the subject’s visual details; use a prepared motion template or upload a compatible clip.

Motion Transfer is a freemium web app that creates a new video from a character photo and a reference clip. The photo guides the subject’s appearance while the clip guides movement, pacing and framing; use a prepared trend or upload a compatible clip.
Audora OS is a free AI workspace by Audora Tech. It combines an AI chat assistant, image generation, task lists, a drawing board, a terminal and small utilities in one browser app.

AI SVG & GIF Generator offers free, browser-local tools for everyday SVG and GIF work. Open an SVG to inspect and sanitize it, convert it to PNG with transparency, compress or resize an animated GIF while keeping frames and timing, or make a typewriter-style text GIF. Parsing, preview, conversion, and encoding run on your device—the source file is not uploaded to an application server. Credit-based AI tools for text-to-SVG, text-to-GIF, and photo-to-GIF emoji packs are planned and not yet open.

Free online cross stitch chart generator — turn any photo or text into a stitchable chart. Free up to 50x50, no signup. Real DMC colours with CIEDE2000 matching, printable A4 PDF, AI pattern generator.

DogPrompt turns an everyday dog photo into a polished AI portrait while preserving the dog’s face, coat colours, markings, ear shape and expression. Pet owners can also upload one photo of themselves and one of their dog to create a new image together. Templates cover Christmas, Thanksgiving, birthdays, weddings, memorials, studio portraits, royal portraits, watercolor, oil painting, sketches, cartoons and more. The first preview is free, credit packs are one-time purchases, and there is no subscription.

ScribeAny is a free online AI transcription tool that turns audio, video, and public video links into editable text. Upload MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG, MP4, MOV, MKV, WEBM and more (up to 100 MB per file), or paste a public YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X, or Facebook video link. The spoken language is detected automatically and you get a timestamped transcript you can search and edit. Optionally translate the transcript and generate an editable summary with key points. Export as TXT, DOCX, PDF, SRT, VTT, or CSV. No account or payment is required.

GrixTrack is a rank and AI-citation tracker built by Grixhub in Bangkok. Track Google positions for your keywords in any country, city and language, and see whether ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI Mode mention or cite your brand for the prompts your customers ask. Compare against competitors, see which domains AI engines cite, and follow changes over time. The free plan includes 10 keywords, 5 AI prompts and 2 competitors with no card; paid plans start at $17.99 a month.

FableClip is an AI faceless video series generator. Design a character once, keep it consistent across episodes, generate scripts, voiceover and visuals, and auto-publish to TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Reels. Plans from $19/month.

What to Wear Atlas is a free website for planning everyday outfits around the weather and your plans. Its Today tool accepts supported U.S. cities or ZIP codes, or a manually entered temperature, and turns the selected conditions and comfort preferences into a layered clothing checklist with reasons. Use it before a commute or casual outing, then consult the weather and occasion guides for context. No account, wardrobe photo or purchase is required. Suggestions are rule-based guidance rather than AI photo styling.

Remove Watermark from Video is an online AI tool that cleans watermarks, logos and text overlays off videos you own. It detects the mark automatically and rebuilds the area behind it instead of blurring or cropping. Upload MP4, MOV or WebM (up to 100 MB / 10 minutes) in the browser; credits are charged per second and failed jobs are refunded.

BeamPetal helps clothing brands and ecommerce sellers create AI fashion model images from product photos. Upload clothing images, choose a model, background and pose, and generate on-model visuals for product listings and marketing. Review generated garment details before publishing. The AI Fashion Model tool is available at https://beampetal.com/tools/ai-fashion-model.

ReddTrends finds Reddit threads ranking on Google and cited by AI search for buyer keywords, suggests which conversations to join and how to reply, then tracks comments and thread rankings weekly. You reply from your own account; it never posts for you. Free preview: 3 thread verdicts, no account or card. Freemium: launch prices through 15 Dec 2026 — Single report $9 one-time, Pro $19/month, Agency $49/month.
Ontoloop connects your team's Claude Code and Codex over MCP to one shared space where agents propose, people confirm, and every agent builds on the same facts.

01Router is one API for all the best AI models. Generate AI videos and images in the web studio, or integrate leading video and image models into your product through one AI video API and AI image API.

Paste a dating text or screenshot and get a quick read of the conversation, plus 3 natural replies ranked, each with why it works. It is soft and kind with no pickup lines, and it never touches your messaging apps, so you always press send. The free plan needs no card.

InkRoom is a browser-based AI image workspace for individual creators and small teams. It combines text-to-image generation, reference-led creation, visual editing and image enhancement for product photos, posters and related visual variations. Usage is credit-based and paid; eligible visitors may try text-to-image under the current live configuration. Users should check available models, permissions and estimated costs, then review generated text, colors and product details before publishing.

The third tool in the VocRemover workspace is labeled Keep the voice intact. It is meant to preserve speech and effects while removing background music, then hand back a finished MP4. The site states that this does not change video quality, because the picture is copied and only the audio is replaced.

Video files can be MP4, MOV, WEBM, or M4V, up to 90 MB. The soundtrack model named in the FAQ is DBS-TIGER. As with the other tools, you preview first and you sign in to process and store the file.

Credits start with the Free plan's 30-credit sign-up grant. The pricing page also estimates monthly video counts on Lite, Pro, and Studio (for example, about 13 / 40 / 133 videos per month on the yearly cards). Failed jobs are refunded automatically.

Trajeto helps Brazilian job seekers create professional resumes, analyze their fit with job descriptions, and tailor applications using AI. A free plan offers an initial resume diagnosis and adaptation. Paid plans provide higher usage limits, premium templates and additional preparation tools, including voice interview practice on Pro. Explore the website to choose the plan that fits your job search.

RapAI (airapvideo.design) is a browser-based AI rap video maker that turns one or two photos into a short two-person rap performance with generated vocals — no camera, editing, or crew. Pick a theme or paste your own lyrics; export 9:16 for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts. No free plan; one-time credit packs from $6.90; failed videos refunded.

LIFE helps people who feel overwhelmed or stuck choose a practical next step. Its free public tool works in Spanish, English, French and German without signing up. Visitors can compare three suggestions based on their time, energy and situation, try a voluntary 60-second starting action, and review what happened. Guest notes stay in their browser. A separate registered experience offers personal follow-up. Advanced AI features may be unavailable.

VocoType is an offline voice typing application for Windows and macOS. Hold a keyboard shortcut, speak naturally, and release it to insert recognized text directly into the active input field. On-device speech recognition keeps voice recordings on the computer and works without an internet connection. The application supports mixed Chinese and English dictation, custom replacement dictionaries, imported audio and video transcription, and SRT subtitle export. Optional AI features help refine text, correct mistakes, and produce summaries. An MCP integration lets AI clients such as Claude and Cursor request transcription through the local VocoType application. Core features are free.

WIKIpdf is a free Windows desktop application for viewing PDF files, designed especially for marine engineers and maintenance technicians who work with technical drawings, manuals, and schematics. It features a fast, native PDF viewing engine with optional AI-powered Codex chat and Wiki generation capabilities for document analysis. Free download with optional in-app purchase. AI provider account required for the Chat/Wiki features.

Roofsyra connects residential and commercial roofing customer records, manual aerial tracing, entered pitch, estimates, invoices, project photos and crew timecards without employee GPS tracking. AI drafting tools support contractor review. Explore current plans on the website.

Image to Image is an online AI editor that changes a photo you already have, guided by a text prompt. Upload up to three JPG, PNG or WebP images, describe the change, and get a new picture in about 20 to 40 seconds that keeps the subject, pose and composition of the original. Restyle photos with one-click templates, edit details in plain words, and make product photos on new backgrounds. New accounts get 2 free credits.

CareOps Maeumi is an AI counseling app for Korean- and English-speaking users. It combines self-assessments, voice or text conversations, and exercises such as thought records, with saved notes and practice between sessions. Conversations draw on established approaches including CBT and ACT. It is available on iPhone, Android and the web. Free sign-up, intake and initial self-checks are available; session offers and prices are shown in the app. It is not a substitute for professional diagnosis, medical treatment or emergency care.

To change words inside an existing picture, InPlaceText provides an editor that runs in a browser. If a shop has a price tag photo with an outdated amount or a flyer contains the wrong date, the tool offers an alternative to recreating the entire design. Users upload a JPG, PNG, or WebP file and type both the original wording and its replacement. AI looks for the specified text and redraws it in place with a similar style, size, weight, colour, and perspective. The user does not have to know which font was used. The service can attempt script, handwriting, and decorative lettering as well as more ordinary text, although results are not guaranteed for every image. Repeated words can be targeted with a selection box. Images can be downloaded without a watermark, and the first edit needs no account.

TrendVido lets creators make personalized short videos by choosing a preset trend template and uploading their own photos. No prompt writing is needed. The independently operated web service uses one-time credit packs, starting at $9.99 for 10 credits, without a free trial or subscription. It is intended for template-based social clips, not unrestricted text-to-video editing.
StatDuels is a head-to-head card game using labelled real-world statistics and game scores, with themed decks, AI opponents and a shared Daily Duel.

Leah is an enterprise agentic AI company. Built on a decade of contracting, legal, and procurement expertise, it autonomously runs work across the enterprise, from the contract lifecycle and legal requests to source-to-pay. Founded in London in 2015 and backed by SoftBank and Insight Partners, Leah serves 400+ global enterprises and supports mission-critical processes in regulated industries. Leah works with partners including Microsoft, Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, PwC and KPMG to support enterprise transformation programs globally.

SyncBooster is a panel for scheduling and publishing social media posts. You upload photos and write a sentence, and an assistant drafts a separate version of the post for each platform: Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X, TikTok and Google Business Profile, with YouTube on paid plans. You edit the text by chatting ("shorten it", "add the price"), then publish right away or pick a day and time. The assistant saves a profile of your business, so each new post does not start from zero. The panel also includes an image generator, a gallery and carousels. You can start free: 100 tokens, no card. The Business plan (3 brands) is 249 PLN a month, VAT included, or 2,490 PLN a year. The offer is for consumers in Poland and for businesses in the EU with a valid EU VAT number.

Remove Music From Video is an online tool that takes the background music out of a video and keeps the people talking, singing or narrating. Choose an MP4, MOV or WebM file up to 500 MB and 30 minutes; the audio is read in your browser and only the audio is uploaded. Download the MP4 without music, the voice track or the music track. For creators, video editors and teachers.

ChibiStyle creates chibi avatars, Twitch emotes and Discord sticker PNGs from photos or text for creators and communities. Up to four images per generation with mood presets. Independent product with 15 signup credits, paid credit packs and a monthly plan; not affiliated with OpenAI.

Named (named.khanex.ai) is an AI visibility service for small businesses. When a buyer asks ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Grok or Muse for the best option in your category, the answer names a few companies. Named works to get you into that answer.

We run a fixed set of your buyers' questions on each engine, count how often each one names you and who it names instead, and log the links it cites. Then we change what the engines read about your site, starting with what moves that count most, and run the same questions again every week. Answers vary from run to run, so we track each engine separately.

It's done for you. Our AI agents, the Namies, run the questions, and a person checks every change before it goes live. Nobody can guarantee what AI says, and we don't sell placement. The audit is free.

Neither's recruitment module creates prioritized interview scorecards from job ads, captures timestamped interview notes with candidate quotes, schedules interviews, and builds candidate profiles from CVs. It is for recruiting teams; free to start, no card.

Vault Security is your personal AI safety assistant for the internet. It helps protect your digital life across web and mobile by spotting scams, phishing links, suspicious texts, fake websites, risky pages, and data threats before they turn into real problems.
Built for Android, iOS, and browser use, Vault gives you clear, real-time warnings in plain English, so you know when something looks unsafe and what to do next. It also supports privacy and identity protection with features like breach monitoring, VPN protection, ad blocking, aliases, and safer browsing guidance.
Unlike traditional antivirus tools, Vault is built for the threats people actually face today: scam messages, fake websites, phishing pages, leaked personal data, trackers, and identity risks. It works quietly in the background, helping you browse, shop, bank, and work online with more confidence.

AILEX is an AI-assisted legal workspace for Japanese law firms. It brings case records, document reading, draft preparation, deadlines and billing into one workflow. Lawyers can review source material and activity records while preparing documents and evidence packages for mints. Final legal decisions and court submissions remain with the lawyer. AILEX is provided by AILEX LLC in Tokyo, Japan. A one-month trial is available; the paid plan is JPY 13,200 per seat per month, including tax.
automates instagram + whatsapp replies for businesses where you book before you go so that they stop losing costumers to slow replies

Reletter helps designers, small businesses and ecommerce sellers update text in screenshots, menus and product images. Standard mode runs OCR in the browser and makes text regions independently editable. Optional Pro AI redraw edits selected regions on more complex backgrounds; review AI output before use. Editing and watermarked previews are free without an account. Clean Standard PNG downloads cost 5 credits per result; Pro redraw costs 10 credits including download. Paid features need Google sign-in and credits. One-time packs start at $4.99 for 100 credits. English and Simplified Chinese are supported.

Extract YouTube transcripts, video metadata, playlists, channel details and search results with simple HTTP requests. Word-level timestamps, output in JSON, text, Markdown, SRT or VTT, and batch extraction for up to 100 videos per request. Official Python and TypeScript SDKs, plus a remote MCP server so AI agents can call it directly. Free 200 credits on signup, no card required; packs $9/2,000 credits, $29/10,000, $79/50,000; credits never expire; no subscription.

Pickle is an AI agent app for iPhone and Android that handles everyday tasks for you - looking things up, drafting messages, booking, errands - and talks with you by voice or text. Access is invite-based. Invite link: pickle.com/i/RDKXK77G9ZRT - when a friend joins with your link and finishes signing up, both get full reset tickets for the app's daily usage limit (the free daily cap resets at 4 AM).

AegisRunner helps developers and QA teams inspect public websites for broken links, accessibility issues, search visibility, security settings and performance. It offers AI-assisted test drafting, reviewable findings and screenshots, with supported web suites exportable as Playwright TypeScript. A permanent free plan is available, with paid plans for additional capacity and mobile testing. Customer sign-in testing and local-runner activation are pending.

CastRemix remakes a short video using your own characters from a 2–30s reference clip plus a character photo. Uploads are private. A quote is shown before generation. It does not guarantee exact face replacement, unchanged backgrounds, or lip sync. Plans: Starter $9.9 USD/month with 500 credits, Creator $29.9 with 1,800 credits, Studio $99.9.

AIGCPanel is a free, open-source desktop app for AI digital-human (talking avatar) video production on Windows, macOS and Linux. Upload a portrait plus text or audio and it generates a lip-synced talking-head clip using open models such as MuseTalk, LatentSync, Wav2Lip and Heygem, with green-screen avatars and a template manager. It also includes text to speech (CosyVoice, FishSpeech, IndexTTS, GPT-SoVITS), zero-shot voice cloning, FunASR speech recognition with subtitle export, and a 25+ tool media toolbox. Everything runs locally once models are installed, so private footage never leaves your machine. Apache-2.0, optional Pro features.

Christmas Dance (christmasdance.org) is an AI Christmas dance video generator: upload photos (JPG, PNG, or WebP, up to 10 MB each; one person per photo, clear face and good light), match each shot to the labeled dancer slot, pick a solo, duo, or group template with music, and download an MP4 with the selected soundtrack. Templates on the homepage include Matching Pajamas, Solo Christmas Groove, Bestie Christmas Dance, and The Christmas Crew; durations are 4–15 seconds (the featured packs are 12 seconds). Output is 480p for 1 credit or 720p for 2 credits, including solo and group dances, aimed at TikTok, Reels, and Shorts. Credits are one-time packs with no subscription and do not expire: Stocking Filler $9.90 (2 credits), Christmas Party $24.90 (6 credits), The Whole Crew $59.90 (16 credits); mix resolutions from the same balance. Confirmed generation failures return the credits charged (not an automatic cash refund). Only use photos and audio you have permission to use. Directory listings: Free, support@christmasdance.org.

Alkademy is an AI-powered online learning ecosystem offering practical courses, professional certifications, live classes, workshops, and mentorship to help individuals and organizations build in-demand skills and achieve professional growth.

ATSway est une application web gratuite propulsée par l’intelligence artificielle, développée par le studio de création numérique Vagabond.work.
Son objectif principal est de rendre les CV hautement compatibles avec les logiciels ATS (Applicant Tracking Systems). Ces logiciels sont utilisés par la majorité des entreprises pour trier, scanner et filtrer automatiquement les candidatures avant même qu’un humain ne les lise.

MakeASong is an AI song maker that turns ideas or your own lyrics into complete songs. Describe what you want or paste lyrics, pick a style, and get two full takes each time. Includes AI song generator, lyrics-to-song, and AI lyrics generator. Songs stay private by default. Freemium: free credits on signup, then subscribe or buy credit packs.

Look Morph is a web-based AI clothes changer for adults exploring personal style. Upload a portrait and a clothing or accessory reference to generate a new look that aims to keep your identity. Tool pages cover outfit, hairstyle, hat, bag, shoes and pants, and Outfit can change clothes and haircut in one still. A finished still can become a turnaround GIF, a creative preview rather than a fitting. Stills cost 10 credits; a GIF costs 30 more. Every account gets 10 free credits daily, no payment card required; free results include a watermark. Uploads stay private.

Visual Maker AI is a credit-based AI visual creation workspace for creators, marketers and teams. Write a prompt or add a reference image to generate photoreal, illustrative or 3D images with models such as GPT Image 2 and Seedream 5.0 Pro, at 1K or 2K output. Turn a still photo or generated art into a 3–30 second clip with Veo 3.1, Seedance 2 or Kling 3.0, using image-to-video, text-to-video, first/last-frame or reference-led modes, with control over aspect ratio, duration, resolution and quality. The AI Film Studio breaks a script into scenes, keyframes and video clips, and the Product Ad Workflow builds a product story from hook to final shot. A curated prompt library and reusable character, product, location and style assets help you start quickly. New accounts receive 10 credits; subscriptions and one-time credit packs are available.

FontKite is a free, non-AI browser-based text toolkit: compare 84 copy-and-paste Unicode styles and symbols, make text-to-ASCII art, create kaomoji and username ideas, and export names as SVG for cutting. No account required.

Gaash AI is an AI-powered platform focused on SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO). We help businesses strengthen their online visibility, improve search presence, and stay ahead in the evolving AI-driven digital landscape. Our goal is to make businesses more discoverable across traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences.

Letter4U turns your words, photos and favorite song into a little page just for them. Writing, previews and drafts are free. Paid publishing is not enabled yet, so you can still create and share letters free during launch. It is not an AI writing tool.
Free IP lookup and network tools — check your IP address and location, run ping and speed tests, calculate subnets, and verify AI crawlers and bots. No sign-up needed.
Vidglory is an AI Video Cloner. Paste a viral video, swap in your own product, and create a video that features your product.

OfferWoo helps job seekers prepare for interviews and suggests real-time talking points based on their resume, job description and project notes. A limited free trial and paid time packages are available.
Lyria 3 Pro is an online AI music generator for longer custom tracks, instrumentals, jingles, and soundtrack ideas. Free to try in the browser.
Seedream 6.0 AI generates images from text prompts and references, with image editing and HD downloads, plus prompt workflow guides.

Emagia Cash Application Automation Software helps businesses automate payment matching, remittance processing, invoice reconciliation, and cash posting. Its AI-native capabilities help accounts receivable teams reduce manual work, improve cash application accuracy, resolve payment exceptions, and accelerate the order-to-cash process. Emagia supports enterprise finance teams in improving cash visibility and managing receivables more efficiently.
Duct Tape AI is an online AI image generator for prompt-based creation, editing, and text rendering. Credit-based downloads, built for teams that need images fast.

Slovio is an AI customer engagement platform for businesses in India, offering AI chatbots, AI Agents, AI Calling, WhatsApp automation, customer support automation, lead generation, appointment booking, campaigns, CRM, and omnichannel messaging. Businesses can engage customers on WhatsApp, Instagram, RCS, SMS, web chat, email, and phone calls from one platform. Slovio helps businesses automate sales, support, lead qualification, follow-ups, and bookings while giving teams a unified customer inbox and CRM.

Avatiko is an AI influencer generator for creators, shops and brands. Design a character once - face, hairstyle, outfit and style - and reuse it so every video and image shows the same recognizable person. Upload a reference video or paste a video link, and your character takes the place of the person in it, repeating the original moves, gestures and timing. Make UGC-style product ads, promo videos and daily short clips without hiring a creator or scheduling a shoot. Freemium: your first character image is free.

OraStage is an AI video generator that turns two photos into a short Hotel Lobby-style rap-duo video. Upload two photos, choose the format (9:16 or 16:9), and generate a 5-15 second MP4 with an original AI beat. It is built for quick social clips, memes and promotional videos. New accounts receive 10 free credits, and failed jobs refund credits. The workflow is browser-based and requires no video editing experience.
Velapic is a free library of high-resolution AI-generated images and phone & desktop wallpapers. Free for commercial use, no sign-up, no watermark.

AI Santa Video helps parents make a personalized Santa Claus video message for a child. Pick one of nine magical scenes, add the child's first name or nickname and your own words, and Santa speaks the message in any of 13 languages. No photo of the child is required — Santa is the only person on screen. You can hear how Santa says the name for free before buying. Messages are reviewed for kid-safe content. Credits are sold as one-time packs from $9.99 with no subscription, and credits never expire. Works in the browser on phone or computer.

Macswarm runs macOS Pods on Apple silicon so Claude Code and Codex can build and test iOS apps with Xcode and Simulators. Free includes 3 Pod-hours without a card. Pro is $99 per month, Team is $399, and Enterprise starts at $3,000 per month.

ClipNoter is an AI video note taker. Upload one MP4, MOV, or WebM file and get a timestamped transcript, summary, key points, and timed sections, with optional key frames. Export Markdown, ZIP+images, TXT, SRT, or VTT. Start free with weekly credits.

dar-ion is a browser-based AI workspace for writing, exploring ideas, creating images and generating video. Start with 10 guest chat messages without an account or payment card. A free account includes up to 30 messages per day, subject to shared safety and feature limits. Paid features use optional prepaid credits, with credit costs shown before generation. Credit packs start at $10 for 100 credits. Custom business AI projects are scoped and quoted individually. Submitted on behalf of dar-ion.

PawMambo creates a short 720p AI dog dance video from a dog photo and a short dance reference clip. It is for pet owners and creators who want to make an imaginative video without asking a real dog to perform a dance. The web app uses prepaid credits starting at $6.99; it has no free generation or free trial.

I'm Nathan Cheng, developer of Anvil. Anvil is a private AI assistant that runs on your iPhone. Chat offline, translate a sign from a photo, pull points from a PDF, transcribe meetings, and create images. No account, no ads, chats stay on your phone. Requires iPhone 15 Pro or newer.

Face Analysis AI is an English-language web tool for AI face analysis. Face shape detection and a photo attractiveness test / rating are free. A personalized improvement report is paid ($17.49). The score is feedback on a photo, not a medical or professional diagnosis.

SkillsSafe is a free security scanner for AI agent skills. Paste content, enter a URL or upload a SKILL.md file, MCP config or system prompt, and it checks it against more than 20 detection rules, including credential theft, data exfiltration, reverse shells, prompt injection and hidden zero-width characters. Scanning runs client-side in the browser. No signup is needed.

Tunetify is a free AI song maker. Describe the person, the story, or the moment — or paste lyrics you already have — and Tunetify writes the lyrics when needed, composes the melody, and sings it back, usually in about a minute. Explore 70+ styles, choose a vocal preference or an instrumental, then listen, tweak, and download the MP3 and lyrics. The first generation is free after you create an account and verify your email (one lifetime free generation per account, no card). Free songs are for personal, non-commercial use. Commercial plans are being prepared and are not available for purchase yet.

Frontier Rehearsal is an independent interview-practice service for research and engineering candidates preparing for frontier AI roles. Practice paths, runnable coding exercises, ML and systems scenarios, behavioral prompts, and browser-based labs help candidates rehearse the reasoning and communication required across technical interview rounds. Frontier Rehearsal is not affiliated with OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, or any employer. Independent practice. Not affiliated with OpenAI, Anthropic, or xAI.

FaceBlur blurs faces in video online. Upload an MP4, MOV or WebM; every face is found and tracked automatically. Tap the people who should stay clear and blur, pixelate or black-box everyone else. Photos and Private mode—browser-only, the video never leaves your device—are free. Cloud mode is planned and not on sale yet.

FlipFlow is an online flipbook maker that turns PDFs, PowerPoint files, Word documents, and images into interactive digital publications. Create flipbooks and AI-generated storybooks, customize their appearance, and share them with a link or embed them on your website. It's useful for product catalogs, presentations, educational materials, and digital storytelling.

Rap Video Generator turns a photo and a topic—or your own lyrics—into a short vertical rap video. Pick trap, boom bap, melodic, drill, lo-fi or hyperpop, a voice, and a 10 or 15 second clip at 480p or 720p. The song is included in the video price. Ten free signup credits cover a first song; video packs start at $9.99.

RemoveWatermarkVideo removes text watermarks, static logos and burned-in subtitles from video online, including moving and scrolling text. Upload an MP4, MOV or WebM, preview locally, then confirm the credit quote before processing. Free trial covers the first 5 seconds at up to 720p. Paid packs start at $9.90 for 500 credits; failed tasks return credits.

fandomgen turns any character into a deck of AI headcanon cards. Type a name, pick a tone (angsty, cute, funny or soft) and pull three cards in seconds. There are also generators for OCs, character backstories, fanfic prompts and ship names. Free, no account, and every card can be saved as an image.

Gfxlift is a free in-browser Roblox thumbnail maker: upload a game screenshot, add text, characters and borders, then export a 1920×1080 or 1280×720 PNG. No watermark, no account. Not AI; not affiliated with Roblox.

Upload a photo and a garment image, or describe an outfit, and preview the new look with your face and pose kept. One free 1K try for guests with no sign-up; more runs use one-time credit packs from $1, no subscription.

RapVidGen turns one or two photos into short AI rap videos with original rap vocals and a beat. Pick Solo or Duo, a style and a 5–15 second length, then download the MP4. Credit cost is shown before generating; pay-as-you-go packs, no subscription.

AI Clothes Swap is an AI clothes changer and virtual try-on tool. Upload a photo of yourself and one garment reference photo, generate a preview of you wearing it, compare before and after with a slider, and download the look. The first swap is free, no card is needed, and a guest preview works without signing in. Paid packs and monthly plans add more swaps.

Remove AI Label is a browser-local tool to inspect and clean metadata in images (JPG, PNG, WebP) and some videos (MP4/MOV). Files are processed in your browser with no upload and no re-encoding. The metadata core is free; an optional paid AI repair feature is available. It cleans file metadata only; it does not remove platform AI labels or invisible watermarks.

MusicLab is a Suno prompt builder for music creators. You describe the mood, instruments, vocal style and song structure you want, and it writes a structured style prompt plus sectioned lyrics with [Verse] and [Chorus] tags ready to paste into Suno. It is a companion to Suno rather than a replacement, made for people who want repeatable results. Free to use, with 500 generation credits on signup.

Look Atlas is an AI product photography studio for ecommerce brands that need polished catalog and campaign imagery. Upload a product photo and choose an AI director to guide the lighting, styling, composition, and setting. Build a consistent visual direction across Shopify product pages, seasonal lookbooks, and paid campaigns, with close attention to details like fabric texture, jewelry reflections, and product shape.

PlayableWorld AI (playableworldai.com) is an AI World Generator. Turn a sentence, a photo or a panorama into a playable 3D world you can walk through, then export it to Unity, Unreal or Blender. Worlds are built with World Labs Marble (Draft, 1.1 and 1.1 Plus). Export SPZ, PLY, GLB or a 360° panorama. The studio also includes image and video models; Google DeepMind Genie 4 is listed as coming soon / waitlist and is not playable here. 30 free credits, no credit card; a Marble Draft costs 20 credits. The free plan is for personal use; credit packs and paid plans add more generations and commercial use.

@stayboba/autoblog is a tested npm CLI and GitHub Actions pipeline that discovers trending topics, pulls live keyword stats, writes E-E-A-T articles, strips AI writing tells, generates cover art, and translates posts automatically.

DetectivePPC is a Google Ads audit and monitoring platform for PPC freelancers, agencies, and in-house marketers. Users connect a Standard or Manager (MCC) account with read-only Google OAuth. Each investigation covers 50+ dimensions across performance, keywords, ads, structure, tracking, bidding, targeting, and Performance Max. Audits typically finish in around 5 minutes and produce a health score, prioritized findings, and a white-label PDF. Every plan includes an AI Account Strategist with live chat, change detection, goal pacing, scheduled audits, a weekly recap, industry benchmarks, and a portfolio dashboard. Pricing: Freemium/paid plans from $39/mo (Basic $39, Pro $99, Business $199, Agency $499). 7-day trial · 1 free audit · Read-only access
GenVid is an AI video and image generator for ads and products. Create clips from text or photos with multi-model Studio, ad templates, daily free credits, and credit packs or subscriptions.

VideoDB lets an AI agent watch, search and clip video. Paste a link or upload a file, then ask. Your agent finds the moment, cuts the clip and sends back a link you can play. Works in Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor and any MCP client. Free to start: $20 of credits, no credit card.
