Petpedia AI Doctor is a multilingual AI assistant for everyday pet health and care questions. It uses your pet’s profile, photos and prior conversation history so guidance can stay consistent across sessions. The service offers triage-oriented information and is not a substitute for an in-person veterinarian; emergencies need a real clinic. Pricing is freemium: 5 free consultations per day after registration, with optional monthly plans and credit top-ups listed on the pricing page.

LLMFlyAI is an OpenAI-compatible API gateway for calling models from one endpoint. Change the base URL, API key and model ID in the OpenAI SDK, Anthropic SDK, Claude Code, Cursor or your backend. Model Plaza lists available models and input, output and cache rates. Signup includes credits for initial use, billing is usage-based, and one-to-one technical support covers setup and everyday API issues.

Image To Image is an online AI image-to-image generator and editor. Upload a JPG, PNG or WebP photo, describe the change in plain English, and get a new version that keeps your subject, layout and composition. Choose GPT Image 2 or Nano Banana models. One-time credit packs, no subscription.

Female Malfoy is an AI photo-to-portrait tool. You upload a clear photo, pick one of 36 fantasy scene templates, and it generates a stylized portrait with platinum hair, dark academy robes and castle-style settings. You can choose the image model and resolution (1K to 4K), add your own prompt or a second character, and turn the result into a short video. New users can try one image a day for free. It is an independent fan-art tool and is not affiliated with Harry Potter or Warner Bros.

Qstudy AI turns lecture notes, slides, and textbooks into study material in seconds: clear notes, practice quizzes, flashcards, songs, and explainers. It is built for university students who want to study faster and remember more. Try it free with 2 free generations a day, and unlock full access from $6.99 a month. Founded in 2024 by Charles Munonye, a physician and former medical student who built the study tool he wished he had.

MusicMint is an AI music generator for creators. Describe a mood or paste lyrics, pick a style, and get two takes in about a minute—vocals or instrumental. Chat, Quick, and Custom flows, lyric tools, covers, and lyric videos help you finish and share. Free plan is for non-commercial use; commercial rights follow the paid plan you choose.

VibeCost is a free, independent tracker of what AI app builders really cost: Lovable, Bolt, Replit, v0, Base44, Cursor, Windsurf and more. Compare plans, credit limits and what expires, with prices checked against each official pricing page. Free weekly price-change email.

ColabContent is a Boston AI consulting company, formed in 2020 and led by founder Brandon Rodriguez. We build custom AI systems that the client owns at handoff: the code, the prompts and the accounts. There are no per user fees and no hourly rates.

Work starts with a first piece built on sample data before any fee, or with the $499 AI-Ready Audit (money back) for an owner who wants the whole business looked at first. Custom systems start from $10,000, with a fixed fee for each phase and a written acceptance test before a phase counts as done. You can stop after any phase and keep what was built. Optional care after handoff is $997 a month and cancels on 30 days notice.

We have delivered 40+ builds (counted September 2026). For Jim Glaser Law we built five AI phone lines, one per advertising channel, which handled 3,787 calls (counted August 2026); Jim Glaser takes reference calls. We also built a practice platform for a law firm that holds 13,296 matters and reconciles client trust accounts every night (measured August 2026).

Audio Converter AI turns audio, video, and online media links into editable transcripts with timestamps, speaker recognition, and AI summaries. It supports 200+ languages for meetings, lectures, podcasts, interviews, captions, and reusable content.

Audio Cutter AI helps creators cut and clean audio using natural-language instructions. Users can find passages by topic, cut at exact timestamps, remove silence, split audio, and export clips without working through a complex timeline.

Video Transcriber AI turns uploaded video, audio, and online media links into editable transcripts with timestamps, speaker recognition, and AI summaries. It supports 200+ languages and is designed for creators, students, researchers, and teams.

Agent Coach is a free coach for AI agents. Search a library of agent skills, MCP servers and prompts that passed a security scan (prompt injection, malicious code, secret leaks) at a pinned commit, get recommendations matched to an agent's goal, and run daily check-ins that say what to keep, mark temporary or remove. Remote MCP server with 13 tools plus a REST API (OpenAPI). Operated by Avatar 8 LLC.

Put Me In is an AI meme video generator. Upload a photo and Put Me In turns you, your friends or your pet into a trending meme video, up to 15 seconds. From $4.99 a video, no subscription. Pick a trending template, upload a photo, pick a quality and download the video. Works in the browser on phone and desktop.

In screenshot, image, and PDF directories, Pinumo is a capture utility for Chrome, Edge, and Windows. Take a visible page, a selected area, or a full webpage, and on Windows capture desktop apps as well. Keep shots in a collection, then save PNG, JPEG, or a ZIP, join images side by side or vertically, annotate, run local Chinese and English OCR, or export a standard A4 PDF with automatic pagination for long shots and no watermark or daily limit. Work stays on your device. Everyday tools are free. Not listed as an AI product.

VozQI connects small businesses, their accountants and their customers. Log sales, payments and expenses in seconds, see who owes you, send quotes and receipts by WhatsApp, run payroll and keep your books up to date. VozIA, the built-in AI assistant, turns a voice note, text or photo into a ready-to-save entry. Web, iOS and Android, free today.
Each stack lists the tools, steps, automation split, risks and a plain-English explainer. Revenue is checked against TrustMRR/Stripe where possible.

Best AI for Agents is an independent directory of 81 AI tools for real estate agents, grouped by job: listing copy, CRM and lead follow-up, virtual staging, video, CMAs and more. Each listing shows only pricing checked on the vendor's official page, plus comparisons, practical guides and a free weekly newsletter.
Xiaofang AI News is a Chinese-language AI news site covering the latest from OpenAI, ChatGPT, Claude and Grok, plus membership top-up guides with code redemption and 30-day support.

Earshot AI is an iPhone translator for people who want to retain the original alongside the translation. Translate typed text, speech, photo text, TXT and PDFs with extractable text, save records locally, and export bilingual or translation-only PDFs. The translation model is included and translation content is processed on-device.

Requires iOS 17 or later. US$4.99 once, with no app account, subscription, in-app purchases or ads. Speech features depend on the device, language and installed Apple resources. Scanned and password-protected PDFs are unsupported.

The bundled HY model licence excludes use in the EU, UK and South Korea, including travel there. The app is also unavailable in mainland China's App Store.

Submitted with AI assistance on behalf of maker Chupeng Sun. The website includes an actual fictional English-to-Chinese example and a separate 85-second workflow video from development 1.0.1(19) in iOS 27 Simulator. Physical-device performance and general translation accuracy are unmeasured. The unedited longer sample contains a wording error and regrouped paragraphs, disclosed beside the PDF.
CleanAudio removes noise, filler words, silence, stutters, and background music in your browser. The same tools also work from Claude or Cursor through a hosted MCP. Free to start.

U-Deco is an AI interior design service. Upload a photo of your room, pick one of 45 styles (Scandinavian, loft, japandi, organic modern and more) and in about a minute you see how your own room could look — useful for checking wall colours, furniture and layout before buying anything or starting a renovation. Works in the browser (including iPhone Safari, no install) and as an Android app in RuStore. Interface in Russian; 2 free generations to try.

Revnu is an AI agent that runs growth experiments for businesses. It finds potential customers, researches the right people, runs approved outreach, publishes search content and operates approved ad campaigns. Founders receive results and approval requests in Slack or iMessage. Pro is self-serve at $99 per month; Managed includes a dedicated growth engineer and is custom-priced.

UnoRouter is an API gateway for SaaS builders that need reliable access to every major AI model without a contract per provider. One OpenAI-compatible key covers GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek and Qwen, and a provider outage fails over to a healthy route on its own. Free models are included with no card, paid usage is pay-as-you-go, and the full stack is open source for anyone who wants to audit or self-host it.

AI Face Swap Live is a browser-based real-time webcam face-swapping tool for creators and streamers. Use portraits you own or have permission to use, switch characters, record short clips locally, and capture the browser window in OBS. AI processing uses paid credits, with subscriptions starting at $9.90 per month and one-time credit packs available.

NameOk is a free AI-powered brand and domain name generator. Describe your idea and instantly get creative, brandable business names with real-time domain availability checks across .com, .ai, .io and more. Perfect for startups, side projects, and new products.

IAIS Website Audit provides free automated homepage checks for common metadata and technical configuration issues. Businesses can also purchase a £29 Website Intelligence Report with explanations, prioritised findings, practical recommendations and a passive review of AI-related exposure indicators.

MP4toSRT creates subtitles from compatible audio and video with Whisper processing, then lets users edit and convert subtitle files. It is designed for creators who need a straightforward way to produce captions for videos, podcasts, and other media.

BirdApi is an OpenAI-compatible AI API gateway for GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, GLM and Kimi. Group rates relative to official pricing: GPT 0.14x-0.4x, Claude 0.4x (Kiro) / 0.9x (CCMAX) / 1.2x (enterprise CCMAX20x, no prompt injection), Gemini from 0.3x, Grok from 0.25x, DeepSeek/Kimi 0.4x, GLM 0.5x. GPT Image supports 4K. Online top-up and a dedicated long-task endpoint. Sign up: https://birdapi.up.railway.app/r/MILY

WattlePing is trade management software made in Perth for Australian trade businesses. Manage enquiries, customers, quotes, follow-ups, jobs, scheduling, tax invoices and overdue reminders in one system. Customers can accept quotes from a link and pay card deposits directly to the business’s own Stripe account. WattlePing includes trade-specific setups, reporting, AI-assisted administration and approval-controlled workflows. Plans start at A$49/month, GST included, with a 7-day free trial and no card required.

AI Pose Gallery helps artists find pose references and generate a new pose from a photo or pose alone. Gallery browse/download is free; generations use one-time credit packs. Not an AI video generator.

Type a job title and see a 2026 AI-exposure score (Microsoft Research, Tomlinson et al., CC BY 4.0; we are not affiliated with Microsoft) plus worldwide hiring-demand direction from the SHIFT Labour Demand Index, Edition 1. Exposure is not a layoff. Free, no account.

Short3D is a text-to-animation tool for vertical cartoon shorts. A story or topic becomes a 9:16 animated short with outlined 2D cartoon characters inside lit 3D scenes, depth of field, and a moving camera. Output is MP4 at 720x1280 and 30 fps, with AI voiceover and burned-in captions. Rendering runs in a desktop browser using the computer’s GPU; the tab needs to stay open, and mobile is not supported yet. Official pricing lists one-time USD credit packs: Starter $4.99 for 20 credits, Creator $12.99 for 60, and Studio $34.99 for 200. Credits are spent on voiceover generation and never expire.

Gemora is a personal AI for talking through your days, thoughts, and relationships. It remembers context over time, recaps your days, and surfaces patterns and insights, so conversations feel more personal the longer you use it. Not roleplay, not therapy — a companion for real life.

Make a short music video from a photo of yourself or your pet. Tiny Desk AI offers a fixed singing performance for consenting adults and an original animal-band scene for cats and dogs. Both modes produce a portrait MP4 with audio, ready to download. It is a playful option for personal clips and pet content, not a custom-song or voice-cloning service. One-time credit packs replace monthly subscriptions. Independent of NPR and Tiny Desk Concerts.

MakeDogSing turns cat or dog photos into short AI videos without writing prompts. Pick a template for a pet concert, dance or comedy scene, upload one or two photos, then generate and download the clip. The concert includes original music. Template pages show video length and credit cost in advance. It uses one-time paid credits, not a subscription, and is designed for pet owners who want a playful clip rather than a full editing suite.
Puley plugs into ChatGPT and Claude to find local business leads, check live competitor ads and social stats, compare prices, and send page-change alerts. Free to start.
The all-in-one AI platform for marketing and sales. Content Engine makes the Reels and ads. Jessica calls, texts and books your leads. 7-day free trial.

Bicep Heart turns one clear photo of an adult into a 7-second, silent, vertical AI video in a bicep-heart pose. Sign in with Google, choose the classic or left-arm template, upload a photo you have permission to use, and download the clip to share. One credit per video; one-time packs start at $4.99, with no subscription. Failed generations return the credit.

Test My Reading offers multiple difficulty levels in English and Japanese. Basic tests need no sign-up. Pro ($8.99/mo or $49/yr) raises quiz/word limits, adds answer keys with source sentences, diagnosis on every result, and syncs Pro to the Chrome extension with a shared monthly AI quiz allowance (300/mo). Built for students and exam prep.

Hotel Lobby AI makes a 15-second rap duo video from two separate adult portraits. The pair performs together in an orange studio, with sound. Choose Original Rap for new AI voices and a beat, or Classic Remix for the classic performance and soundtrack. Download the MP4 in portrait or landscape. SD 480p uses 10 credits, HD 720p uses 20, and one-time credit packs start at $4.99.

AI virtual fitting room — upload a photo of yourself and pick a garment; the AI swaps the clothes in seconds and tries to keep your face, pose and background. 3 free changes a day, no signup, resets 00:00 UTC, 24 preset garments sorted by occasion. Uploaded photos deleted after 24h, never used to train AI. Credits 70 credits $9.99, 160 credits $19.99.
English shadowing app: turn any YouTube video, audio, or text into sentence-by-sentence speaking practice with instant AI pronunciation feedback. Free to try.

Ember brings together AI agents, your company’s documents and connected apps to support strategy, fundraising, sales and content creation. From business planning to lead intelligence, Ember helps you act on your priorities in one place. Ember is an AI team built for entrepreneurs and founders, combining multiple AI models, your company context and end-to-end workflows in one platform.

productName: the video creation tool on kling-4.art
description: Kling 4.0 is an online AI video generator. It supports text-to-video and image-to-video, equipped with omni-reference, keyframe adjustment and long-duration generation. With realistic motion and consistent visuals, it works well for shorts, promos, concepts and storyboards.

Tellcut is an AI motion graphics generator powered by Claude Opus 5.5. Describe what you want or drop in a screenshot, and Tellcut builds an animated video: app launch videos, product walkthroughs, animated data charts, logo reveals, social ads and explainers. Every frame is generated as code, so you can keep editing: select a shot on the timeline and ask by chat for a slower reveal, a new headline or a different ending, and only that part changes. Every version is saved so you can compare and roll back. Outputs 16:9, 9:16 or 1:1 videos up to 30 seconds and exports 1080p MP4. Start from ready-made templates and swap in your own images.

Create documents, spreadsheets and presentations. Bring in the apps you already use. Arrange tasks, notes, research and AI beside the work they relate to. Work independently or collaborate with your team, with local-first storage and AI that understands your project's context. Download Plexii for Windows and Mac at plexiidesk.com.

For developers building with AI coding assistants, AI Skills offers a curated catalog of agent skills across coding, design, and productivity. Listings are verified rather than scraped, so the install steps and descriptions match the source repositories. New skills are added as they pass verification.
Bengali tech news website (বিশ্বস্পন্দন) — phones, AI, gaming, calculators and tech tips in Bangla.

RestorePix AI is a browser-based photo enhancer for sharpening detail, reducing noise and upscaling images. It also offers old photo restoration, photo colorization and image extension. Upload a photo, compare the before-and-after result, and download it. Results depend on the source image.

productName: Cat Dancing Meme Generator Online — AI Pet Meme
description: AI Pet Meme turns one cat photo into a beat-locked dance party video. Vertical 9:16 with sound; hip-hop, disco, and viral dance styles. The cat dancing meme is one of the most shared pet video formats. Cats and dogs work best; clear face-and-body photos produce the most recognizable memes.

EzHomeo is AI-assisted homeopathy software for practitioners, clinics and colleges. The doctor records the consultation in the browser or the Android app. EzHomeo transcribes it, including mixed-language speech, structures the symptoms, suggests rubrics and prepares an editable case record. The doctor reviews every item and makes every clinical decision.

1,000+ doctors have registered and 5,000+ consultations have been completed (November 2026). EzHomeo also organised Hahnemann's National Homeopathy Case Taking Challenge 2026.

New accounts start with 10 consultation credits and no card. EzHomeo is made by Omnoryx Technologies Private Limited in Assam, India.

Ryter Pro is a browser-based AI humanizer and AI text rewriting tool that helps users make AI-generated drafts sound more natural in English. Users enter text, review the rewritten result, and make their own edits to preserve their intended meaning. Ryter also offers AI detection and text-processing tools to support writing and review. It can help writers, students, marketers, and content teams refine articles, emails, and website copy.

Create a personalized rap short from two portraits or one photo of both people. Choose a duo style, add names or an occasion, and review the credit cost before generating. Watch and download completed videos from your account.

Quotelinks is free US stock and ETF research with no sign-up or paywall. Every NYSE, NASDAQ and AMEX stock has an AI analysis page (bull and bear case, financials, valuation, key risks). It also has quote pages with interactive charts and financial statements, stock and ETF screeners with 50+ filters, stock comparisons, embeddable stock widgets, investing calculators and free JSON APIs for SEC fundamentals and exchange rates. For individual investors, students and site owners who want free stock data.

Mock Interview is a preparation workspace for job seekers. Choose a role or paste a job description, then practise a question by speaking or typing an answer grounded in your own experience. Review feedback on the structure, relevant detail and clarity of your response. Earlier answers and feedback remain in private history, making it possible to compare attempts. The free plan includes three completed answers per month. Pro adds more practice, longer responses and role-focused resume review.
Independent Tesla Paint Shop wrap tool, not Tesla-affiliated. Design on official templates, preview in 3D, export a PNG. Browsing and PNG export available; AI uses credits.

Lenormand Reflect is a multilingual Lenormand site with 36 original cards, twelve spreads, online draws, combination lookup, and optional personal AI interpretations. Guests can use meanings and standard spreads without an account.

Handwriting AI is a browser-based text-to-handwriting converter and printable worksheet maker. Choose from 100+ built-in handwriting fonts, multiple paper styles, formulas, images, and shapes, then export watermark-free JPEG, ZIP, or PDF.

SaaS Deal Spot is an independent publication for small businesses that reviews SaaS lifetime deals and software. Every review covers features, pricing, pros and cons, and who the tool is really for — so readers can decide before they buy. The site also publishes how-to guides and best-of lists, including email marketing, CRM, AI tools and analytics, all written for non-technical business owners.

FontKind AI restores your handwriting from an uploaded photo into a reusable personal TTF font, and can also create fonts from text descriptions or style images. Preview with your own words and download for cards, letters, and design work.

ViewMax Studio is a flexible alternative to VidRush AI: plan a story scene by scene, start shots from text or a reference image, refine one shot without redoing the whole video, and keep recurring characters consistent. One workspace covers text-to-video, image-to-video, voices and multiple models (Kling, Veo, Wan, Seedance, MiniMax). Free signup credits, no credit card.

BestSong is an AI song generator that turns a sentence or your own lyrics into a finished track with vocals, lyrics and arrangement in seconds, across 100+ styles from pop and hip-hop to lo-fi, country and synthwave. It does not stop at the first draft: the built-in studio splits any track into up to 12 time-aligned WAV stems, clones your singing voice for covers, generates melodies as MIDI and opens them in a piano-roll editor, and masters mixes to streaming loudness (-14 LUFS). Free browser tools (BPM Finder, Chord Finder, MP3 Cutter) need no account. BestSong is built for songwriters, YouTubers and content creators, game developers, podcasters and marketing teams. The free plan gives 50 credits a day (about 10 songs) for personal use; paid plans from $5.99/month add commercial rights, WAV export and longer songs.

BPM Finder helps DJs, producers and creators estimate tempo and key from a reference track. Core BPM analysis runs locally in the browser without an account. Detailed results include confidence, half-time and double-time alternatives, meter, waveform and beat positions. Estimates can be wrong on complex rhythms or changing tempos, so check important results by ear. Optional signed-in Studio features turn reference attributes into an editable music brief and support AI-assisted creation using account credits.

PixelToPrompt is an image-to-prompt generator, not an image generator. Upload a JPG, PNG, or WEBP reference (up to 8 MB), inspect visual signals such as subject, composition, lighting, camera, colors, art style, background, and mood, and generate copy-ready prompt text (including a negative prompt) that you can edit and reuse. Output styles include General, Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, Flux, GPT Image, Nano Banana, and Seedream, with short, detailed, or deep levels of detail. The tool is free to use, with no sign-up, no credit card, and no paid wall on the generated prompt.

SynthClear offers a free Remove AI Label tool at https://synthclear.com/remove_ai_label that strips EXIF, XMP, IPTC, C2PA and PNG text in the browser, with no upload and no account, for images you own or are authorized to edit. It helps with privacy and a clean client handoff; it does not replace disclosure rules and is not a way to evade AI-detection policies. A separate paid tool on the homepage removes Google SynthID watermarks ($1 per image or $9/month for 100 credits), only for owned or authorized images.

Upload a photo, pick a style, and RapClips writes the lyrics and turns it into a 15-second singing or rap video with vocals, beat and lip sync. Great for selfies, pets and social posts. From $9.90 per video.

TextScope is a free browser-based toolkit for writers, editors, students, marketers, and developers. It combines word and character counting, Flesch readability, keyword phrase frequency, SEO title checks, reading and speaking time estimates, case and URL slug conversion, AI-output Markdown cleanup, and estimated LLM token counts. Text processing takes place locally in your browser; no account is required.
Monitor AI API relays with uptime, latency, model-fingerprint checks, public history, scoring methodology and on-demand self-test / speed / IQ suites.

Pick the faces that catch your eye across eight sets of fictional portraits and get a free type card showing the visible-feature patterns behind your picks, with real counts. Also a face shape finder, face symmetry test and golden ratio face calculator. Free, no sign-up, adults 18+.
Ovanto is a free AI image generator and photo editor that runs in the browser. Users can create or edit images without creating an account or installing software.
CharaAI is a Japanese anime and 2D AI avatar generator for SNS, VTuber and original characters. Users can create icons and characters without writing English prompts.

KO Jumper is a free arena brawler by Kirouff Games. Three or four fighters shove, hit and block rivals on a changing LED floor. The last survivor wins. It includes online matches, private rooms, labelled bots, practice, daily challenges and unlockable characters. Browser and iPhone players share online matches. The iPhone version, Knockout Jumper: Brawl Royale, also includes offline bot practice with no ads or in-app purchases: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/knockout-jumper-brawl-royale/id6829604403 . AI assisted development and some promotional assets.

Tidykit helps turn everyday pictures into usable assets for online shops, presentations and social posts. Its image tools remove backgrounds, produce pure-white backgrounds, convert raster logos to SVG/PDF/EPS, use AI for complex background removal, and generate avatars from a photo. Users can preview results and download a small image of about 500 by 500 pixels for free. Full-size downloads use prepaid credits starting at $4.99 for 20 credits. There is no subscription or automatic renewal. The website states that original uploads are not saved and result files are private and deleted after 24 hours.

SongReelAI turns your lyrics into complete songs with AI. Paste verses or a chorus, set style, mood, and vocal direction, then generate a playable track you can preview, download, and keep building. Guests can try one free generation before signing in.
Biology.digital is a daily research intelligence hub and directory covering AI-driven drug discovery, genomics, protein folding, and digital biology breakthroughs.

RapYourPhoto, at rapvideoai.xyz, turns a single photo into a short AI-generated rap music video for TikTok, Reels and similar apps. Upload a portrait, start the generation, and get a shareable clip. Not affiliated with rapvideo.ai. Free or trial path available, paid options for more clips.

Christmas PFP Maker is a web tool at christmaspfp.org that turns an ordinary photo into a festive Christmas profile picture. Upload a portrait, pick a Christmas-themed look, and get an avatar for social apps and chat. A free path is available; paid options may apply for extra generations.

AuraShot is an AI dating profile photo generator. Upload recent selfies, pick everyday scenes, and generate profile-ready photos for apps like Tinder, Bumble, and Hinge. One-time plans from $29; no subscription.

Sevli is an AI image editor for simple photo edits by text instruction. Upload a JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF up to 10 MB, describe changes, compare versions and refine. Includes text-to-image, background removal, photo-to-cartoon, headshots, multiple models and free starting credits.
CNIPA.AI assists patent practitioners in preparing editable drafts, searching patent documents and creating drawings for review.
Patent Task helps users prepare editable patent drafts and drawings from technical disclosures and search patent documents for professional review.
OA Review helps patent practitioners prepare editable response drafts with remarks, claim amendments and source citations for professional review.
Open-source AI snipping tool for Windows, macOS and Linux. Screenshot a formula and get LaTeX, a table and get Markdown, text via OCR, an image described in words, or a code snippet explained.

ClearRemover is a browser-based AI photo cleanup tool. Upload a JPG, PNG or WebP image (up to 20 MB), brush over whatever you want gone - a photobomber, a date stamp, power lines, a trash can - and the AI fills the area with background that matches the rest of the picture. Only the brushed area changes, and you can compare before and after with a slider before downloading. A separate mode removes the background automatically and exports a transparent PNG for product shots, profile pictures, stickers and slides. It works on phones as well as desktop. You can start without an account: you get 2 free images a day, plus 2 more after signing in with Google, and downloads carry no watermark. Uploads are stored privately, deleted automatically within 48 hours, and never used to train AI models.

Hotel Kitchens helps travelers find hotels with kitchens and kitchenettes they can actually cook in. Every listed room must have a real cooking surface (a microwave alone does not count), and each one is checked by a person and an AI model, with the room-level evidence shown on every listing. Browse hotels with kitchens by city and state across the United States.

Aethely is an AI receptionist for small businesses and law firms. It answers every call 24/7 in your business name, says it is an AI assistant, answers common questions from information you approve, takes caller details or legal intake, books jobs and texts or emails you a summary of every call. For law firms it never gives legal advice and flags urgent matters to a lawyer right away. You keep your existing number and forward missed or after-hours calls. Built in Edmonton, Alberta and billed in Canadian dollars, with plans from $19/month and a 14-day free trial.

FindInvestors is an AI investor outreach platform with a 720,000+ investor database of VCs, angels and family offices across 149,000+ firms. Founders generate personalized pitches and decks, then run timed follow-ups from their own mailbox until investors reply. Unlike static investor lists, it combines targeting, pitch generation and follow-up sequencing in one place. Permanent free plan, with paid tiers from $39/month.

InsightFuse is an AI PR agent that finds the right journalists in a 799,000+ contact database, writes each one a personalized pitch, and sends it from your own mailbox. It reads replies and follows up automatically, so outreach runs from your existing email address rather than a black-box sender. Unlike blast-style PR spam tools, every pitch is individually written and sent. Permanent free plan, with paid tiers from $29/month.

EbookMagic is an AI ebook generator for marketers, coaches and course creators. Enter a topic or outline and it produces a complete, designed, ready-to-sell ebook — cover, chapters and landing copy included — in minutes. Unlike generic text generators, it handles the whole publishable package, so the output is a product you can sell or use as a lead magnet. Free to try, with paid plans for volume publishing.

Cooper Email gives AI agents their own real email inboxes: one API call creates an inbox and key, with REST, signed webhooks, threads, search, a hosted MCP server and optional owner approval before mail goes out. Free plan with 5 inboxes.

FBVerse Bot is a Windows desktop application for automating Facebook Marketplace work. It is built for sellers who manage many listings and need to post, renew and manage ads across multiple Facebook profiles, cities and product niches without repeating the same manual steps every day.

The software posts new Marketplace listings, renews expired ads, and schedules posts across multiple profiles. Each profile runs in an isolated browser profile, and posting follows human-like pacing, so activity is spread out rather than fired in rapid bursts. It supports the listing formats of the major Marketplace categories, including vehicles, property and rentals, home and repair services, and general e-commerce items.

Recent modules include an instant hotkey for listing renewal, an AI auto-reply for Facebook Messenger that answers common buyer questions and captures contact details, a specialized vehicle lister with VIN decoding, mileage, transmission, body style and title status fields, and image preparation tools for listing photos. 

FBVerse Bot is a desktop program, not a browser extension or a web dashboard: it runs on a Windows machine and drives the browser locally. Setup involves adding your Facebook profiles, preparing your listing content and images, and choosing the categories and locations you want to post to. From there, the posting and renewal routines run automatically according to the schedule you configure.

The software is commercial. A free demo is available on request via WhatsApp so you can see the workflow before buying, and continued use requires a paid licence. It is aimed at professional resellers, dealers, agencies and lead-generation teams who treat Marketplace as a serious sales channel and need their listings to stay live and current across many accounts at once. Listing content can be prepared once and reused, so a whole inventory stays current with a fraction of the daily effort that fully manual posting would take.
Communication infrastructure for businesses, creators and their AI agents.

Mivee is a calorie and protein tracker for Android and the web. Log meals with photos or manual entry, explore recipes for vegan, vegetarian and all-food diets, and track water and daily nutrition. The free plan includes manual logging, calorie and protein tracking, recipes, water tracking and one AI food scan per day. Optional Premium adds unlimited AI scans, meal planning, shopping lists and more nutrition insights.
Image editing, PDF tools, text and SEO helpers, developer utilities, calculators, media tools and quick games — plus CraftSprint AI to find the right tool for you.

Turn text or a reference image into looping AI GIFs, stickers, reactions and pixel art. Watermark-free output. No subscription. Verified accounts can claim one-time free credits, with additional credits available as one-time purchases.

Agile Growth Labs helps growing teams take on more customers without another hire by installing Portable Delivery Intelligence (PDI), AI-agent workflows that ship real delivery outcomes with a person approving every output. Instead of a generic chatbot wrapper, we install complete systems on the tools teams already use: Newsletter, Video Clipping, Email, RFP and Ecommerce, plus the PDI layer that makes delivery portable across accounts. Proof: $7.5M+ in client growth across 12 companies · trained on $17M+ in revenue. Built for services firms, B2B and SaaS teams, AI companies and departments inside larger orgs that already have recurring delivery work.

Creepless is scope-creep software for agencies and freelancers. Each client gets a no-login request link. An AI referee checks every ask against the agreed scope: included work proceeds, extras become a quote the client approves first. Free for 2 clients and 20 AI checks a month; no card required.

Multi-tenant lead-generation SaaS for B2B exporters. It creates and monitors feed campaigns across Meta, Google and TikTok, targeting decision-makers by country, industry and job title, then funnels every inbound lead into one inbox with AI vetting and A-D grading.
Free YouTube transcripts with timestamps, no sign-up. Export TXT, SRT, VTT or Word, get an AI summary with chapters, or transcribe uploaded audio and video.

HalfPrice sells one-month, single-account AI subscriptions (ChatGPT, Claude, Google AI, X, DeepSeek API credit) paid in USDC, USDT or USDG. Finished accounts at about 50% of official price, top-ups at about 60%. Processed within 1 hour after payment, shown on the order page.

productName: fifty cents per extra photo text edit after the free first one
description: Edit Photo Text AI edits text that is already part of a photograph rather than adding a new caption on top. Upload a JPG, PNG or WebP up to 10 MB, type the words as they appear and what they should say instead, and the editor rewrites those words in a similar font, color, size and position. Remove mode erases listed words and fills the background. Translate mode rewrites lines into one of 20 languages and keeps brand names, logos, numbers and prices unchanged. The first edit is free; after that each edit costs $0.50. A $5 top-up covers ten edits. There is no subscription.

MeshShift converts 3D files (STL, 3MF, OBJ, GLB, STEP and more) right in your browser, with no upload and no sign-up. It also turns a photo into a printable 3D model with AI. Free to use, with one free AI model per day and paid plans above that.
An unofficial Claude developer guide with current model docs, Claude Opus 5.5 migration notes, Claude Code tutorials, API workflows, and best practices.

AI Crawl Score is a free website-readiness checker for site owners, developers and SEO teams. Enter a URL to inspect up to five public pages for crawler policies, indexing directives, sitemaps, metadata, raw HTML and JSON-LD. Each finding explains its technical evidence and limits. No signup is needed. The scanner does not ask AI engines buyer questions or guarantee rankings or citations. Optional AnswerReady reports include a $79 Fix Kit or a $249 audit with AI-answer checks and an action plan.

Unprompted Topic is a free web app for practising thinking on your feet. Generate a random topic from a hand-written bank of 470+ prompts in five categories — general, persuasive, creative, debate, and professional — then prep and speak against a timer. Prep can be 15, 30, or 60 seconds; speech can be 1, 3, or 5 minutes. Topics do not repeat until you have seen every one in the selected category. There is no account, no sign-up, and no limit on how many topics you can generate. It is built for speaking clubs, language classes, interviews, and writers who need a blank-page warm-up. The prompts are hand-written, not generated by AI.
Organize photos, videos and motion photos locally with AePix: albums, smart collections, combined filters, semantic search and optional AI image tools.

SlayMyLook is a web app for creating AI portraits with your own facial identity. Choose a visual template and add one to three reference photos. For images, you can ask to change the pose, background, or lighting. You can also personalize selected video templates while keeping the original audio. New users receive 16 one-time welcome credits after Google sign-in, enough for up to four Fast images. Additional credits are available in one-time packs.

TaskBullet Hub (https://taskbullet.com/hub) lets AI agents hand off work needing a real person through MCP (npm @taskbullet/mcp-server; https://taskbullet.com/api/mcp). Agents supply phone-call questions and get structured answers and wrap-up notes. Calls cost $2.50 for the first minute (minimum), then $1 per additional minute. US-managed virtual assistants handle last-mile tasks, physical-world work, logins, one-time codes, and QA. Founded in 2013, US-based.
One API key and one prepaid balance for the models, data APIs and skills your AI agent needs. Pay per call, no subscription. Card auto top-up, USDC and x402. Works with Claude Code, Cursor and Codex.

SteerLatch connects MCP-compatible AI assistants to a local agent installed on macOS or Windows. The owner permits selected actions on files, browsers, keyboard, mouse and terminal, and can revoke authorization or stop operations. The public beta offers 1,000 MCP tool calls once for up to a month without a credit card. Test using non-sensitive files; screenshots and outputs can pass through the chosen AI service and relay.

Plan, build and market an online business with one connected AI team. B.R.A.I.N.E.R. gives solo founders an AI CEO plus Engineering, Writing, Marketing and Outreach specialists that share company context. The CEO researches the market, maintains the roadmap and task board, and asks before sensitive actions. Engineering builds websites and checks pages in a real browser; Writing creates and publishes blog articles; Marketing prepares social posts and visuals; Outreach finds relevant contacts and drafts personal emails. Founders set direction and approval boundaries and can review recorded work. Growth includes full apps with sign-in, custom domains, automatic publishing to X, LinkedIn and Facebook, Meta image ads, and outreach sending from your own mailbox. Starter is $39/month with 1,500 AI credits; Growth is $79/month with 3,000 AI credits. Credits cover AI execution, not external advertising spend.

CanvasForAgents is a shared public 1,000 × 1,000 pixel-art canvas that AI agents can paint through MCP. Connect an MCP-compatible agent, choose a design and region, and watch the artwork take shape on the live board. An account is required to connect. Everyone gets one reusable pixel, which refills after five minutes; extra reusable pixels cost $1 each as a one-time purchase.

A personalized song gift with their name in the chorus, written from your story. Hear two versions free in minutes, then keep the one that sounds like them. Type their name and a few real details (how you met, the inside joke, the nickname), pick genre, tempo and voice, and two sung versions come back in one to three minutes. Unlock one to get both MP3s, the lyrics and a gift page with a QR code. One song is $9.99, three are $19.99, paid once with no subscription.

A free, browser-based self-check for service businesses that accept appointments or quote requests. Walk through eight manual checks on a public route, record what you observe, then download your notes or build a prompt for an AI assistant you choose. This tool does not inspect or change websites, call an AI model, send your notes to iTeam, or predict bookings. No account, upload, or API key.

We built TailGPT for businesses whose website is where enquiries start: clinics, coaching institutes, real estate firms, travel agencies. Paste one script tag and an AI agent appears on your site, no plugin needed. It reads only the pages you tick and any files you upload, so when someone asks "Are you open on Saturday?" the reply comes from your own page. If the answer is not there, it says so. Every fact it gives is checked against the source page. No AI is perfect, and we would rather you see that up front: test it in the dashboard and check which page each answer used. When a visitor wants to go further, it asks for a name and phone number and adds them to your leads list and Google Sheet. The dashboard also lists the questions your website doesn't answer, most asked first. It is not a helpdesk: it won't look up orders, book, refund or hand off to a person.

US stocks: the expected earnings move before the report, and what actually happened after. SIGNUM HQ is a US stocks app with an earnings calendar, the options-implied expected move, after-report scoring of the actual reaction against that range, alerts for the stocks you follow, and short AI summaries. Information only, not investment advice.

OmniaKey provides a unified AI API for developers building agents and applications. It offers OpenAI-compatible text endpoints and asynchronous image, video and music generation through one prepaid account. Developers can compare supported models and pricing, integrate with coding tools, and track usage in one dashboard.

WidgetCalc lets small businesses and agencies build ROI, pricing and savings calculators from ready-made templates and embed them on any website in minutes to capture leads. Built and operated by an AI-run company, Rock Software Oy.

NanoPic edits existing photos from a plain-language instruction instead of layers, masks or brushes. It can restore and colorize old prints, remove tourists and objects, swap product-photo backgrounds, change season or weather, restyle portraits as Ghibli, Pixar or anime art, and preview new hair colors or outfits while keeping the subject intact. Users pick GPT Image 2/2.5 or Nano Banana 2/2.1/Pro per request, and new accounts get 10 free credits with no card required.

Mons is a native iPhone and iPad terminal for developers who use coding agents on their own Mac or Linux host. Start work at a computer, continue the same persistent terminal session on iPhone, then use iPad when you want more room. Keep your existing agent accounts and tools.

The public TestFlight beta is available at https://testflight.apple.com/join/QrKBvj5S. A host that stays awake and online with SSH enabled is required. Setup instructions and an illustrated three-device workflow are at https://mons.cc/beta.html. Mons is a paid product with trial access; it does not include an AI model subscription.
Create personal tattoo concepts with AI, compare visual styles and prepare a clear reference for your tattoo artist.

PhotoRestore is an AI photo restoration tool that repairs scratches, dust, fading, and color loss, and sharpens faces while preserving textures. Slide to compare the original against the restored image. Every job generates three versions so you can pick the best one. It works on color and black-and-white photos (optional colorization), supports JPG and PNG, and exports in 1K, 2K, or 4K. Private by default.
On Lovart ME, a design agent sits at the center of Lovart AI. Type a brief for a poster, card or social graphic, or begin with an image, and the agent drafts the visual; a short video is optional.

YoAIRap is a web-based AI rap video generator. Add a photo of a person, a pet or a drawn character, type what the rap should be about, and the AI writes rhyming lyrics, picks a hip-hop beat and renders a 15 or 30 second video of the photo performing the song with vocals. Hot templates also remake viral rap memes such as Hotel Lobby with your faces (template clips are silent). Lyrics in 35 languages; watermark-free MP4 in 9:16 or 16:9 up to 1080p. Paid, from $4.99 per video.
WebTestNavi helps university students and job seekers prepare for Japan's SPI and Tamatebako web tests with practice questions, answers, explanations, and an AI photo solver.

AgentShed is a free site of plain-English guides to AI agents and automation for small businesses and sole traders. Each guide walks through a real workflow step by step, says what the tools cost, and flags what can break, so owners can hand repetitive work to an agent and keep the decisions.

GuanPalm is a browser-based AI palm reading tool for entertainment. Upload a palm photo to generate a magazine-style reading card based on traditional palmistry, with options in Traditional Chinese, Japanese and English. A free reading is available, with a paid deeper analysis option.

College Essay Checker is an AI grader for college application essays. Paste a Common App personal statement or a supplemental essay and, in about a minute, you get an overall score from 1 to 10 plus separate scores for hook, structure, voice, specificity, and grammar and style. The report names your strongest and weakest lines and explains why, lists the few changes to fix first, and gives notes on each area. The tool gives feedback, not rewrites: it does not write your essay for you. Essays are never published or used for training. It is an independent tool and is not affiliated with the Common App or any college. Your first review is free, with no account and no card; after that, one-time packs of 10, 30 or 60 reviews cost $9.90 to $29.90 and last a year, with no subscription.

TTSMint is a browser-based text-to-speech tool that converts written text into spoken audio. It offers AI voices for creators, educators and others making voiceovers or listening to written material. New users can try the service with introductory credits; paid options are also available.

Tooldex is an AI tools directory that sorts more than 500 tools by the job you need done: writing, images and design, video, audio and voice, coding, research, productivity, marketing, education, data, automation, business and AI assistants. Each of the thirteen categories comes with a short guide on what to look for before you pick a tool. What makes it different is that it tells you what is actually free. For the most popular tools, Tooldex reads the official pricing and feature pages and writes down the plans, the free tier and its limits, along with the pages it used and the date it last checked. A dedicated "Free AI tools" list only includes tools with a confirmed free plan, and editor's picks give one strong starting point for each kind of job. A "Latest AI tools" section is updated every few days from public launch posts. Every listing links to the tool's official site, and makers can submit a new tool. The directory is free to use with no sign-up.

Normal Map Generator turns a texture, photo or sprite into a full set of material maps right in your browser: normal, height, roughness, metallic, ambient occlusion, edge and packed ORM. Drop in a PNG, JPG or WebP, tune maps on a live 3D preview (material ball, sphere, cube, your own .glb, .gltf or .obj model, and studio, outdoor or night lighting), then download a ready-made set for Unreal Engine, Unity, Unity HDRP, Godot or Blender, or every map separately. The free maps are made on your own device, so nothing is uploaded, there is no sign-up and there is no limit. Transparent sprites keep their outline, which makes it handy for 2D games with dynamic lighting as well as 3D materials. The free maps read height from brightness, which suits clean textures and sprites. For photos of real surfaces with shadows or mixed metal and non-metal parts, there is an optional AI texture set: an AI model built for PBR materials reads the surface and returns base colour, normal, roughness, height and metalness maps. New accounts get one free AI set; after that, one-time packs of 15, 50 or 150 sets cost $4.99 to $29.99 and last a year.

Photo to GIF is an online tool that turns a single still photo into a short animated GIF. Upload a portrait, a pet, a product shot or a drawing (JPG, PNG or WebP), describe in a few words how it should move, or tap a ready-made motion such as "wave hello", "blink and smile" or "wagging tail", and an AI image model draws eight new frames and plays them as a seamless loop. You don't need a video, extra frames or any editing software.

HeySupa is an AI-powered platform built to help behavioral health practices manage their everyday operations more efficiently. From administrative workflows and clinical documentation to revenue cycle management, HeySupa helps healthcare teams reduce manual work and spend more time focusing on patient care.

ChatNory is an AI chatbot for websites and WhatsApp. It learns from your website, files and price list, then answers customers on website chat, WhatsApp, Messenger and Telegram in Bangla, English, Hindi, Arabic and more. It hands over to a human when needed, can check orders and book slots, and sets up in minutes with no code or as a WordPress plugin. Free plan available.

AwesomeDevKit is a free collection of browser-based developer tools: JSON formatter and validator, cron expression parser, regex tester, UUID generator, plus GEO tools — an llms.txt validator and an AI crawler access checker for AI search readiness.

Tintmill helps visual creators generate images from text, edit photos and create short videos with a choice of AI models. Paid credits are shared across workflows. Eligible Google users can claim one free image, subject to a shared daily limit.

Transcribe Video: To The Text is an iPhone app that turns video files, audio files, YouTube and Vimeo links, and live microphone recordings into searchable text. It can split the transcript by speaker, summarize it, and export to TXT or DOCX. A free tier is available; Pro unlocks more transcription time via in-app purchase.
Free AI search/GEO audit: read-only checks of public pages, robots.txt and sitemaps, then score plus PDF/Markdown report after login.

AI Clothes Change is an online photo outfit editor. Upload a portrait, describe a look, add a clothing reference or pick a template, then compare and download the edit. Includes 1K/2K output, clothes color changer, suit photo editor, AI photo editor, AI video generator and single-person face swaps. Credits-based paid plans start at $29.90/month.

Hop Hop Hop Dance is a browser-based AI video tool that turns two photos into a silent eight-second vertical dance clip. Download an MP4 and add licensed audio in your social app. The site also explains the hop hop hop trend and how to film it yourself. Free trial clip, then optional one-time credit packs; no subscription.

Whisk AI is an online workspace for AI image generation, reference remixing and image-to-video. Generate images from text, remix up to three subject/scene/style references, or animate a still image. Whisk AI is an independent creative workspace and is not an official Google Labs product.

Kling 4.0 AI is a browser-based AI video generator on kling4.pro for turning text prompts and photos into cinematic clips: text to video, image to video, text to image and Motion Control AI. Freemium with free signup credits; paid plans from $19.9/mo. kling4.pro is an independent product and does not claim an official Kuaishou Kling 4.0 release.
Upload one photo and get an AI holiday portrait of you, your family, your partner or your pet. Christmas is live with 20 looks. First photo free, no watermark. After that, each photo costs 1 credit.

Stitchidy is a Windows 10/11 desktop organizer for machine-embroidery designs. Turn scattered folders into a searchable collection, keep related sizes and formats together, and browse designs that fit your machine and hoops. Optional AI Smart Labeling identifies subjects and visible text in design previews, helping you find a birthday bear instead of remembering a filename. Original embroidery files stay on your computer; Smart Labeling processes previews online.

Try Stitchidy for free for Windows. The limited free version includes 100 manually labeled design families, three saved search tabs and 100 total family exports. Sign in to receive 50 starter Smart Label credits. A paid Full Version and additional Smart Label credits are available.
Aitopkit is a free AI tools directory with 203+ hand-reviewed tools, side-by-side comparisons, 439+ prompts, and daily AI news. No sign-up needed.

Meishiki is a free Japanese-language Shichusuimei / Four Pillars (命式) chart tool with English and Chinese versions. Enter birth date, time and place for a chart and short AI-generated reading, optional fuller interpretation. Cultural exploration only, not scientific/medical/investment advice.

Bazi Pan is a free online BaZi / Four Pillars chart calculator in Traditional Chinese with Simplified and English versions. Enter a birth date, time and city; solar or lunar input and optional true solar time. Get a free chart and short AI-generated reading, with optional fuller interpretation. For cultural exploration and self-reflection, not scientific, medical or investment advice.

AIGPTImage is an independent AI image studio for people who need usable visuals. Describe an image, or upload up to 16 reference photos to edit or restyle, and get one to four results in several aspect ratios. Output runs from 1K to 4K. The credit cost appears before you generate, and your history stays private. Built-in tools handle background removal, upscaling, old photo restoration and image-to-prompt. New accounts get 20 free credits. AIGPTImage is an independent service and is not affiliated with OpenAI.

AI Raphael (Raphael AI at airaphael.org) is a web-based AI image generator and photo editor. Type what you want, or upload a photo and describe the change in plain language. It keeps faces and characters consistent across edits, preserves the rest of the scene, and can blend several images into one. Extra tools cover background removal, upscaling, old photo restoration and image-to-prompt. It uses models such as Nano Banana Pro and GPT Image. New users get 10 free credits.
WaveMira turns photos and drawings into stylized images and short videos. Browse effect examples and input requirements in English or Chinese. Creating images or videos uses paid credits.
RapVideoGo is an AI rap video generator. Upload one or two photos, edit the lyrics, and it creates a short rap video with vocals and a beat. No filming or video editing needed.
Free online PDF tools — AI PDF summarizer, PDF to Word converter, CV builder. No signup required.

Infograph turns articles, AI answers, study notes and meeting transcripts into editable visual stories, diagrams and study guides. Students, educators, researchers and teams can organize dense material into clear visual explanations and refine the result before sharing. Saved material can be searched with source citations. Finished work can be shared by link or exported as images, PDFs, carousels and narrated videos. A free plan is available, with paid upgrades from $4.99 per month.

GenflowAI helps ecommerce sellers and marketers create product images, lifestyle scenes and UGC-style video ads. Reusable templates and a visual canvas connect creative generation steps, so teams can adapt workflows for new products and creative variations. A free plan includes limited credits, with paid memberships available.
OpenLinker connects, calls and coordinates AI agents. Order a service for a result, call agents directly, link MCP tools, or build multi-agent workflows. Hosted or open-source Core.

Sarnix is a browser AI appearance simulator with 12 filters: Bald, Bangs, Glasses, Hair Color, Blonde, Smile, Braces, Piercing, Age, Fat, Pregnant and 90s. Guests get one free AI result per day (resets 00:00 UTC). Sign-up adds 4 free credits. The 90s filter is always free in-browser. Credit packs are one-time ($4.99/30, $12.99/100, $29.99/250), never expire, and failed results are refunded. No subscription. Only use photos you have rights to, with consent from anyone pictured.

NotaGen is a browser-based AI music tool. It generates classical-style sheet music as real notation, and transcribes audio recordings (file upload or a YouTube/TikTok link) into editable scores. Export MusicXML, MIDI, ABC and PDF for MuseScore, Sibelius, Finale or Dorico. Built for composers, arrangers, teachers and students. Works best on clean solo piano and clearly separated parts. Pricing: freemium – new accounts get welcome credits with no card; playback, editing and downloads are free; new transcriptions use credits; paid plans from $9/month.

Genjutsu AI is an online video tool that recasts existing footage with your reference photos. Upload a source video or pick one from the community library, add the photos you want to use, and generate. A written prompt is optional. Motion Transfer keeps the original movement, timing, and camera while rebuilding the people and visuals from your photos. Object Swap changes one selected person, outfit, product, or object and keeps the rest of the shot as close to the source as possible. You can add one reference photo for each person, up to 10 photos per video.

AI Gov Library helps teams find practical materials for recurring AI governance work. Its task-based index covers use-case intake, vendor assessment, procurement, system inventory, and governance committees, with templates, checklists, and official references. The public index and core guides are free; an optional starter pack is a one-time paid download.

W Chews AI turns your selfie and a food photo into a funny food-reaction meme for social media. Choose W Chews for a winning bite or L Nibbles when dinner disappoints, then download a short clip ready to share. Each video is US$6.99, plus tax.
AI Kiss Generator turns two photos into a short AI kiss or hug video. It is consent-first and moderated, and is not an adult service.
AI Beat Video turns a photo plus a song or lyrics into a beat-synced music video. It also offers free lyrics, rhyme, and song-name tools.

Swift Remover is a free online AI photo cleanup tool. Upload a photo, brush over photobombers, tourists, trash cans or power lines, and AI fills the area with a matching background in seconds. 3 free removals a day with no sign-up; Pro credits (from $6.99, one-time) unlock our best AI model and watermark-free downloads. Works in any browser, including on phones.

FreeVideo AI is a focused MiniMax H3 video workspace with text-to-video, photo animation and first-and-last-frame generation. Eligible new Google accounts receive 60 one-time welcome credits valid for 30 days. Text tasks cost 6 credits; image-based tasks cost 8. Public output is silent standard-resolution MP4 footage. Submitted by the product team.

PixRoom is a native macOS app (macOS 14+) for browsing, organizing, tagging, rating and searching local photo and video libraries. Everything stays on your Mac: no cloud upload and no network permissions required. The free version covers folder organization, 1-5 star ratings, manual tags, hardware-accelerated video playback and fast browsing and search. An optional AI Upgrade ($19.9 one-time, no subscription) adds on-device natural-language photo/video search and smart tag suggestions. It is an organizer, not a photo editor, which makes it a lightweight Lightroom alternative for sorting rather than editing.

We built The Dragon's Day Off, a short English voice negotiation game. You have two minutes to talk Ember, a dragon on vacation, into toasting one slice of bread. No account, up to 3 free rounds per 24 hours, two hidden endings. Voice runs on the OpenAI Realtime API; nothing is recorded and transcripts aren't kept after the round.

Fancy Cafe AI turns two full-body photos, or one full-body photo plus an AI partner, into a short silent vertical clip of a first-time fancy-cafe scene, about 15-21 seconds. Every result is labelled AI generated. Exports are silent; add sound when you post. One-time video packs, no subscription: 1 video $6.99, 3 videos $16.78, 10 videos $41.94. Failed videos return 1 video. Photos should be full body, JPG, PNG or WebP up to 10 MB. No account is required to start. Contact: support@fancycafevideoai.com. A paid one-time purchase, not a free or subscription service.
A photo-to-video tool for the bicep heart gesture: upload a half-body photo. One-time packs from $6.99, no subscription.

Humanize Like Me rewrites AI-generated text so it sounds like you. Paste a sample of your own writing or take a short calibration, and it builds an editable voice card covering sentence length, formality, vocabulary and phrases you use or avoid. Paste an AI draft, pick a purpose and strength, and it rewrites sentence by sentence beside the original so you can revert or ask for alternatives. Numbers, dates, names, quotes and URLs are kept word for word. Free daily use needs no sign-up; a paid plan adds longer runs and more voice cards. It makes no promise to beat AI detectors.

AppStruct helps small teams build a focused business app and organize their work. In the visual builder, arrange screens, connect AppStruct tables, Supabase or an HTTP API, and configure form and record actions. AI can supply a starting page or component; connect and test the data and behavior in the editor.

AI video, image and music generation plus AI tools for backgrounds, 4K upscaling, photo restoration, subtitles and reframing. Free credits on sign-up.

Get your website reviewed by AI agents. Submit your URL and one focus area, and registered AI agents write structured reviews. Site owners, other agents and the public each rate usefulness separately.
