ieltswrites is a free IELTS Writing practice tool built around a 1:1 replica of the real computer-delivered IELTS Writing test: the question on the left, the answer box on the right, a live word count and a timer. Practise Academic and General Training Task 1 and Task 2 with the free question bank or your own topics. When you finish, the AI scores your essay against the four official IELTS criteria (Task Achievement/Response, Coherence and Cohesion, Lexical Resource, Grammatical Range and Accuracy) and gives an overall band, line-by-line corrections, synonyms and high-band vocabulary. Practice and the question bank are free. AI scoring is paid per essay, and new verified accounts get free scoring to try it. The band score is an estimate for practice, not an official IELTS result.

InfiniteTalk adopts sparse-frame dubbing. It syncs lips, facial expressions, head and body motions from audio while keeping characters stable. It supports image-to-video and audio replacement with no duration cap, ideal for courses, podcasts, corporate presentations and multilingual dubbing.

Club Spotlight Couple AI makes the viral La Tormenta de Arena club spotlight video (te he perdido entre la gente) from 2 photos, for couples, friends or pets. Fan-made and not affiliated with the band Dorian. Also available in Spanish. Paid, from $9.90 per video.

Outstanding Tiny Desk AI is a fan-made AI video maker for the viral Outstanding Tiny Desk meme. Upload 1 to 5 photos of friends, family or pets, choose who to replace, and get a 15-second 9:16 video in that meme style. Not affiliated with NPR. Paid, from $9.90.

Fancy Cafe POV is an independent AI video generator for people recreating the viral fancy cafe POV meme. Pick two photos, sign in with an email code, and generate an 8-second vertical clip. One-time video packs start at $5.99, with no subscription. The site also offers a free in-browser photo planner and meme guide.

MelodyKeep helps people turn memories into personalized song gifts for birthdays, anniversaries, and other occasions. The public site is a pre-launch preview: tell a story, generate original English lyrics within a free allowance, edit the words, and save a private draft. Full song generation, checkout, and MP3 downloads are not available yet. Planned pricing, once launched, is $19.99 for one song or Pro at $29.99/month for five songs. Contact: hello@melodykeep.com.

AI Rap Video Forge turns two photos and a creative prompt into short, vertical 9:16 AI rap performance videos for social media. It is a paid tool with one-time credit packs starting at $9.90 and no recurring subscription.

RapVid is an AI rap video maker that turns one photo into a lip-synced rap performance. Pick a viral rap effect, choose 5, 10 or 15 seconds, and generate a shareable rap music video with an original beat in minutes. No camera, no studio and no editing skills needed. Post it to TikTok, Reels or Shorts.

Independent, verified price comparison of 44 AI receptionist and AI answering services for dental, medical, legal and home-services businesses. Every price links to its source with the date we checked it, a public log tracks when vendors change pricing, and sponsored spots are labeled. Rankings aren't for sale. Free to use, no sign-up.
Prayer Song Maker turns a written prayer into an original AI song for faith, healing, and meditation. Free trial credits and one-time credit packs, with no subscription required.
AI Rap Generator turns a theme or mood into original rap lyrics and beats. Choose hip-hop styles, customize flow, and create tracks online. Free starter credits and paid credit packs.

ScorePredicts is an AI-powered football analytics platform combining machine learning, match statistics and live match data. It provides forecasts for match results, goals, both teams to score, corners and cards, alongside live scores, match events, fixtures, results and standings. Users can explore match statistics, lineups, referee profiles and statistics, and head-to-head records, while tracking historical forecast performance across more than 1,200 leagues.
FastMoro AI is an online AI creation studio: make images from text, edit a photo with a prompt, apply ready-made AI effects or bring a still image to life.

Travel Itinerary Template is a free online itinerary maker with 900+ ready-made trip plans across 96 countries. Edit day-by-day plans in the browser, then export to PDF, Excel, CSV, Google Sheets or a calendar (.ics) file. A free account is needed to download and print. Optional Pro ($5.99/mo or $49.99/yr) adds premium themes, and an optional AI chat helps draft trip plans.

Larkgrass gives you AI agents that each get their own Linux computer, memory, routines and connectors to your apps. They take on recurring work like research, email triage and reports, and ask for approval before risky actions.
Soundora is an AI music studio: create songs from lyrics or ideas, remove vocals and split tracks into stems online.
WhisperTranscript.ai turns interviews and long recordings into structured text for research and content teams.
WhisperTranscribe.ai converts podcasts, calls, and voice notes into clear transcripts with a freemium speech-to-text workflow.
AccurateScribe.ai turns meetings, interviews, and voice notes into editable text so teams can search and reuse spoken content in the browser.

PawLine helps people care for family pets and livestock with AI-powered answers, pet profiles, medication reminders and daily health notes. Use it to keep everyday care information together and prepare questions for your veterinarian. PawLine provides supportive information, not a replacement for professional veterinary care. Free to download; see the store listing for current offers, pricing and trial terms.
Create videos with AI Video Maker from text, photos or reference clips. Explore cinematic examples, choose a model and check credit costs before you generate. Paid plans from $14.9/mo.

Enaviya Meet is free video conferencing in the browser with no downloads. AI meeting notes, live captions in 100+ languages, recording, waiting room, polls, breakout rooms, webinars, and public booking pages.
Paid AI image generation and editing in the browser using text prompts or reference images, with upscaling, background removal, image extension, and SVG generation.

Seedream Best is an independent, third-party AI image studio that brings several leading image models together in one workspace. Switch between Seedream, Nano Banana and GPT Image for the same prompt and pick the best result. It supports text-to-image and image-to-image generation, selectable aspect ratios and output up to 4K (4096x4096). Use it for social media visuals, marketing creatives, concept art and illustrations. Credit-based pricing, and new users can start free. Not affiliated with ByteDance, Google or OpenAI.

AI Viral Video is an AI video template site for social media trends. Each template recreates a clip people are posting right now, such as Tiny Desk, Hop Hop Hop Dance or Dog Dance Crew, in the same frame, length and vertical 9:16 format. Pick a trend, upload one to three photos (solo, duo and pet templates), and get your own version of the trend. Pay per video with no subscription: a single video is $9.98, and packs start from $6.99 per video. Failed generations are refunded to your balance automatically, and uploaded photos are deleted after 30 days.

Mortmeter turns risks into time. Type an activity and see the odds it kills you (in micromorts) and what that costs in hours of life at your age and country. 87 sourced Atlas figures, labelled AI estimates for the rest, method and sources on every answer. Free, no signup, for fun. Beta, not medical advice.

Dola AI Hub is a browser-based workspace for generating AI videos, images and audio. Compare models like Seedance, Kling and Wan side by side, see the credit cost of each run before you generate, and start with 10 free signup credits. Independent product, not affiliated with ByteDance or the official Dola app.

ScanMySaaS helps SaaS founders building with AI coding tools check website exposure and review repository security. Paid plans add AI review of selected high-risk server files for potential missing ownership or role checks, with code evidence to verify. Website checks cover public headers, cookies, TLS, CORS and exposed files. Repository rules check committed secrets, dependency advisories, risky GitHub Actions and Supabase signals. Public repo scans are free; private repositories use a read-only GitHub App. Reports prioritize findings and provide coding-agent fix prompts. Automated findings require verification and do not replace human review or penetration testing.

ToHD is a free AI video upscaler that runs entirely in your browser. It turns 360p, 480p and 720p MP4, MOV or WebM clips into 720p or 1080p using Real-ESRGAN on your own graphics card through WebGPU, so the video never leaves your computer. No signup, no watermark, clips up to 10 minutes.

The Email Header Analyzer turns a raw email header into a clear report. Paste any header dump to map each server hop with delays, read SPF, DKIM and DMARC results, flag spoofing signs such as Reply-To mismatches, and get a plain-English LLM explanation. It runs in the browser, stores nothing and needs no account. Built for IT admins, deliverability work and anyone checking a suspicious Outlook or Microsoft 365 message. Published by MailboxInsights, which also covers Outlook, Microsoft 365 and email guides.

Free browser face analysis for a photo-geometry score, face shape, symmetry and related tools. Landmark detection runs on-device; original photos are not uploaded to our servers. Free core tools need no sign-up.

PSL Scale rates facial attractiveness with AI on the 1-8 PSL scale, where 4 is the true average - stricter and more meaningful than 1-10 scales. The AI analyzes 68 facial landmarks across 8 dimensions: symmetry, harmony, proportions, skin quality, facial structure, averageness, sexual dimorphism and memorability. Choose a Scientific breakdown or a Roast mode, get results in seconds, and receive a personalized improvement plan. Photos are never saved. Free evaluations available.

Trymusic AI (trymusic.ai) is a browser-based AI Song Generator and music toolkit for creators. Paste any text or lyrics and get professional-quality, royalty-free tracks in seconds. Beyond text-to-song, it includes Cover, Extend, Stems, and Remove Vocals, plus light music-analysis helpers like tempo/key tools. No install required — ideal for short-form video soundtracks, podcast intros, indie demos, and everyday creative experiments.
SameVid AI turns viral TikTok, Reels & Shorts trends into templates. Add one photo and get the same scene, moves and sound—no prompt needed.

Kaeso is an MIT-licensed AI gateway written in Rust and deployed on your own infrastructure. It provides OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs, SSO, roles, budgets, rate limits and request logs. Hosting and upstream model-provider usage are separate costs.

productName: Erase Traffic Signs using Ediroo AI
description: Urban photos often include traffic signs, parked scooters, or warning cones. Ediroo lets photographers highlight these fixtures and replace them with matching street textures. Check sidewalk paving and facades after each generation.

Crealo AI helps agencies, small businesses and marketing teams create content with artificial intelligence. It brings together tools for marketing copy, ads, images, videos, voiceovers and social media content in one platform.

AI image-to-video platform: upload a photo, describe the motion, and get a watermark-free HD MP4 in minutes. Six leading models (Grok Imagine, Kling 2.6, Veo 3.1, Vidu Q4, Seedance) share one credit balance. Pay per video with one-time credits that never expire, failures auto-refunded, free 15-credit trial without a card.

VOLT is built to notice moments: a fall, a possible fight, someone where they shouldn't be. VOLT detects possible handguns, long guns, and knives visible to the camera. A VOLT reviewer checks a moment by default before staff are notified.

VOLT is built to run on the cameras you already have. VOLT serves K-12 districts, colleges and universities, and other organizations.

Chato is a multi-number WhatsApp web inbox for businesses. Connect several WhatsApp numbers, let your team reply from one shared inbox, assign conversations, and turn on an AI chatbot that answers common questions automatically around the clock. Pricing is simple: €5 per WhatsApp number per month. Used by businesses worldwide, especially in Brazil.
CodeX Link provides web hosting, domains, website and app development, AI automation and digital marketing, plus a marketplace of premium digital tools and subscriptions at local prices.

Partiturmaker is a browser-based sheet music maker. Generate original classical-style pieces from a period, composer style and instrumentation, or convert recordings into scores. Five tools are free without an account: notation, piano sheet music, chord sheets, lyric sheets and music staff paper. AI generation, audio conversion and scanning use credits. Export ABC, MusicXML and MIDI.

CooperBuild AI is construction software for general contractors. Teams estimate once, then carry that estimate into the project budget, trade bids, submittals, pay applications and CRM, so every job runs from one workspace on web, iOS and Android.

Nebula is a fully autonomous AI security engineer that works for you. It finds security flaws, proves impact with working exploits, explains the fix and retests it once you have made the change.

Nebula tests web apps, APIs, mobile, cloud and AI systems. Each finding comes with evidence and reproduction steps, is mapped to OWASP and MITRE ATT&CK, and is scored with CVSS.

You can talk to Nebula over a call or by email, and it can walk you through its findings as slides in a live video meeting. Small and non-technical teams use it as their security engineer. Technical and larger teams use it to refine their research, loop through findings and understand each one in depth. Retests use credits.

BreachLine Labs is based in London, sells worldwide and is Cyber Essentials certified by CDS Defence & Security.

MyType Test is a free visual attraction quiz: choose women or men, then tap faces across eight portrait rounds to get a named, shareable type card. No account or photo upload; picks stay in your browser. An optional paid AI report is available; the core quiz and result stay free.

I Love The Smiths AI is a two-photo AI video tool for recasting the 'I love the Smiths' elevator conversation from (500) Days of Summer. Assign two authorized adult portraits to the headphone listener and speaker without writing prompts. The reference-guided workflow is designed to preserve the scene, dialogue and timing, with 720p or 1080p MP4 output. Photo selection is free; video generation uses paid one-time credits. It is an independent project, not an official movie or band product.

VidEraser uses AI to detect and erase watermarks, logos, hard-burned subtitles/text and timestamps from videos and photos you own or are authorized to edit. Photos can also erase objects or people. Free erase preview for eligible clips ≤2 minutes (preview cannot be saved); export when satisfied. Web + iOS/Android. Not a downloader and not for stripping marks from content you do not own.

BossCheck is a security scanner for indie game developers who build with AI coding tools. Vibe-coded games often ship with hard-coded Steam or Stripe keys, Firebase and Supabase databases anyone can edit, and multiplayer servers that trust whatever the client sends. BossCheck finds these issues and explains each one in plain English, with a paste-ready fix prompt for your AI tool. It's pre-launch: join the free waitlist, and read our free guides on Steam keys, Unity secrets and anti-cheat.

Shanshenbu Dance is a shan shen bu dance AI that turns one full-body photo of you into the viral flash step: you stand stiff, lunge sideways in a flash, snap back, then finish with a crouching back kick and a deadpan stare. Pick 5, 10 or 15 seconds, 480p or 720p, vertical or wide. You get an MP4 with no watermark in a few minutes, with no app and no sign-up. There is also a cat and dog version and a bear shake (狗熊哆嗦毛) effect. Pay per video from $4.99, or use credits.

AISongsMaker is an AI song workspace. Paste your lyrics or describe an idea, pick a style, and generate a full song with vocals. Each generation gives you two versions to compare, and eligible paid plans include MP3 and WAV exports. Free signup credits let you try it first; one-time credit packs and monthly or yearly plans are available.

ApiHub is a marketplace for AI model APIs, transactional APIs priced by usage, and MCP. Buyers compare API offers; sellers, partners and resellers can discuss onboarding and white-label terms with the team. AI access includes an OpenAI-compatible interface, provider comparison, project keys, spending limits and RUB usage billing.

Typo fixes spelling as you type in any app on Windows and Mac, locally on your device. English and Swedish are built in, with 19 optional starter language packs. Its Token language also trims filler from prompts in ChatGPT, Claude and other AI tools, with 10 levels you choose, and Backspace undoes any change. Free to start: 500 fixes a month for the first 3 months.

Pumli is an AI assistant for iPhone and iPad. Download a compatible model for local, offline conversations, or choose supported online services. Work with documents and explore ideas in one place. Search, connected tools and creative services can use the internet. Model requirements and optional provider charges vary.

prospy helps founders and small teams find relevant public conversations about their brand, competitors and customer problems. it brings keyword matches into one feed, with ai relevance and buying-intent scores, saved views, lead tracking and alerts. users open the original conversation and reply themselves; prospy does not automate posting or dms.

Image to Image AI Lab is a browser-based creative workspace for generating images from text, editing reference photos with written instructions, and turning still images into short videos. Creators can restyle images, change backgrounds, adjust visual direction and aspect ratio, and download their results. Projects are private by default, with account-based history. Eligible new users can try a starter generation; further image and video generations use paid credits from one shared balance.

MemeBoing is an AI meme video generator that turns a photo into a short vertical video. Upload a photo, choose a trending meme template, and generate a 6-second clip without writing a prompt or editing a timeline. It supports solo, friend, and pet templates, with 720p HD downloads and no watermark. Creators can use the videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, birthday memes, and playful social posts. Video generation uses paid credits.
CiteScope audits whether ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity can find, crawl and cite your product, with a report in 24 hours. $49 one-time audit, $19/mo monitoring.

Picvello helps people enhance photos, remove backgrounds, watermarks and unwanted objects, and restore old photos online. AI tools show a free watermarked preview first; full-quality download is paid. Compressing, resizing and converting images is free.

Tikpal brings conversations, reminders and personal memory across your phone, Mac and the web, with an optional Tikpal Voice device. It can draft calendar events and help create documents, slides and sheets. The site says account actions ask for your approval. The app includes a free daily allowance; Tikpal Voice is listed at $129.

Uplumo helps businesses and SEO agencies inspect brand mentions and cited sources in sampled AI answers. It brings AI visibility checks, Google rankings, technical site audits and recognised AI referral tracking into one workspace. Use it to review AI search evidence alongside website issues and decide what to improve next. Free and paid plans are available; paid tool access depends on the plan. Results are sampled and do not guarantee rankings or citations.
QIT deploys liquid-cooled GPU containers at powered sites and offers AI Model API with about 407 models, serverless QIT Pods, and reserved or bare-metal GPUs. GPU containers. Built for AI.

Create custom Twitch emotes from text or reference images. Emote Studio generates static PNGs or animated GIFs, with chat-size previews and downloads at 112, 56 and 28 pixels. New accounts receive 30 credits for one static emote; further credits are one-time purchases.

Diagnosed by AI is an AI-powered multi-agent medical diagnosis platform. People post ailments as public cases without an account. Multiple registered AI agents can respond to the same case. Responses are labeled AI-generated opinions. Humans can add comments and follow-ups.

Barsio creates rap videos from portrait photos. Choose a solo or duo, select a stage, add a topic or lyrics, and download an MP4 with vocals and a beat. Designed for personal greetings, creators and small businesses. Paid credit packs and monthly plans are available.

AgentLucidity is a public knowledge board where AI agents (sent by their human operators) share practical lessons: what worked, service comparisons, mistakes to avoid. Humans can read and search everything.

Upload a PPTX or PDF, pick an AI presenter and voice, and get a narrated slide-by-slide video with lip-sync — up to 40 pages / about 80 minutes in one render. Freemium with a free 6-page trial. For training, education, onboarding, and sales enablement.

Spicy Lab is an independent comparison and benchmark site from the SpicyAPI team. It tests AI image, video and chat models that allow mature (18+) content with side-by-side runs and publishes rankings and methodology, so readers can see which models perform best before choosing one. It is not a generator. Disclosure: Spicy Lab is run by the SpicyAPI team. Adult (18+) audience.

Questant helps Y1–Y12 learners practise English reading, thinking and writing through short stories based on science, maths and world events. Learners answer comprehension questions and explain ideas in their own words. AI supports content creation and preliminary feedback, while teachers confirm scores and notes before families see them. Parents can follow progress through reports. Questant offers a free plan with optional paid upgrades.

Nano Banana AI helps creators edit and generate images with text instructions. Typical uses: keep a character consistent across poses and panels, adapt lighting or style, replace backgrounds, and place products into new scenes. Results are meant for design drafts, social creatives, and marketing stills. Pricing is paid (yearly plans and credit packs shown on the site).

Image Describer is a free online AI tool that turns photos, screenshots, and illustrations into clear, detailed text. Choose from eight modes including general description, alt text, OCR, and image-to-prompt, with editable output you can copy or download. No sign-up required.
Free browser-based genogram maker with family symbols, relationship lines, and templates. Create family diagrams for therapy, genealogy, and counseling — no AI.

RapSongGen is a browser-based AI rap song generator for creators. Start with a theme or your own lyrics, choose a style and listen to two generated versions. Eligible verified users can try a generation subject to limits. One-time credit packs start at US$2.99.

Writivia is a college essay reviewer that gives structured, line-by-line feedback on clarity, structure, evidence and voice. It helps students revise their own work and does not write, replace or ghostwrite essays. A first review is free, with optional paid reviews available.
ScribeMedical.ai is an AI medical scribe that helps clinicians turn patient conversations into structured clinical notes and documentation.
AIGPTZero is an AI content detector that helps teachers, editors and writers review text for AI-generated patterns. Freemium.
Whisper AI Transcribe is an online AI speech-to-text tool that turns meeting recordings, interviews and media files into editable text. Freemium.

productName: Explainer Video Generator: one sentence to narrated MP4
description: Write one sentence about a product or idea and get a 15-60 second MP4 with script, narration, scenes, music and SRT subtitles. Landscape or vertical. Paid plans from $19/month. Not affiliated with Anthropic or Claude.
RapAvatar turns a photo and short prompt into a personalized AI rap video with original generated vocals. Create short, shareable rap clips from your pictures.
DescribePicture is an online AI tool that writes detailed descriptions of images and videos, extracts text from pictures and turns images into prompts you can reuse.

MemeRadar combines meme explainers, original-video references and Google Trends charts with photo-to-video AI generators. Read about the background of a viral clip, then upload a photo to make a short personalized remix. English and Chinese supported. Generation requires an account and paid credits. One-time credit packs start at USD 9.90 for 25 credits.

WordCountTool is a free online word counter and character calculator that counts words, characters, sentences, paragraphs, reading time and speaking time instantly as you type, using Unicode-aware processing. Six scientific readability formulas give a grade level for any draft. Around the counter sit 50+ free text tools: count words inside PDF, DOCX, subtitle (SRT) and spreadsheet (CSV/XLSX) files without uploading them, check keyword density and TF-IDF, compare two drafts, generate citations in APA 7th, MLA 9th, Chicago 17th, Harvard, Vancouver and IEEE, count AI tokens and estimate API costs, test typing and reading speed, and generate word clouds. All core analysis runs 100% locally inside the web browser — no text is uploaded or stored.

GrammarCheck.site is a free writing workspace with 69+ grammar, spelling and readability tools — built for students, researchers, marketers and anyone who writes in English. Paste a draft into the editor and get instant feedback: grammar agreement, punctuation, homophones, clichés, tone, sentence variety and readability, all checked against 25 named writing dimensions. Six readability formulas, an AI sentence rewriter with 6 modes, Hemingway-style highlighting, citation generator (APA, MLA, Chicago, Harvard), AI writing detector, tone checker and thesaurus. Everything runs client-side in the browser: text is never uploaded or stored. No signup, no account, no paywall — 100% free forever.

Revision Triage is a free browser tool for freelance video editors handling client feedback spread across messages and email. Paste notes, review uncertain timecodes and repeated notes, edit tasks and status, and export a Markdown handoff or CSV/text audit with the original wording retained. A free offline kit and local project backup/restore are included. No account, footage upload or AI API is needed. Processing runs locally; the online host receives ordinary page requests. Optional $5 support unlocks nothing. Submitted by the builder; this beta was developed with AI assistance.

Movmix is an AI video and image generation platform for creators and marketers. You pick from pre-tuned templates — product ads, anime-to-video, fashion, AI dance, social media clips — and generate cinematic results. It supports Text to Video, Image to Video, Reference to Video, Video to Video, Video Extend, AI Motion Control, AI Recast and an AI Video Editor, plus Text to Image, Image to Image and an AI Image Upscaler. It includes models such as Kling, Wan, Seedance, MiniMax, GPT Images and Nano Banana, and is designed to help keep characters more consistent across clips.
Approval inbox for AI agents. Review the exact command, diff or email draft, then approve or deny with feedback from terminal, desktop or phone.

Creators drop two face shots (or one duo photo), pick a vocal language (EN/ZH/JA/KO), and get a short Migos-style rap performance with a fresh beat, no blank prompt required. Six stages cover studio and party looks; export 9:16 for Reels/TikTok or 16:9 for YouTube. A creative AI tool that ships a finished MP4, not just an image.

Octuo is the one place to run the agents you already use — a coordinator and unified entry point for heavy agent users. You state the goal, it prepares the work, hands each part to the right agent (Claude Code, Codex, MCP tools, browser and files), and follows up until it is done; long jobs keep going after the chat closes. Canvas views, a visible and editable memory graph, and an encrypted Secrets Vault the model never sees. The work runs on your own Mac (macOS 15+, native, signed and notarized); tool calls require your own Mac. An iPhone companion (iOS 18+) shows everything the Mac side sees and lets you answer decisions and tick off checklists on the go, though without a Mac it cannot run tool calls. Plans from $20/month; 1,000 trial credits, no card required.

ShangTuCe AI helps ecommerce sellers turn product flat-lay or mannequin photos into on-model images, detail shots, and product videos in about three minutes. Unlike general image models, it treats garment outline, print, stitching and silhouette as hard constraints and only regenerates body, skin and lighting, targeting 95%+ fidelity. Pay per image (about 0.2–0.4 CNY), no monthly seat fees. Browser-based with REST API and MCP for batch workflows. Known limits: occluded hands, sheer fabrics, strict stripe alignment, brand campaign hero shots.

Teachers and parents upload a landmark, pet or family photo and get a clean printable coloring sheet. Choose Simple, Standard or Rich detail and Classic, Cartoon or Light Tracing style; export A4/Letter or PDF. Also converts images to line art and generates pages from text. Free trial credits.

ScrapeAtlas is a social media data API for developers and AI agents. It returns public profiles, posts, videos and conversations from 49 social, commerce and messaging platforms as structured data through a REST API, an MCP server and a CLI.

Clarpex is an online AI photo fixer for the photos people actually have: soft phone shots, low-resolution images, scanned family prints and black and white pictures.

Upload a JPG, PNG or WebP (up to 20 MB) and pick the tool for your problem: enhance photo quality, sharpen, unblur, remove glare from glasses and glass, unpixelate, upscale to 2K, 4K or 8K, convert to HD, restore old photos, colorize black and white photos, change the background, or make AI images look like real photos.

Every result opens in a before/after slider so you can compare it with your original before downloading, and the credit cost is shown before you start.

Everyone gets 10 free credits every day with no sign-up and no watermark. Paid plans start at $9.90 a month, and one-time credit packs never expire. Photos are only used to create your result, never to train AI, and are deleted after 24 hours without an account.

Multi-model OpenAI-compatible API on Cloudflare Workers (https://n3mak-gateway.n3mak.workers.dev/v1). Free /trial in Telegram @N3mak_bot (24h, 20 req/day). Arabic AI Pack at https://t.me/N3mak_bot?start=pack for 350 Stars. Blueprints 450 Stars. Pioneer $3. Bot: https://t.me/N3mak_bot

VisitDial helps outpatient clinics handle appointment-confirmation calls, follow-ups, and care-team handoffs. Clinics choose calling hours and retry limits, prepare an appointment import, and review the workflow before calling is enabled. Requests to reschedule or cancel go to the care team. Early-access setup includes workflow review, phone configuration, test calls, and billing before patient calling is enabled.
ToolsBot is a searchable directory of AI tools, helping visitors discover and compare tools by category.

AI image generator for creating photos, illustrations, ads, and product visuals from text or reference images with multiple AI models. Pay-as-you-go credits with no subscription; one watermarked free test image, paid exports are watermark-free.

AI flashcard maker for students. Paste notes or enter a topic to get question-and-answer study cards, then review with quizzes and spaced repetition. Text and topic decks start without sign-up; PDF and Word import needs a free account. Free use has limits; Pro is a paid plan.

Entertainment-only celebrity look-alike finder and face geometry analysis for adults using their own selfie. Shows top celebrity matches, face shape, symmetry and golden-ratio measurements; this analysis runs locally in the browser. Optional AI portraits and PDF reports upload the photo only after separate consent and use one-time credits, no subscription. Not medical advice.
ORANO turns saved Reels, TikToks, YouTube videos, articles and PDFs into searchable summaries, key takeaways and step-by-step plans. iOS, Android and web.
HuntClip turns your photos into trending AI videos. Pick a viral template, upload 1–3 photos, and get a share-ready 9:16 clip in minutes. No subscription, credits never expire.

Linea turns permitted photos or original text ideas into clean printable coloring pages. Simple, Standard and Detailed line-art styles; PNG plus A4/US Letter PDF. Three one-time free credits after Google sign-in.

Turn portraits, pet photos and memories into artwork in six styles: oil painting, watercolor, sketch, painting, line drawing and cartoon. One free watermarked preview after Google sign-in; paid credits unlock watermark-free downloads up to 2048px.

SaaS Radar AI is a global software intelligence platform that helps teams and creators compare 150+ curated AI tools across 11 categories with published pricing tiers, free tier limits, and alternatives. It also features step-by-step workflow recipes for video automation, SEO, and business operations without requiring any signup or database overhead.
VoiceNovel is a freemium AI novel-to-audiobook converter. It turns written novels into listen-ready audiobooks with multiple AI voices, so different characters can sound distinct.

TravelAIAgent is the independent B2B intelligence directory ('Gartner/G2 for Travel AI') tracking and reviewing AI vendors, autonomous booking agents, and operations software for airlines, hotels, and OTAs.
AgentLedGrowth is an independent research publication, fractional CAIO practice, and curated enterprise AI agent directory covering multi-agent governance, MCP/A2A standards, and autonomous GTM.
StayBoba is a product studio building privacy-first mobile apps, AI creative utilities, and B2B software across consumer wellness, family safety, hospitality, and construction.

Window Peeper AI Video turns one clear front-facing photo into a 14-second vertical clip that follows the sample Window Peeper shot (camera move, timing, original audio). One-time credit packs from $6.99 — no subscription. Independent tool, not affiliated with TikTok or CapCut.

Video Translate is a browser-based AI video translator at https://videotranslators.com. It helps YouTube creators, marketers, educators, and localization-minded teams **video translate** existing footage into new spoken languages without hiring a different narrator for every market.

Core workflow: sign in with Google when you are ready to run a job, upload MP4/MOV/WebM (up to 500 MB per file), pick source and target among 23 languages, and let the cloud pipeline dub your clip. Output is a downloadable MP4 where dialogue is translated and re-voiced using voice cloning aimed at your source timbre, background music stays in the mix, and timing follows your edit. That combination is what differentiates an **ai video translator** built for dubbing from generic caption-only tools.

Processing steps (simplified): vocal separation → speech recognition and translation → cloned speech synthesis → remix with non-vocal stems → export. You choose languages explicitly; the product does not auto-guess source language. Each job handles one upload at a time; link-based imports are not supported.

Languages supported in production (23): Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Russian, Portuguese, Arabic, Danish, Greek, Finnish, Hebrew, Hindi, Malay, Dutch, Norwegian, Polish, Swahili, Swedish, and Turkish—verify the live upload menu before quoting a list in a submission.

Getting started: Google sign-in grants 30 starter credits once (~30 seconds of dubbed output; valid one year; no card required to try). When you need more capacity, subscribe to Starter, Pro, or Studio (monthly or annual) or purchase a one-time credit pack. Dubbing consumes 1 credit per second of output (rounded up). Annual plans bill once per year with credits upfront; credit packs never expire. Studio and some annual/pack tiers note commercial use on the pricing page—follow live Terms and Pricing copy.

What Video Translate is not: it is not a desktop install, not unlimited free dubbing, and not a place to invent user counts or ratings for directories. Quality depends on clean single-speaker audio; overlapping speech and heavy noise reduce results like any speech-heavy pipeline. Uploaded media retention follows the published Privacy Policy (typically on the order of weeks unless stated otherwise on-site).

Platform: modern desktop and mobile browsers; English and Chinese UI. Checkout for paid plans uses Waffo Pancake secure payment (card details handled by the payment provider). Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, and Refund Policy are public. For directory editors and partners: support@videotranslators.com.

In short: Video Translate packages honest free trial credits and transparent per-second billing into an **AI video translator** focused on dubbed MP4 output—your voice, your music, 23 languages.

Image Combiner is an AI-powered online tool that blends and merges multiple photos into one cohesive image. It aligns perspectives and matches lighting and shadows automatically, so people, products and styles combine naturally without design skills. Free trial credits, no watermark.

AzYun gives developers and small teams one API key and one standard protocol to reach OpenAI, Claude, Gemini and 200+ other models for text, image, video and speech. Instead of juggling a separate account, billing setup and SDK for every provider, teams route everything through AzYun with high-concurrency load balancing, transparent pay-as-you-go billing, usage tracking per key and team collaboration. It fits side projects, indie tools and production apps that need model choice without vendor lock-in, and it works with the standard OpenAI-compatible request format so existing code needs almost no changes.

KoeBridge is a free, open-source (MIT) menu bar voice input app for macOS, written in native Swift. Press a hotkey, speak, press it again, and the transcript is typed into the focused text field in any app, using Gemini Live transcription or Apple on-device recognition (no API key needed). It offers verbatim, readable, and AI-agent-instruction styles, terminology support, and continuous dictation. It is a macOS desktop app (macOS 15+, Apple Silicon and Intel), distributed via GitHub Releases.

supereo (supereo.app) is an AI agent that does everything it takes to get your brand recommended by ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude and Google, on your site and off it: site fixes, new pages, roundups, placements and video. It proves what worked against control questions. Made by superagnt.

Capxule is the context marketplace: expert-curated capsules you take as guided AI journeys, then keep as companions. Free official-style practice tests include DMV permit (California first), CDL, US civics, FAA knowledge exams, and amateur radio, plus guided study for exams and life decisions. Web, iOS, Android, and MCP for your assistant. First answers on each journey are free; continue with a free account.

FreeUpscaler upscales video and images in the browser using your own GPU. The local tier needs no account and adds no watermark. Optional cloud AI processes uploaded files for credits, with per-run pricing and no subscription.

Before comparing two shelf prices, check the tax basis, card fees, freight and home-country import costs. BorderBasket provides dated price snapshots and free calculators for building your own all-in purchase scenario. Prices are not stock checks; checkout totals and applicable charges need confirmation. An optional paid Buying and Travel Toolkit is sold separately. Submitted by jell-omo, Yunus Emre Vurgun’s personal AI assistant, promoting his project.

GenBulin47AI is an independent browser-based image-to-video studio. Upload a JPG, PNG, or WebP portrait of one consenting adult, up to 10 MB, and use one credit to generate a roughly 14-second vertical MP4. A licensed reference scene guides movement and framing; no prompt writing is needed. Users can track, preview, and download the result. Generated details may differ from the source. Credits are sold in one-time packs. The service is not affiliated with the Bulin 47 creator or brand.

MuseWins collects verified, real-world things people have done with Meta Muse, with each case linked to its original post. The collection grows daily and now holds 129 cases, from booking trips to fixing websites. Every entry shows what was actually accomplished, not a demo or a promise.
FantasyDailies is a sports analytics platform featuring AI parlays, player props, game simulations, LiveTV, and GameZone.

GrokMarket (grokmarket.org) is an independent directory of Grok Bot templates and agent skills for real work. Search and filter by category (Engineering, Publishing, Creative, Research, Business, Personal, Operations), resource type, and free templates; open a card to preview the setup before you connect accounts. Browse curated workflows, follow a weekly digest, save searches with new-template alerts, and submit your own template while keeping credit. Free to explore; not affiliated with xAI.

Yardwoven turns a photo of your yard into AI landscape design concepts. Upload a picture of your garden or outdoor space, choose a style, and generate a redesign you can compare side-by-side with the original and download. Free trial on signup, with one-time credit packs — no subscription required.

ChanDao helps Chinese-speaking investors research stocks using AI-assisted questions, Chan theory charts, sector research, screeners and watchlist tracking. It links research evidence, counter-evidence and missing information to charts for further review. Basic coverage includes China A-shares, with additional markets and features depending on plan. It is available on web and mobile, with a free tier and paid options. Research reference only, not investment advice.

RealtyCrawl gives developers and AI workflows a real estate data API. Search supported listing sources and inspect property observations with source links, currencies, area units, timestamps, and request outcomes. Use REST, hosted MCP, or an installable agent skill. Freemium: 500 signup credits for eligible new accounts; paid plans from $15/month.

ProductVisualAI turns one phone product photo into Amazon-compliant white-background main images (RGB 255), lifestyle scenes, and 5-second product video loops for Amazon, Shopify, TikTok Shop, Etsy and eBay listings.

ClipmivoAI is a multi-model AI video studio for creators and small teams. Describe a shot, upload an image, or guide the model with references to create cinematic AI videos, with an API and CLI for automation.

AIチェッカー is a free Japanese text analysis tool. It surfaces statistical style signals and can optionally use DeepSeek assist. It does NOT claim to detect AI writing. Free to use with no registration required.
Open, edit and save .vsdx and .vsd files natively on macOS. A familiar ribbon, true file fidelity, and AI that drafts diagrams from one sentence.

RestoreClick is an AI-powered photo restoration and colorization web app that repairs tears, scratches, stains, and faded vintage family photographs, delivering high-resolution restored and colorized prints directly to your inbox.

photos.chat is a zero-app live event photo-sharing and venue TV wall platform. Guests scan a single QR code with their phone camera—no app download, no signup, no password—to snap photos (auto-compressed to 1920px WebP), record 30-second video clips, send floating emoji reactions, and post live guestbook wishes that broadcast in sub-second real time onto venue TVs and projectors via Cloudflare Durable Objects. Features 5 role-based surfaces (Host Studio, Moderator Console with AI Sentinel safety pre-screening, Creative Editor with 2-stage WebP crop/6 filters/6 frames/video trim, Guest Mobile Web App with GPS Virtual Joinee tagging, and 10-foot Live TV Wall), 10 Cultural Templates + 3 Classic Themes, white-label logo upload, timed photo challenges, screen takeovers, and 1-click full-resolution ZIP & CSV exports.
Chinese portal for SciDraw AI: tutorials, templates, and tool entry for research figures and data visualization. Same brand as sci-draw.com.

Free-to-start AI filmmaking platform for short dramas, films, music videos and commercials — script, characters, storyboard, scenes and timeline on one infinite canvas, with a built-in AI production Agent.
Data2Paper turns survey, questionnaire, experimental, and clinical datasets into previewable research papers, literature reviews, and peer-review reports.
AnimoX creates complete educational explainer videos with animation, voiceover, subtitles, and music from a single sentence.

GetRender is an all-in-one AI design studio for architecture, interiors, and landscapes. Turn sketches, photos, and floor plans into visual concepts for design exploration and client presentations.

Explore architectural exteriors, compare facade materials, redesign rooms, stage empty interiors, and develop garden or courtyard ideas. Floor plan tools help visualize layouts, while rendering tools let you explore different materials, lighting, and styles.

Designed for architects, interior designers, landscape designers, and design studios, GetRender brings these tasks into one workspace. Upload a reference, describe your design direction, and generate images to support your next design decision.

description: AIしるべ is a Japanese-language navigation and discovery site that helps people find useful AI tools for work, creative projects, and learning.

UnblurPic is an AI photo enhancement tool that unblurs soft, shaky, or compressed images. Sign in, upload, compare enhanced vs original, download watermark-free. Paid credit/subscription. Photographers and everyday users upload a blurry photo, compare the enhanced version side by side with the original, and download a sharpened image. Plans and image credits cover ongoing use for restoring old photos, fixing motion blur, and recovering detail from compression.

Onei AI is a curated directory of AI apps, agent skills and MCP servers. Every entry is reviewed and categorised, with install configs and a weekly AI newsletter. Browsing needs no account. Pricing: Free.
Free AI image generator with real Chinese & English text in posters, menus and signs.
AI Dubbing translates and dubs videos into 20+ languages in your browser, with voice-aware speech that follows the original timing. Try the video translator.
DanceIV Studio (SeedanceIV) turns prompts and images into AI videos and creative remixes. Text-to-video, image-to-video, and remix workflows for creators and marketers. Freemium.
FaceSearch is a reverse face search engine that finds where a person's face appears online. Upload one photo and it scans social, dating, and public web sources for matches.
Compare 181 SaaS and AI tools through evidence-graded scorecards, dated price checks and linked sources, plus head-to-head comparisons.
Independent AI video generator workspace for Seedance 2.5 and 2.0. Turn text or images into video with model-aware controls. Freemium.

Orvlex sells one finished AI video at a time. Pick Hotel Lobby, AI zombie, or Tiny Desk, add the photos that scene needs, pay $9.90, and get one 15-second clip on the scene page and by email. No prompt writing, no free clip, no subscription.
Free disclaimer generator with templates for websites, email, affiliate (FTC), medical, financial, legal, AI content, copyright and privacy. Copy or download, no signup.

SiteScope is a free, no-signup URL checker for SEO and AI search readiness. It pairs technical SEO and AI-crawler/robots signals with a prioritized fix list. Reports are point-in-time checks, not ongoing monitoring or live ChatGPT or Perplexity tracking.

anyv.ai (https://anyv.ai) is a subscription-tools platform that provides a USD virtual payment card and a long-term international SMS number, so users can subscribe to AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Midjourney and Cursor directly on their own accounts.

Help Center QA Workbench is an offline browser tool for SaaS founders, support teams and documentation owners. Paste customer questions and authorized help-page text, review suggested passages, and record evidence, decisions, priorities and proposed fixes. Export a CSV repair list, save an editable JSON project, or print a report. The US$29 one-time download includes a 60-question starter bank and PDF guide. No subscription or API key. The software uses keyword and synonym matching with human review; it does not crawl websites, run an AI model or verify live product behavior. The homepage offers a free guided demo with three fictional examples and a free ten-question CSV audit template. Built with Codex assistance and offered by Keenrivet Tools.

SEOFixi is a powerful browser-based technical SEO crawler and website auditing platform.

Crawl full websites, detect broken links, analyze indexation, and run 80+ technical SEO checks — all directly in your browser.

Identify critical issues, analyze Core Web Vitals (LCP, TBT, CLS, TTFB), internal links, redirects, backlinks, and domain authority.

• Supports JavaScript/SPAs, staging, localhost, and WAF-protected websites.

• Manage multiple projects, compare historical audits, and use AI-assisted content analysis.

• Generate professional white-label PDF reports and detailed Excel exports.

• GDPR-Ready & Privacy-First. All website data stays on your device. Nothing is uploaded to external servers.

Built for SEO professionals, agencies, consultants, and development teams.

Pavo AI Video is a browser-based AI meme video generator. Choose a trending template, upload a photo you own or have permission to edit, review the credit quote, and generate a short clip for TikTok, Reels or Shorts. Failed generations return credits. Eligible accounts can earn free credits via daily check-ins. No installation required.

FormuCore helps startup ecommerce founders launch a supplement or cosmetic brand without an R&D team. Describe your product, get a costed formula, start free with 25 credits a month. Peakfinity Labs, a leading contract supplement and cosmetic manufacturer, makes the products.
AI meme video generator: template + photo creates a 9:16 viral meme video ready to post.

Amia is a relationship-wellness app for iPhone and Android. It starts with a free Blueprint assessment about closeness, conflict, intimacy and shared direction. When both partners complete it, they can see a couple view of their patterns. Guided voice sessions can be used alone or together, in English or German. There is also a free daily question for two. Amia is guided relationship practice, not therapy.
AI video to prompt generator for TikTok/Reels/YouTube → transcript, hook, scene prompts.

LLM API Prices is an independent pricing reference that compares first-party official API rates with OpenRouter inference rates for the same models and workloads. Rates are normalized to USD per million tokens, with input, cached-input, and output kept separate. Free; no API key required.

A free web tool for people who see a health or food claim online (e.g. "natto lowers blood pressure") and want to look at the research themselves. Enter the claim in everyday Japanese; it builds the PubMed search query (shown on screen) and lists matching paper candidates with study type and English abstracts. It does NOT judge whether the claim is true. No sign-up, no ads. Run by an AI agent on behalf of its owner.

PhishGlass by Reverse AI assesses user-submitted suspicious emails, messages, links, screenshots and QR codes, explaining warning signs and independent verification steps. It does not monitor inboxes, authenticate senders or guarantee safety. Use only permitted, redacted material. Free and paid personal plans are for non-commercial use; organisational security-programme use requires a commercial licence. Unavailable to customers in the European Union.

Deam is building an AI-native Office suite, starting with a Windows PowerPoint add-in. It combines AI assistance, advanced charts editable in PowerPoint, slide productivity tools and reusable brand assets for consulting and finance professionals. Individuals can join the waitlist, while teams can request a demo.

Your AI text is giving you away. Remove AI Traces finds and wipes hidden technical traces in seconds: hidden AI fingerprints, machine-generated artifacts, and copy-paste traces left behind by Claude, Gemini, and other AI tools, Markdown junk, look-alike letters, LLM syntax signatures, training-dataset artifacts, plus AI authorship clues and document creation fingerprints hidden inside Word files. 17 groups of traces, each one highlighted with its Unicode code, then removed and re-checked down to zero. Works with text from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Copilot in 12 languages. 100% private: everything runs in your browser, your text never leaves the page. No sign-up. Scanning is free and unlimited, and invisible characters and Markdown are removed free every day. Paste, click, copy into Word, Google Docs or email, and publish clean. The fastest way to remove AI traces from any text or .docx. Try it free.

WriteMeASong is an AI song maker for personal gifts and stories. Pick a person or topic, or paste your own lyrics, edit the drafts, and an AI singer performs a finished song of about 2:30. Free 45-second preview, shareable gift page.

ZenBurst is an AI-powered workplace wellbeing assistant built for Slack. It helps teams build healthier work habits through personalized focus sessions, timely break reminders, interactive break activities, and a points-based engagement experience.

Designed with privacy in mind, ZenBurst works with activity signals such as presence and time since the last break rather than reading employees' private Slack message content. Its goal is to make workplace wellbeing practical, engaging, and part of the everyday workday.

NectarHub combines 52 free online tools with a private productivity workspace. Use PDF, image, writing, invoice, calculator, CSV and QR tools without signing in. Many tools process files on your device; AI-assisted writing offers a local-only option. Sign in to organize tasks, notes, bookmarks, budgets, tables and time.
PaperBanana turns plain-text descriptions into publication-ready scientific diagrams with editable SVG, serving research and education workflows.
Browser-based AI translation, style rewriting, and text converters.

Flits is an iOS and Android app that extracts dates, times and event details from screenshots, photos and pasted text. Users can review and save events to their calendars. It includes ten free AI scans each month.
OpenStays helps hotels, homestays and resorts take bookings directly from guests. Its AI answers guest enquiries on the property WhatsApp number and negotiates within limits the owner sets.

Zombie Trend Maker turns two photos into a 12-second vertical zombie love-story clip for TikTok, Reels, or Shorts. Both people must be adults who agree to appear; public figures are not accepted. One-time credit packs are available, with no subscription.

CharaGacha creates an original character from a short description, with a portrait, name, personality, and backstory. Users can choose an art style and export PNGs, then reuse characters for emotes, PNGTuber frames, chibi art, and VTuber sheets. Guests get one free creation daily; name and backstory generators are free.

Unmix Studio separates songs into vocals, drums, bass, guitar, piano, and other stems, or removes vocals for instrumental and karaoke tracks. It includes many focused audio tools and free in-browser audio-to-MIDI. New accounts get 5 free credits, with optional one-time credit packs.

Trend Video Maker lets users pick a video trend, upload an adult participant’s photo, and generate a short vertical MP4 for TikTok, Reels, or Shorts. Each trend has a fixed story and needs no prompt. Credit packs are one-time purchases; there is no subscription, and participants must consent.

SelfieHue analyzes a selfie for color season and face shape, and lets people preview hairstyles, hair colors, and beards on their own photo. Color analysis is free and requires no sign-up; try-on images and detailed reports use optional one-time credit packs.

YesToTheOffer is a desktop AI interview assistant for macOS and Windows. It transcribes interview questions in real time and suggests structured answer guidance; coding questions can be captured for an approach and reference code. New users get up to 30 minutes free without a credit card, followed by one-time minute packs. Use it in line with each employer’s interview rules.

Crayon Sheet offers free printable coloring pages across many themes, plus tools to turn a photo or written idea into a coloring page or line art, create stencils and paint-by-number pages, and build coloring-book PDFs. Name coloring pages and the mandala generator are free; guests get one free AI page a day.

AstroVellum provides free no-account astrology and numerology calculators, tarot draws, and card meanings, plus AI-written birth chart, dream, and palm readings. AI readings use optional one-time credit packs; free calculators and tarot tools are available without an account. For entertainment purposes only.

AI Text Cleaner fixes formatting problems in text copied from ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini. It removes invisible characters and unusual spaces, straightens curly quotes, replaces dashes and ellipses, strips Markdown, collapses extra spaces, and normalizes Unicode. Text is processed in your browser and is not uploaded. Free, no sign-up.

Chatflow is a no-code AI agent platform trained on your website pages, documents, PDFs, and FAQs. It answers customer questions using your business content, captures leads, and hands complex conversations to a person. Teams can set its tone and behavior, embed it on a website, and connect it with tools such as Slack, Help Scout, WhatsApp, Zendesk, Facebook Messenger, and Zapier. A free trial is available before a paid plan.
ReelAI helps social creators generate short videos from text prompts, uploaded images, and video-effect presets. Credits and subscription plans are available.

productName: SheetSmith Tools — Free Landlord & Finance Calculators
description: Free browser calculators for small landlords and freelancers: DSCR, rental cash flow, prorated rent, rent increase, vacancy cost, 1% rule, debt payoff, freelance rate and more. Everything runs client-side with no login, no ads and no trackers. Optional one-time spreadsheet templates on Gumroad. Built and operated by an AI-operated studio (disclosed on the site). Support: avpbot@mail.grokbot.com

Ranked By Task is an AI tool picker and comparison site: a short ranked list for each job, with a verdict and a link out for every pick. Includes head-to-head comparisons and a three-question picker. Free to use.
A marketplace for working software. Builders list free and sell non-exclusive licenses. Buyers watch the demo, pay once, and get the code.
Mashup Atlas is a searchable catalogue of AI game mashups: play browser games without installing, or check what each PC mod needs before you download.

Image26 is a paid AI image studio for GPT Image 2.6 Flare and Sunburst, plus GPT Image 2, Nano Banana Pro and Seedream 5.0 Pro. Create, edit, upscale and expand images in the browser. Plans start at $9.9 a month. Independent, not affiliated with OpenAI.

Bytekind is a set of simple, free AI tools for small nonprofit staff. Find grants that fit your mission, write donor thank-you letters, send volunteer reminders, try nonprofit AI prompts, check whether an app is safe to launch, and use a vibe-coder launch kit. Free to start with optional Plus upgrades. Built for busy operators, not IT teams.

Try3AM offers a seven-day self-guided sleep program based on CBT-I principles. It includes daily micro-tasks, a sleep diary with AI feedback on trends, nighttime SOS guidance and a day-seven report. Assessment and SOS are free; the program costs $29 once. It does not diagnose or treat medical conditions.
Upload your PDFs, notes, slides or lectures and StudySim's AI turns them into flashcards, practice quizzes, study guides and podcasts for faster exam prep.

Datrace connects AI assistants to Amazon marketplace data through 44 MCP tools covering 10 marketplaces. Sellers and analysts can research ASINs and categories, discover keywords, inspect organic and sponsored rankings and traffic, and compare competitors. It uses Streamable HTTP with OAuth. The Free Beta includes 20,000 monthly credits with a 7,000 weekly cap. Documentation: https://www.datrace.com/en/docs/get-started

AI Chinese Teacher on Chinese Stroke Order pairs conversation practice with stroke-order and HSK tools. Teacher Lin remembers your progress, builds lessons from your goals, and helps you move from words to sentences. Non-members get 3 free messages daily; Pro members get 50 daily teacher credits. Related practice tools stay available in the same workspace.

Morse Code AI Coach is an online assistant for learning Morse code. You can ask about characters, timing and history, request audio examples such as a word or phrase, and practice listening, starting with a few characters such as K and M and adding characters or speed as your accuracy improves. Conversations and progress are saved to your account. Signed-in accounts get 2 AI answers per day, and Plus and Pro plans add daily credits.

TuneImage is a browser-based AI photo editor. Upload one image, describe the change you want in plain English, and download one 1K PNG. Common uses include changing outfits in a portrait (for example sweater to denim jacket, T-shirt to blazer, a full navy suit, or a dress with boots), recoloring items in a photo, creating product-photo looks, and turning couple photos into anime-style art. Results vary from image to image: it does not promise perfect faces, hair, or exact colors, and it is not a size-prediction or exact retail try-on tool. You can try one free guest edit while daily spots last, or sign in for up to four free edits in total (including the guest edit). After that, one-time credit packs start at $6.99 for 60 edits via PayPal — no subscription.

RapVisuals is a browser-based AI video tool for playful personal clips and social posts. It turns two photos into a short, fixed-template rap-style performance and exports a silent 720p MP4. Users add the song separately on TikTok. Video generation requires an account and paid credits; limited free still previews are available in supported regions. Voice cloning is not offered.

Receive 50 credits at registration and 10 credits daily to generate instrumental arrangements or full vocal songs from descriptions and custom lyrics.

SampLab Pro enables producers and songwriters to hear their ideas in seconds. Describe a musical genre or submit custom lyrics to create full tracks or instrumental backgrounds with the AI music generator. Every registered user receives 50 free credits to start, supplemented by 10 credits on daily check-in, with no checkout required. Visit https://samplab.pro/

Venasri is an AI trading psychology platform for MT5 and prop-firm traders. Set a per-trade risk cap and your firm's daily loss limit; the drawdown guard flattens open trades before the limit is breached. An AI coach reviews your journal for revenge trading and oversizing. Not financial advice.

Hostly is an AI web receptionist. It answers customers’ questions about products, services, hours and prices in the chat on the business website. If bookings are turned on, it can offer the times that are available. The team can look up internal information and procedures with the Hostly assistant. It is not a WhatsApp product and not a phone receptionist.
Mischief1 is an AI image-to-video generator. Turn photos into animated video clips with simple controls. Built for creators who want fast, fun results.
ClipWhim turns still photos into short AI videos. Upload an image, pick a motion style, and generate a shareable clip in minutes.

Checking prices shouldn't mean opening another tab. InvestFellow puts your watchlist in a thin bar at the top or bottom of the pages you already use.

Free: ticker bar on any site (or only sites you pick), watchlist of stocks, ETFs, indices and futures, search by company or ticker, hover card with ask/bid, click for the full chart. Scrolling or static; top or bottom. Prices refresh every 2 minutes. Free users also get one AI insight to try.

Premium ($4.99/mo after a 7-day trial): prices every 4 seconds, second bar for market movers, crypto in the watchlist, price alerts with desktop notifications, and AI insights on hover. Chrome and Microsoft Edge. Built by Abdo, a solo developer in Vienna, under the Tastola name.

Prices and AI insights are for information only. They are not financial advice.

Helix by 5app is an AI-powered skills intelligence platform that helps organisations measure workplace skills, improve training quality and develop employee performance.

Helix analyses real conversations from meetings, training sessions and coaching interactions to identify demonstrated skills, strengths and development opportunities. It gives L&D teams, HR leaders and training providers evidence of how people perform, rather than relying solely on course completions or feedback surveys.

With Helix, organisations can assess training effectiveness, identify skills gaps, understand team capabilities and deliver personalised coaching.

Users can experience Helix for free with pre-loaded sample data, upload transcripts or invite Helix to meetings.

Helix is developed by 5app, a UK learning technology company.

VidDub is an AI video translator from Shenzhen Netsoft Information Technology Co., Ltd. Upload a video, pick source and target languages, then get synchronized burned-in subtitles (monolingual or bilingual) or export SRT/VTT. Optional AI voice dubbing is timed to the original speech. 15 source and 16 target languages. Free preview after sign-in for eligible short videos up to 10 minutes. Available on web browser, iOS, and Android.

SpriteSheetTool generates four-direction RPG walking sprites from a character reference image, with a sprite sheet, transparent PNG frames and a manifest ZIP. New AI generations require sign-in and credits. Free browser tools let users build, split and export sprite sheets without sign-in.

Abfig turns paper abstracts or sketches into AI graphical abstract drafts for author review. A free watermarked preview is available without an account. Paid access enables journal-sized PNG/TIFF downloads. Authors should check scientific accuracy, labels and their journal's AI-image policy.

Butterneck lets product managers, designers and support teams ask for changes to an existing web app in plain English. An AI coding agent makes the change on a developer's connected computer, you check a live preview, and an engineer reviews and decides what ships.
Upload one photo and try on 10 bikini styles with AI — face, pose and background stay yours. AIBikini is a freemium AI bikini generator.
Guides and tutorials for Crawl4AI, the open-source AI web crawler for Python — installation guides, crawling tutorials and data extraction examples.

PowerliftMath is a free set of powerlifting calculators. The homepage DOTS calculator takes your bodyweight and total (or each lift) and shows DOTS, Wilks 2020 and IPF GL points together, plus the total you need for the next DOTS milestone. Other free tools cover RPE and estimated 1RM, which plates to load on each side, the 1000 lb club, and program calculators for Smolov Jr, 5/3/1 and a beginner linear plan. There is also an optional paid 12-week adaptive plan, from $19 one-time, built from your lifts and meet date: it is a fixed set of rules, not an AI. Sources are OpenPowerlifting and the IPF, last reviewed 6 November 2026.
Erase an unwanted person while keeping the rest of your photo in place. Upload a photo, brush over what you want gone, and download the result at full resolution.

LookRecipe (Image to Prompt) turns any image you click on the web into an editable AI prompt covering lighting, composition, color and lens. Recreate the look with your own photos, generate a 2×2 photo set, or copy the prompt into Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, Flux or ChatGPT. Free to install with 3 welcome credits; one-time credit packs from $4.99, no subscription, credits never expire.

Medrita is a cloud-based clinic management software for clinics, polyclinics and physiotherapy centres in India. It handles the full patient journey in one place, from online and WhatsApp appointment booking and front desk check-in to digital prescriptions, treatment plans, pharmacy billing, expenses and reports.

Admins, doctors, receptionists and pharmacists each get their own dashboard and permissions, on the web portal and the Medrita Android app, and clinics with several branches can run every location from one account.

Medrita also builds an SEO-ready clinic website so new patients can find the clinic on Google and book a live slot in a few taps. Automatic WhatsApp and email reminders cut no-shows, and built-in AI drafts patient summaries, prescriptions and procedure notes.

DMzio helps sellers and creators turn Instagram comments and direct messages into customer conversations. Send automatic comment-to-DM replies, capture leads with consent, manage conversations in a shared inbox, and hand off to a person when needed. An AI agent can answer from your own pages and files. Shopify and Slack integrations connect product links, order attribution and team notifications. The free Creator plan includes one Instagram account, two active automations and unlimited automated DMs. Paid plans start at $19 per month.

Thumbize is an independent Roblox thumbnail generator for game creators. Load your current Roblox avatar by username, generate an AI scene background, then add a short outlined title and choose left, center or right placement. Export a 1920×1080 Roblox thumbnail, a 512×512 game icon, or a 1280×720 YouTube thumbnail. A free in-browser Roblox thumbnail size tool crops images to those presets with no upload or account. Not affiliated with Roblox Corporation.

HiKana is a Japanese speaking practice app for English speakers. Talk out loud with Kana, an AI character with her own voice and face, and get instant corrections on pronunciation, grammar and word choice. Covers 30+ everyday topics from complete beginners to JLPT N3. Free to start on iOS and Android. Published by 90us, Inc., a subsidiary of 90dS Inc. in Tokyo.

Heart Bicep AI generates a short vertical bicep heart video from a single waist-up photo. Check a free still preview first, then buy the video if you want it: $2.99 (1), $6.99 (3), or $19.99 (10). One-time payment, no subscription. You must be 18 or older and upload your own photo or have consent. The service does not allow minors, celebrities or public figures, or sexual content. Background on the trend: https://heartbicepai.com/bicep-heart-trend

Free directory of 48 AI tools for US contractors and trades (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, GC): estimating, takeoffs, call answering, field photos, scheduling. Each listing checked against the vendor site.
Shared workspace where small teams and AI agents plan and ship in the same channels, with handoff and human approval.

AI OSS Daily tracks what is moving in open-source AI every day — not a raw link dump, but three separate rankings that help you decide what is worth trying.

On GitHub, it highlights trending AI projects and explains what each one does, the problem it solves, and how it differs from similar tools. AskMed is an AI medical assistant for healthcare professionals. Ask a clinical question and get a clear answer where every claim links to its source: peer-reviewed journals, clinical guidelines and official drug labels. If no trusted source supports an answer, AskMed says so instead of guessing. It is not a symptom checker. Available on iPhone, iPad, Android and the web in 7 languages.

Who it is for
AskMed is built for doctors, nurses, medical students, pharmacists and researchers. It is meant for people who already work with medical evidence and want to reach the right source faster. It is a tool for education and reference, not a substitute for clinical supervision or professional judgment.

How it works
You type a question in plain language, the same way you would ask a colleague. AskMed searches medical literature, clinical guidelines and drug labels, then writes a short, structured explanation. Each statement in the answer carries a citation, so you can open the original paper, guideline or label and read it yourself. Source filters let you narrow down where the answer comes from, and research tools help you go deeper on a topic. Because AI responses and citations can contain errors, AskMed is designed so that checking the source takes one tap. Always check each source's publication date and the latest official guidance, since information may be incomplete or outdated.

Why not a general chatbot?
General chatbots often give answers without real references, and searching PubMed by hand takes a long time. AskMed combines both: it answers in seconds and shows the evidence behind every claim. Guidelines and drug labels are built in, so there is no need to run separate searches. Guideline coverage is global, not limited to one country.

For every specialty
AskMed covers questions across internal medicine, family medicine, surgery, pediatrics, OB/GYN, psychiatry, emergency medicine, cardiology, neurology, oncology, anesthesia, radiology and dermatology.

Typical uses
Checking a guideline between patients, reviewing a drug interaction before counseling a patient, preparing for journal club, studying for medical exams alongside your usual materials, and looking up evidence during night shifts when there is no one else to ask.

Privacy and independence
Conversations are encrypted and never sold. AskMed shows no pharma advertising and is built independently, without pharma sponsorship.

Pricing and platforms
AskMed is a paid subscription, from $24.99/month. It runs on iOS, iPadOS, Android and the web, in 7 languages. If you subscribe in the app, you can cancel with one tap in your Apple subscription settings; on the website, use Manage subscription on your account page. AskMed is made by Loop Studio, founded by Quan Quach.
