Pick recipient and tone, get two clearer options. Limit about 500 characters. No signup; drafts not saved on the site.
Software, apps, AI tools, tutorials, resources and useful websites.

Fake Review Detector is a free online tool that uses AI to analyze review text and give a verdict on whether the review looks genuine or fake. Paste any product or business review into the checker and get an instant authenticity assessment, plus tips on what to look for. The site also offers a website scam checker that screens a URL for common scam signals. Built to help shoppers and researchers spot manipulation in online reviews.

AI Meme Video turns uploaded photos into short, shareable meme videos. Users choose a dance, pet, rap or cinematic template, upload one or more photos, and generate a downloadable clip. It is for creators, meme makers, pet owners and social media users who want fast meme content without video editing.

Image Editor AI (ImagEditorAI) is a free online AI image editor for changing existing images with plain-language instructions. Upload up to five PNG, JPEG, or WebP references (20MB each), describe what to change and what to preserve, then choose a model, aspect ratio, and resolution. Remove objects, replace backgrounds, restore old photos, change clothing, combine references, or expand the canvas without learning layers or masks. Works in the browser with no sign-up required to start.

An AI sales agent for Shopify stores. It answers shoppers 24/7 from live prices and stock, adds to the real cart and checks every reply. Early access is open (not on the Shopify App Store yet). Free plan 25 conversations/month; paid from $59/mo via Shopify billing.

Paste your App Store, Google Play or website link. Reachira writes 30 video ideas, makes short-form videos and posts them to TikTok, Instagram, YouTube & more. Free plan with 100 credits, no card required; paid plans from $39/month.

AI Rap Video Generator turns a short theme into an original 15-second vertical rap lyric video. It generates the rap track and word-timed lyrics, then renders a downloadable MP4 in the browser. No song upload or account is required.

Madame Margo is an AI-powered online Tarot entertainment service featuring a fictional, sarcastic fortune teller. Explore Love & Relationships, Career & Money, or What Awaits Me? Five-card readings start at $1.99, with dark humor and zero sugarcoating. Online only, in English. For entertainment and personal reflection, not factual predictions or professional advice.

AI book cover generator for indie authors: turn your title, genre, and story summary into two distinct directions. Refine your favorite and download ebook/KDP front covers and square audiobook formats. Freemium: 20 free credits, one-time packs from $19, no subscription.

Lyks.ai is an AI-powered video creation platform designed for Shopify merchants, e-commerce businesses, and digital marketers.

It transforms Shopify product information, images, and descriptions into engaging AI-generated UGC and cinematic product videos.

With seamless Shopify integration, Lyks automatically imports your product details and generates compelling video scripts that you can review and edit before video creation.

Choose between AI UGC videos featuring virtual avatars with natural speech and lip-sync, or cinematic product showcases with professional visuals and motion effects.

Create engaging marketing content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and other digital marketing channels without hiring influencers, arranging video shoots, or needing professional editing skills.

Lyks.ai makes product video creation simpler, faster, and more accessible for growing e-commerce businesses.

NOX Vision is an AI-powered 3D object recognition SDK that enables developers to detect and track real-world objects in real time using a smartphone camera. Upload 3D models, integrate the SDK, and build interactive AR experiences without custom ML training.

Toonderly is an all-in-one creative studio that turns photos, references, saved characters, and written ideas into cartoon images, animated videos, reusable characters, and illustrated storybooks. Four creation types: Image Generator, Video Generator, Character Generator, Storybook Generator. Styles from Pixar and Ghibli to pixel art.
Letikette helps businesses track unpaid invoices and prepare payment reminders with Plume, its AI assistant.
Turns text, images, or a captioned video link into a whiteboard video with a script, hand-drawn scenes, voice, and music. One free 30-second video per account. Creator plan is $5.99 a month.
Tingkaopu recommends usable AI tools by the job you need done, with pricing and whether they work in China.

LumaReport is an AI-powered marketing report generator built for freelance SEO/PPC consultants and small agencies. Create professional, branded client reports in seconds — no more copy-pasting from GA4, Google Ads, or Search Console. Free plan: 1 report/month. Solo $19/mo: unlimited reports. Agency $49/mo: multi-client reports + white-label branding.

Coding agents load instruction files every session. When AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, Cursor rules or skills grow, adherence drops and every turn costs more. Clogmeter runs entirely in the browser: paste or drop your files, see per-file and per-section token cost against common context windows (32k / 128k / 200k), spot near-duplicate rules and conflicting always/never guidance, then download a cleaned markdown export. Built for developers using Cursor, Claude Code, Codex and similar agents. Free plan for one project; optional Pro at $15/mo for multi-project scans.

Contify is an AI-native Market and Competitive Intelligence platform that provides decision-ready insights on your market, industry, competitors, key accounts and other strategic entities. We help org-wide business teams to make faster, more confident decisions and respond to competitors with greater agility.

Editpad is a free collection of online tools for everyday text, file and image tasks. It includes a paraphrasing tool, an AI text summarizer, a JSON formatter, a JPG-to-PDF converter and other practical utilities that work in the browser without installing software. It is useful for students, writers, developers and office users who need quick, reliable helpers for editing, formatting and converting content.
Barz Studio turns your audio into a beat-reactive rap lyric video. Sync lyrics, pick a mood, export 9:16 WebM. Free without an account. You bring the track. Not an AI music generator.
Cyanvid is an AI video generator. Create from text or images, compare specs, and see exact credit quotes before you generate. Built for creators and marketers.

SeaDance is an independent web app operated by GAAI and is not affiliated with ByteDance. Write a text prompt and it renders a short 16:9 clip with the Seedance 2.0 Mini model, at 480p or 720p, up to 15 seconds, one video per request. Access runs on paid credit plans, and new accounts start with 0 credits.

AiTopMix is a free-to-browse directory of AI tools with honest comparisons, real prices, and free-tier limits checked against each vendor's own pages. Every listing states the price, the free allowance, the watermark rule, and whether the free tier allows commercial use, so creators know the truth before they pay. No sponsored rankings, ever — the scores move only when a product changes. Built for faceless YouTube and TikTok creators, the site also offers a prompt library, a glossary, profession stacks, and a Tool Finder quiz.
Upload one photo and get your PSL tier, 1-10 score, percentile and tips on what to improve. Free to try; photos are not kept on our servers.
Pimg is a free AI image toolkit: enhance blurry photos, upscale 2x/4x and generate images from text, with no watermark on free exports.
SongGen is an AI music maker: create full songs with vocals or instrumentals from a text idea or your own lyrics, plus free slowed+reverb and audio tools.
Unlimited free AI image generator. Sign in with Google to make pictures and edit your own photos on Veida AI Image v1 with no limit and no card | Veida AI

Create Roblox thumbnails in-browser from your screenshots. Add outlined headlines, stickers and backdrops, drag items on the canvas, export 1920×1080 PNG. Use ThumbBlitz to create Roblox covers from your own screenshots without uploading them. The editor loads in the browser, where you type a headline, pick from 8 text styles, add stickers from a set of 15, and select one of 16 backdrop presets. Drag text and stickers into place, reset the canvas if needed, then export a PNG at 1920×1080, 1280×720 or 512×512. There is no account, no watermark and no AI guesswork. Separate pages cover specific games, thumbnail size, backgrounds, A/B testing, game icons, decals and templates. The workflow is manual: the thumbnail is made from your image, not generated.

Facetry gives you an AI beauty score from a single selfie in the browser. The score itself is free. If you want the longer write-up, the full report is $9.99 once, not a subscription. It is aimed at people who want a straightforward face read rather than filters, editing, or a makeup preview.

Tolee (tolee.in) is an AI-powered Indian social networking platform built for real communities. Connect with nearby interest groups, watch trending local reels, get hyper-local radar alerts about your neighborhood, stream unlimited songs across languages, and chat with Tolee AI. Free to join — sign up on tolee.in or download the app on Google Play.

VariantLedger compares a current native Shopify product CSV with a proposed import in your browser. Review price changes, variant identifiers, ambiguous matches and supported file-format problems, then export CSV or JSON findings. The free preview accepts 100 data rows per file. Catalog files stay on your device; no store connection or AI API is used. It never imports or modifies a store and does not guarantee import success. A USD 29 offline edition is proposed but is not yet for sale.

Radarkit is an AI search visibility platform that shows how your brand actually appears inside AI answers via real browsers on 4G/residential IPs across 50+ countries (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot, Google AI Mode/Overviews). Local/Shopping/Ads Radar. Analytics + AI agents + MCP/API. Plans from $29/mo with 7-day free trial.

Qwen TTS is an online text-to-speech and voice cloning tool built on the Qwen3 TTS model. Clone a realistic voice from a 3-second sample or generate emotional speech from text, in English, Chinese, Japanese and Korean. Free trial with no signup required.

Motion Skills turns your docs, code, data or script into a postable video inside Claude Code, Codex or Cursor. Renders MP4 locally. Free to start. Built for developers, indie makers and founders who use coding agents.

MoneyPrinterTurbo Online turns a topic or script into a publish-ready 1080p short video: AI copy, HD footage from Pexels/Pixabay/Coverr, voice, subtitles, and music—no local setup. Freemium browser studio for TikTok, Reels, Shorts, YouTube.

AI virtual try-on for clothes. Choose a garment and a photo of yourself or a model, then preview outfits with AI in one workspace. Browse sample looks without signing in; Google sign-in unlocks generation credits.

RouteMux is a reliability-first AI gateway. One API key reaches models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, DeepSeek, Qwen and more through the SDK you already use. Requests fail over across redundant routes, and you only pay for the ones that succeed. Pay-as-you-go pricing starting at $10.
Free AI palm reading from a photo of your palm, just for fun.

Before You Ink is a tattoo CHECKER (not a generator). Upload a design, flash art, or AI concept to review placement, readability, aging, and regret risk before you book. Freemium: 5 free analyses; $4.99 for 20 one-time.
AI photo cleanup in your browser: brush over objects, people, text or watermarks and get a clean background. Try free, no signup needed. For online sellers, photographers, travellers and creators.

Denpex delivers automated cluster diagnostics and root-cause analysis for high-performance GPU infrastructure and AI training fleets. Denpex isolates hardware anomalies, silent data corruption, and network bottlenecks across NVIDIA H100 and B200 clusters before they cascade across training jobs.
Build and print a family tree in the browser with a privacy-first approach. Aimed at people who want a simple DIY tree without forcing relatives into a public social graph.

MusicPromptPro turns a rough music idea into copy-ready prompts, Suno and Udio style tags, lyrics direction, and structured music briefs before you generate. Helps creators prepare Universal, Suno, Udio, Lyrics Direction, and Style Tags. Free daily AI quota for visitors.

iRoomDesign is an AI room designer that works from a photo of your real room. Choose full renovation or furniture-only, pick styles like Japandi or Scandinavian, keep walls/windows/proportions. Freemium: 1 free design; credit packs from USD 4.99; subscriptions from USD 9.99/mo.

Describe a scene or upload a photo, and Veo 3.1 turns it into an 8-second video with sound — dialogue, footsteps, rain on the window, all generated with the picture. Start with Veo 3.1 Lite for quick takes, then move up to Fast or full Veo 3.1.
Turn a prompt or a photo into a 5–20 second FLUX 3 Max video with synced sound at 720p or 1080p. Set a start and end frame, then run the next take. Free starter credits; paid plans from $19.90/mo.
The upgrade to Nano Banana 2. Combine up to 14 reference images, keep faces and products consistent, and get sharp text inside the picture. Start with Nano Banana 2 right here.
Deep Face Cam is an open-source desktop application for local image, video, and live-camera face swaps on macOS and Windows.
Local AI face swap software for Windows that creates realistic photo and video results with real-time preview, NVIDIA GPU acceleration, and private on-device processing.

Virtual Stage Now stages empty-room listing photos with AI. Upload a JPG, PNG or WebP, choose the room type and one of six furnishing styles, and preview the staged room before buying. Walls, windows and the camera angle stay as shot. Brokers can stage up to 8 angles of one room with matching furniture. Packs start at 5 images for $15.

testfide is an independent practice site for the fide language test, which people in Switzerland take for a residence permit (C permit) or for citizenship. It covers German and French at levels A1 to B1.

Free: B1 reading tasks with explanations; writing practice (formal letter and email) and speaking practice (picture description and B1 conversation) with an AI estimate of your level based on the official scoring criteria; all 141 official test centres and dates; which level you need for a permit or citizenship; guides to the oral exam and letter writing; and a printable PDF practice sheet. AI feedback needs a free Google sign-in.

testfide Plus (USD 35, one payment, 60 days, no subscription) adds four more practice sets per language, up to 20 texts and 10 recordings a day, and a progress report.

testfide is not affiliated with the State Secretariat for Migration (SEM) or the fide secretariat; the official model test is on fide-service.ch.
OKNP is a sourced AI reference: models, Agents, channels, products, companies and papers in one place — with sources and observation dates, without ranking or recommending one over another.

Tapemoon is an AI music video generator for your own songs. Upload a WAV or MP3 up to 8 minutes or paste a Suno link, edit the storyboard, then render a beat-cut MP4 with lyrics timed to the vocal, in 16:9 or 9:16 up to 1080p, cinematic or anime styles.

Saybrush is an AI image editor where you describe the change in one sentence: remove objects, swap backgrounds, relight, recolor or upscale, plus a background remover. Two free edits with no account, three more on signup, no watermark, then pay per edit.

Free AI Rap Video turns uploaded photos into short AI-generated rap videos using ready-made templates. Choose a scene and add your photos to create personalized clips for social sharing. A limited free trial is available, with paid options for further use.
Lap Photos — a private, open-source photo manager for your library. Organize photos locally with AI photo search, duplicate finder and more. Free and open source.

Jev001 — a reference library for Jev, TypeSafe AI's System One decision model, and Laya open-source alternatives. Explore 1,173 Jev cases, demos and projects, plus topics, builders and open-source resources. Free.

Git Homed — a daily mirror of GitHub Trending. See the most starred and most active repositories every day, with weekly and monthly rankings across Images, Videos, Audio and AI Skills. Free, no sign-up, no sponsored placements.

AIImgPrompt — a free library of 1,500+ AI image prompts for Midjourney, Flux and more, plus image-to-prompt and text-to-image tools. Browse prompts by category and model, copy and create. Free, no sign-up required.
ai-homed.com is an AI video generator built around fun, ready-to-remake video templates — pick a template and recreate it as your own video in a few steps, no editing skills needed.

AI Homed — GitHub Trending aggregator. Discover the most starred and most active GitHub repositories, updated daily. Browse daily, weekly and monthly trending lists across Images, Videos, Audio, Models and AI Skills. Free, no sign-up, no sponsored placements.
Free random movie picker: filters for Netflix and more, no repeats, trailers, watchlist—no sign-up. Real film catalog—not AI-generated titles.

Free AI virtual makeup try-on — try any makeup look on your own photo, no sign-up required. Upload a selfie, pick from natural, glam, smokey, wedding and more looks, and compare before/after instantly.
Hotel Lobby AI turns two photos into a short AI music-performance video set in a luxury hotel lobby scene. Upload photos, generate online, no app to install.

AI-powered quotation generator for cleaning businesses. Builds professional, itemized cleaning quotations with smart US market pricing, plus SMS and email follow-up messages for Day 0, 3 and 7. Free to try with 3 free quotes and no credit card; Pro is $27/month.
Tiny Markdown packs for freelancers — AI writing briefs, prompt packs, quote/invoice kits. Instant download.

I'm Piet Baudoin, founder of Poldermarketing. Marketing, AI and automation in one person. I make sure buyers, and their AI agents, find you first: on Google and in AI answers. AI doesn't replace what makes a brand human. It amplifies it. I work with clients worldwide, in their own language. https://poldermarketing.nl/

CryptoNews turns related crypto reporting into short briefs with links to the publishers used. Topic pages and coin hubs connect the news to the assets readers follow, while a tools directory offers calculations for costs, planning and portfolio scenarios. Its methodology explains AI assistance and automated checks, so readers can understand how the briefs are prepared.

Submit a Tool is a free, ordered checklist of 270+ hand-curated AI and SaaS directories, ranked by authority and re-checked monthly, so you can submit your AI tool and track every listing in one place.
Image to Image AI is a free online img2img generator. Upload a photo and transform it into new styles or variations with AI, right in the browser. No sign up needed to try it.
TextRemover.org is a free AI text remover: upload an image or photo and erase captions, watermarks and overlaid text while the background gets filled in. Works on mobile, no install.

Mike AI is an AI advisor built by Doer Tough LLC for big-money decisions. Paste a VIN to see what a used car is worth, get a contractor quote checked for padding, get practical home repair guidance, and run the numbers on a real estate deal. Works in your browser; free 7-day trial, no credit card.

AbodeVid is an AI-powered real estate video maker and property marketing platform designed for real estate agents, brokers, agencies, and property photographers.

Transform existing listing photos into cinematic property videos without filming or complicated editing. Create videos in 16:9 landscape, 9:16 vertical, and 1:1 square formats.

Premium campaigns include an integrated Real Estate Marketing Kit featuring single-property websites, branded brochures, social media marketing content, buyer lead capture tools, and seller-facing materials.

Standard campaigns start at $9.99 per property, Cinematic 30 costs $19.99, and Pro is available for $35/month.

A separate free slideshow maker offers two watermarked creations every 30 days.
AITranscribe turns video and audio files into text transcripts and TXT, SRT or VTT subtitles, with in-browser Whisper or Workers AI. Free tier after sign-in.
AEO Inspector grades how readable and citable your website is to major AI answer engines. Free scan covers crawler access, agent readiness, and a fix list so pages show up in AI answers.

CopyrightChecker is a music copyright checker for video creators. Upload a video, MP3 or other audio file and it fingerprints the audio against a 150M+ track library, then returns a report: the song title, artist, label or distributor, ISRC and release year; a plain-language platform risk level for YouTube and TikTok; for full scans, where the music plays in every 12-second segment; and royalty-free swaps to use instead. Free checks scan short clips (3 per day); files are deleted after 24 hours. Full-video scans are a paid option.
AI-related cost calculators (LLM API cost, prompt caching savings, AI ROI, VRAM, RAG token budget, AI video cost, etc.)

Problems captures the errors agents hit in your product, posts them to an agent status page, and steers agents back on track.

See which tools and commands agents call, spot recurring failures, and inspect recent error occurrences. Recurring problems appear automatically on the status page and clear after five quiet minutes.

Add Problems to an MCP server or CLI with the @problemsdev/sdk npm package.

Pixel Avatar Generator turns a photo into a pixel art avatar in the browser. Upload a portrait, choose one of five styles — 8-Bit Classic, GameBoy, Retro 16-Bit, Cyberpunk, or Anime Pixel — and the AI redraws the face in that palette. Output size is selectable at 128, 256, 512, or 1024px with adjustable color mode and background. It is built for Discord, Steam and Telegram profile pictures, streaming overlays, and game projects. New users get five free generations.

Turn a recording or YouTube link into a gentle music-box arrangement. Hear a free preview, adjust the arrangement and tempo, then make a one-off purchase of the full lullaby to export audio and share a listening link. No subscription.

Ozil Goal AI is a browser-based photo-to-video tool for adult football fans and short-video creators. Upload one photo of yourself or an adult who has given permission, then use a fixed template to generate an original fictional football goal scene. The requested output is an 8-second, 720p vertical MP4 with sound. Buy one-time credit packs; each generation uses 10 credits. There is no subscription or free video allowance. Free photo-preparation and prompt tools are separate from paid video generation. Review completed videos, save them in your private library and download the MP4. AI likeness, clothing and ball movement can vary. Independent project, not affiliated with Mesut Ozil, any club or tournament.

Prizm helps job seekers apply better without losing their evenings to it. Paste a job offer and Prizm starts with an honest fit verdict: how well your profile matches, what is strong, what is missing. Then you decide whether it is worth applying. If it is, Prizm tailors your CV and cover letter to that offer in under a minute, using only your real background. It never invents experience or skills. Templates are clean and readable by applicant tracking systems (ATS). Free to start (5 applications per week, the verdict is always free), then one-time packs with no subscription. Built in France for graduates, professionals, apprentices and career changers.

SECODE is a browser-based security-training platform for developers, engineering teams and educators. It combines language-specific secure-coding missions, Python security exercises, AI-security learning and short security lessons. Learners work through scenarios, quizzes and explanations to practise decisions about input validation, web application security, prompt injection, AI agents and MCP risks.

A practical starting point is Python Security Quest, which opens with a registration-input validation scenario. Some modules are marked beta, and access varies by module and plan. The first Python question and answer feedback were available without sign-in during our check.

TokScript transcribes individual TikTok, YouTube and Instagram video links into editable text. Review the transcript and export TXT, SRT or VTT. Videos up to five minutes are free without registration; longer videos use paid time packages.

flatt is an AI inference subscription for developers who use coding agents every day. A fixed monthly price covers access to the models included in your plan, with no monthly token limit. Connect Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, Grok Build and Pi Agent using one API key. The CLI helps configure compatible tools and launch an agent from the terminal. Plans define included models, concurrent requests and context per request. Documentation is available in English and Portuguese.
Image to Video is an AI tool that turns product photos into short promo videos and images for Etsy and Shopify sellers, using models like Veo 3.1 and Seedance.

MemeVideoMaker is a browser-based AI meme video maker for creators who want to place themselves in current TikTok, Reels, and Shorts trends. Choose a trend template, upload one to five clear portraits, and export a clean vertical MP4 with the motion and camera direction already mapped. The workflow is built for fast social publishing and does not require timeline editing or prompt engineering. Visit https://memevideomaker.org to try the best meme video maker.

MiPrep AI helps job seekers prepare for interviews with resume-and-job-description grounded answers, practice/mock interviews, and a private desktop overlay for Zoom, Meet, and Teams. A free tier is available on macOS and Windows.
Independent tracker for AI usage limit resets across Codex, Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Gemini, Copilot and Grok, with alerts, a Chrome extension and a free API.

Verifly checks email addresses before you send to them. Upload a CSV or call the REST API and every row comes back as ok, invalid, catch-all, disposable or unknown, after syntax, domain/MX and mailbox checks. There is no monthly subscription: packs start at 5,000 checks for $10, credits never expire, and new accounts get 100 free credits. It is built for cold-email teams, outbound agencies and developers: guides for Clay, n8n, Make, Zapier, HubSpot, Apollo, Smartlead and lemlist, plus a hosted MCP server at https://verifly.email/mcp so AI agents can verify an address before they email it.

KlantcontactVergelijker.nl is a Dutch research platform for organisations choosing customer contact software: telephony and contact centres, helpdesks and shared inboxes, WhatsApp and live chat, and AI phone assistants. The database covers 54 tools from 53 vendors in 15 categories, each researched on the same 77 features, from channels and integrations to security and pricing. Every claim links to a source with a verbatim quote; anything that cannot be found is marked 'not found' and never counts as yes. There is no ranking and no winner: lists are alphabetical and inclusion is free. Visitors can compare tools side by side, use a selection guide, compare prices and estimate AI phone assistant costs with a calculator. Operated by LOADIQO, Almere, the Netherlands.

DishPenny is a free browser beta for independent kitchens maintaining recipe costs. Keep a shared ingredient catalogue and reusable prep recipes; compare supplier price changes with a saved baseline before updating affected recipes. Planned portions produce ingredient demand and whole-pack shopping quantities as separate values. Export working documents and keep a local backup. The workflow does not provide nutrition, allergen or food-safety certification. No account or card is needed.

Submitted by the tool’s maintainer, Rogin Tools. This description was prepared with AI assistance.

BunchPlan is a free browser beta for event florists planning flower purchases. Enter supplier SKUs and bunch sizes, build recipes, and combine requirements for events sharing a delivery date. It separates stems consumed from whole bunches purchased and can allocate existing stock. Export supplier orders, production sheets and client estimates separately. Keep the full workbook private. It does not reserve live wholesaler inventory. No account or card is needed.

Submitted by the tool’s maintainer, Rogin Tools. This description was prepared with AI assistance.

MockFlair is a free browser beta for artists preparing framed-poster listing images. Bring your own flat artwork, choose frame and mat settings, then apply the same look across selected rooms. Export PNG or JPG files individually or in a named batch ZIP. Full artwork preserves the image; Fill & crop is an intentional alternative. Outputs are listing previews, not print masters or photographs of manufactured products. No account or card is needed.

Submitted by the tool’s maintainer, Rogin Tools. This description was prepared with AI assistance.
WhimKid turns an idea, a photo, or a familiar character into an illustrated children's storybook with editable pages and PDF export. Freemium. Ages 0–12.

Watch the task in My videos and download your silent 9:16 MP4 when it is ready. Add a permitted sound inside your publishing app and label the post as AI-generated.

Excel for Accountants Practice is a free interactive learn-by-doing site: lessons 1–4 are fully open (no signup). Content is AI-assisted with fictional sample data only; not affiliated with Microsoft.

I operate AIClipPilot, a web-based video clipping tool for recorded podcasts, interviews, lessons and webinars. Upload an MP4, MOV or WEBM recording, review AI highlight suggestions and captions, and export short, watermark-free MP4 clips. Paid plans include timing and subtitle editing, smart framing and batch ZIP downloads. AIClipPilot repurposes existing footage rather than generating video from a prompt. A limited free plan is available; current plans are at https://aiclippilot.com/pricing.

Legalnaut helps litigation teams build chronologies, compare accounts and examine evidence with page-level source references. Trace findings to a document, page and quotation. Compare conflicting accounts and identify evidence gaps.
Lanesra AI is an analytics and optimization platform built to track brand visibility, positioning, and sentiment inside AI search engines and generative models

SIOS coordinates AI agents for ops, sales, marketing and compliance behind a pre-execution approval queue. It has per-agent budget controls and a full audit trail, and runs in your region under your brand. Built for businesses that want AI automation without losing control or an audit trail. Enterprise deployment, quote on request.
Lyria 3 AI turns a prompt or lyrics into an original song in the browser. Preview your track, then continue with vocal removal, stem splitting and lyrics tools.

Coding Tools MCP is an open-source MCP server that gives any AI chat or agent a safe pair of hands on a codebase — 18 tools over the Model Context Protocol: file search, atomic multi-file patches, PTY command execution, and git. Model-neutral (works with Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, Gemini CLI), gated by permission modes with Landlock kernel confinement on Linux. Apache 2.0, published on PyPI and npm.
Helps ecommerce teams put AI automation into real workflows — FDE for Amazon sellers, custom workflows, training and coaching. Operator-built studio (富富工作室).

Marketing films, product explainers, training and investor updates with narration, music and subtitles. Review the storyboard before production. Storyboards free; first video $2.99. 31 languages, up to 4K on plans, commercial use.

Swayno helps indie developers and SaaS and app teams turn a website or App Store link into short-form marketing content. Create videos, review and edit content, organize a content calendar, and schedule posts for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. It also includes AI influencer characters, video templates, carousel creation, and cross-channel analytics. A 3-day free trial is available, with paid plans from $29 per month.

Fame OS is the software that underpins everything Fame does: the operating system behind Fame's done-for-you B2B podcast, LinkedIn creator and AI-search/AEO services. It covers guest & topic planning, production workflows, repurposing episodes into LinkedIn/social content, and pipeline & visibility tracking. Offered as part of Fame's services.
Browse 9,000+ free AI image prompts for ChatGPT, GPT Image 2 and Nano Banana. Every prompt is copy-ready: paste, generate, no prompt engineering needed.
AgentSkillsDir is a directory of agent skills, MCP tools, and harnesses for AI coding agents. Browse skills and harness pages, then open the ones you need for Claude Code and similar agents.

RapBooth turns adult portraits into template-based AI rap videos with vocals and a beat. Unlike generic AI coding assistants, Phoenix.vu works side-by-side with Xcode, eliminating the need to switch between external chat interfaces and code editors. It provides real-time build monitoring, reviewable code diffs, and approval controls, allowing developers to maintain control over every change.

Phoenix.vu also prioritizes developer privacy. Source code and project history stay on the developer's Mac, while only the minimal context required for AI inference is sent externally.

Whether you're building iOS applications, developing SwiftUI interfaces, fixing build errors, or improving existing Apple projects, Phoenix.vu helps streamline your entire development workflow.

Build, debug, and ship Apple applications with an AI coding agent designed specifically for Xcode.

Start by asking a question in your own words, then draw your tarot cards. Taromi interprets the cards in the context of your question, turning traditional tarot symbolism into clear, accessible explanations tailored to your situation.

Key Features

- AI Tarot Readings: Get personalized interpretations powered by AI.
- Interactive Card Drawing: Draw tarot cards as part of your reading experience.
- Question-Based Readings: Explore personal questions about relationships, life decisions, and personal challenges.
- Contextual Interpretations: Understand card meanings in relation to your question.
- Clear Explanations: Explore tarot symbolism without needing prior knowledge.
- Self-Reflection: Use tarot readings to consider different perspectives and possibilities.

Who Is It For?

Taromi is designed for people interested in tarot, self-reflection, and personal insight. Whether you are new to tarot or already familiar with the cards, Taromi offers an accessible way to explore your questions through personalized AI interpretations.

Use Taromi to reflect on relationships, consider important decisions, and explore personal challenges. Readings are intended for reflection and entertainment, offering perspectives to consider rather than guaranteed predictions or professional advice.

TattooJinn is an AI-powered tattoo design generator that helps you turn your ideas into custom tattoo concepts without needing drawing skills.

Describe your tattoo idea using a text prompt and optionally upload a reference image to guide the design. TattooJinn uses your input to generate visual concepts, making it easier to explore different ideas and styles.

Key Features

- AI Tattoo Generation: Turn written ideas into visual tattoo concepts.
- Text-to-Image Creation: Describe the design you imagine and generate a visual concept.
- Reference Image Uploads: Use inspiration images to help guide your design.
- Personalized Concepts: Explore tattoo ideas based on your preferences and creative vision.
- Design Exploration: Experiment with ideas before deciding on your next tattoo.

Who Is It For?

TattooJinn is useful for tattoo enthusiasts, people planning their first tattoo, and anyone looking for inspiration for a custom design. It can help users explore possibilities and prepare visual references to discuss with a professional tattoo artist.

Whether you have a detailed concept or just a few words describing an idea, TattooJinn makes it easier to visualize potential tattoo designs with AI.

Browser-based text match cut generator that keeps one word fixed while paper-style layouts change around it. Three free templates, no signup or watermark; optional AI backgrounds with credits. Export 2–8s clips in 9:16, 1:1 or 16:9 for title beats and transitions — not a full video editor.

AI-powered TCF/TEF Canada French exam prep with personalized writing and speaking feedback and live teaching by Adèle. Freemium SaaS for language learners, schools, and language programs.

Free browser tool: short form to paste-ready ChatGPT Custom Instructions or Claude Project instructions. No signup, no API, nothing stored. Formatting helper for solo founders.

AI CAD for makers and engineers. Edit templates and STEP so functional parts fit, including on phone/tablet.

You built your app with AI. Has anyone checked if it is safe?

VibeVigil looks at the live, public site of an app you built with Lovable, Bolt, v0, Cursor, Replit or Supabase. It runs passive checks and explains each problem in plain words.

What it looks for:
- Secret API keys showing up in your frontend code
- Supabase tables without Row Level Security (RLS), which strangers may be able to read or change
- Public .env or .git files
- Missing HTTP security headers
- SSL and HTTPS certificate problems
- Downtime

For every problem it finds, VibeVigil gives you a ready-to-paste fix prompt. Paste it into your coding agent and let it make the change. You do not need to be a security expert.

The free scan needs no account. Scan only apps you own. Paid plans let you save sites and scan them on a schedule.

VibeVigil does not guess passwords, exploit bugs or read private repos. It is not a penetration test, and it does not promise that an app is fully secure. It helps you find and fix common gaps.

Podium is an open-source agent development environment (Apache-2.0). It combines an agent-native issue tracker with a coordinator for coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Grok and Pi. You prompt your idea together with the software factory you want: which agent researches, which writes the spec, which reviews, when you approve, and which agents build in parallel. The coordinator agent turns that into tasks, subtasks and dependencies, brings in the other agents and follows their results. Tasks, decisions, handoffs and results are stored as structured state on a board that you and your agents share. Plans, screenshots, recordings, test evidence and cost estimates stay attached to each task. You can change the plan at any time, through the coordinator or directly with an individual agent. Podium runs on your Mac or on a Linux VPS you own, and you can follow the work from the desktop app, your phone or a browser.
